A Crystal Reflection.description: The technique is similar in style to the Demonic Mirroring Ice Crystals technique of the Yuki Clan. However, utilizing the Jade Crystal Labyrinth and its reflective properties, the user casts a generic genjutsu that changes the appearance of the crystal in a subtle manner. Put simply, it leads the opponents on, consistently harrying their sense of direction, with the crystal's reflective properties further aiding the genjutsu's confusion aspects. When fully utilized, it is capable of keeping a large group of shinobi occupied potentially indefinitely depending on the scope and size of the technique.

Absolute Darkness Technique.description: It is a Genjutsu developed by Junsui after learning the Bringer of Darkness technique combined with his Senses manipulation genjutsu. This technique is basically an enhanced form of the parent jutsu. The user performs the required hand seals and he gets his opponent under a genjutsu of them having none of the five senses, which are sight, hearing, smelling, tasting or even feeling. This technique is very strong, but there is a catch to it. The opponent needs to be already under the user's genjutsu, unlike the original technique where it can be applied out of nowhere. This technique can be broken if the opponent manages to directly hit the user, so experienced sensory-type shinobi should make perfect counters for this technique. While the target's senses are completely nullified, the user can manipulate these senses with Genjutsu. He can make the target hear a certain sound that wasn't ev

Absolute Darkness: World of Shadows.description: Zettai-teki na Yami : Sekai no Kage (絶対的な闇:世界の影, Absolute Darkness: World of Shadows) is a jutsu developed by Nigini, it allows him to create a large dome where the sense of sight wont work, only the user has the sense of sight, so basically, Nigini can create a world where he is the one with vision and everybody inside are blind. It is like the Bringer-of-Darkness Technique, the only think different is that when Nigini uses the Bringer-of-Darkness Technique he still cannot see, while when he use this jutsu, it gives him a black and white vision.
Absolute Darkness: World of Shadows.title: Absolute Darkness: World of Shadows

All Seeing Darkness.description: This technique is the strongest genjutsu of Kogomei Nara. Using natural energy, with Yin and Yang chakra, she creates a miniature moon, then covers it in her Shadow Forest technique, causing it to emit not light, but darkness. This darkness ensnares anything it covers in a genjutsu. Unlike light, which can penetrate solid, non-transparent objects, this shadow-light, can penetrate all objects. The only dojutsu capable of breaking out of its effects are the Byakugan, because of the way it functions. Within the genjutsu, everything is viewed as a silhouette. Kogomei can attack from these silhouettes, as well as merge with them. She's a living genjutsu within the genjutsu itself, being unaffected by techniques. In this genjutsu, a dark moon rises in the west, and sets in the east, repetitively. The moon used to cast the genjutsu is absent, making the feat of breaking the genjutsu from within
All Seeing Darkness.title: All Seeing Darkness

The Allied Shinobi Forces Technique is focused on three primary goals; disrupt the opponents sensory abilities, restrain the Ten-Tails, and combat and remove Madara and Obito Uchiha from play. The first step would executed by the Kumo-nin, who would use Lightning Release: Lightning Illusion Flash of Lightning Pillar to temporarily blind the opponents and Storm Release: Laser Circus to create a cloud of dust. Next, Suna-nin would use their Wind Release: Air Current Wild Dance to manipulate the dust to further obscure the Uchiha's vision, while Aburame clan members and Kiri-nin would use their Insect Jamming Technique and Hiding in Mist Technique to impair their sensory skil
Allied Shinobi Forces Technique.title: Allied Shinobi Forces Technique

The Allied Shinobi Forces Technique is focused on three primary goals; disrupt the opponents’ sensory abilities, restrain the Ten-Tails’ movements, and combat and remove Madara and Obito Uchiha from play. Using Inoichi’s telepathic abilities, Shikaku was able to relay the formation to every member of the alliance at once. Amatsukami.description: Amatsukami (天津神, Amatsukami) is a Mangekyō Sharingan technique that doesn't require eye contact granted to the Mangekyō of Sigma Uchiha. It is said that this technique is the "Pathway of Peace" (,) the antipode to Amenotokotachi — a powerful , and Amaterasu — a powerful , both fellow Mangekyō techniques. The technique allows, Sigma, or any other inheritor of this technique, to create a place into their prey's life. Manipulating the mind into believing the caster was there in the past, or even allowing the caster to see the prey's techniques. This technique is to be fought against carefully. This technique grants the caster the ability to even see the prey's weakness of their technique. Respectively saying, if the opponent has never seen, or heard of this technique before, once this technique is cast, they will be able to manipulate the foe in order to get them to mentally spill out it's
Amatsukami.title: Amatsukami

Amatsumikaboshi.description: Acknowledged by Ryun Uchiha as the "most terrible corruption of Ninshū" (忍宗の戦慄汚職, Ninshū no Senritsu Oshoku), it is an ability developed by Seireitou Hyūga which serves as the foundation of his dark methods as a criminal lord that seeks to bring the Sengoku Rebirth to fruition. Ninshū is an art that connects hearts together and allows people to come to understand one another for the sake of creating peace. As the ultimate perversion of this religion, Seireitou utilizes a special method of Ninshū that essentially serves to connect with the negativity within the hearts of any living being within his range. Doing so allows him to freely manipulate those emotions by enhancing it, simply by feeding that darkness with his own darkness; his deep desire for a world of conflict. Normal individuals would easily succumb. As though they were hit with a strong Genjutsu, their minds immediately go cra
Amatsumikaboshi.title: Amatsumikaboshi

Ambience.description: is a special genjutsu used by Fukkatsu. Unlike most genjutsu, this illusion does not affect victims through sight or hearing, instead it affects them through smelling. By infusing their scent with chakra, the user can cast an illusion to whoever smells the scent. This is an advantage as it cannot be seen and one will only realize the illusion once they're caught. When in the illusion, the victims deepest desires appear, thus putting them into a euphoric state, then it is taken away from them. Their cravings and dreams are realized, then turn into a nightmare, then back into their desires. This is repeated multiple times to break a person's spirit. Additionally, Fukkatsu can manipulate their hormones through the scent to be addicted to something for the duration of the illusion, whether it is a physical object or sexual desire. Then she tortures them by placing it infront of them, but mak
Ambience.title: Ambience

Amenokoyane.description: The Amenokoyane is a visual technique employed by Densetsu. The last time this jutsu was even heard of was during the warring states period. The Genjutsu was a particularly fierce one because when cast, a victim would not be able to break out of it unless he knew of the jutsu, or saw it being cast. The realism of the technique was also renowned when used by Densetsu, as he could attack in such a way that it did not seem to be an illusion. The technique in itself is just a more complex utilisation of the generic Genjutsu afforded by the Sharingan. The technique is very similar in principle to Tsukuyomi, only it takes place in the actual world and is able to be broken easily, if it is spotted unlike the latter. This fact means that the opponent usually does not know he's under Genjutsu. The effects of the virtual attack also take a mental toll on the victim, making every second in real lif
Amenokoyane.title: Amenokoyane

Amenonaemasu.description: Amenonaemasu is a powerful Genjutsu technique of the Mangekyō Sharingan Dōjutsu and noted to be one of the most powerful Genjutsu in existence. It is accessed in Kama Uchiha's left eye and Heiwa Uchiha's right eye. This technique is noted by Kama to be of the highest Calibre, and is the counterpart of Amenowakahiko; a powerful genjutsu in its own right. Few have lived to tell the tale after having this Illusion casted at them. It's sheer power is feared all around the shinobi world after its usage from its progenitor; Heiwa Uchiha. The user instantly projects a powerful Illusion in the target's whereby the target is tormented by a fabricated memory of their past flaws and/or mistakes. This makes it versatile in a sense that even the purest of hearts will succumb to the illusion. The memories are fabricated by the user and the targets are made to think that the memories are real. Because

Amenonaemasu.title: Amenonaemasu

Amenowakahiko.description: Amenowakahiko is a powerful Genjutsu Dōjutsu utilized through Kama Uchiha's right Mangekyō Sharingan eye. The user projects an illusion at the target, which affects all senses. This illusion is set to look exactly like reality and, because the target's vision is affected, even those possessing Dōjutsu such as the Sharingan, Byakugan or even the Rinnegan cannot realize it. The special thing about the technique is that it can be cast using another person or object. For example; if the user were to focus eyes on a tree, anyone who looks at the tree would be trapped in the illusion. This makes the illusion versatile in a way that it could come up from anywhere and makes avoiding it is extremely difficult. The technique causes Kama's eye to irritate through prolonged use, and Kama cannot use it more than five times a day without experiencing irritation and pain. The name of this technique cam
Amenowakahiko.title: Amenowakahiko

Anaesthetic Technique.description: This unnamed anaesthetic technique demonstrated by Kuukoyo is a genjutsu that can make a person sleep soundly. It was used on Takatsuke Uzumaki to stop him from trying to fight Riyan Uchiha and his Tatsu while invading Konoha. Though, at the time she utilized this jutsu, Takatsuke was already unconcious. It is not known what effect this jutsu would have on a target completely awake and concious.

infobox.hand signs: Wave of hand over the target's face

Anaesthetic Technique.title: Anaesthetic Technique

Angelic Illusion: Tengoku.description: Angelic Illusion: Tengoku ( あんげぃｃ いっぅシオン： 天国, Angelic Illusion: Tengoku) is a the ultimate Genjutsu of the Angelic Illusion branch, a branch of genjutsu created by Coming Soon. Who taught it to Soru Kurama. Angelic Illusions corrupt a human's concept of Nirvana, or true enlightenment by invoking a false sense of materialistic satisfaction and creating an illusion of perfection. Each Angel Illusion fooling a different sense. Usually, the Angelic Illusion last just as long as it's darker counterpart. However, when utilized by one with [http://narutofanon.wikia.com/wiki/Kurama_Clan%27s_Kekkei_Genkai Kurama blood], the Illusion can go on for a lifetime. Putting it's victim into a coma. Only high caliber shinobi have the skill to disrupt such a powerful Genjutsu. There are various ways to activate Tengoku. And each utilizes a different sense. Angelic Illusion: Tengoku's differs between users.
Angelic Illusion: Tengoku.title: Angelic Illusion: Tengoku

Antithesis.description: Using his hand as a medium, Shintai is able to place a large number of people under a subtle genjutsu, and since his enter lower arm is being utilized as a medium, any kind of gesture such as pointing, a flick of a wrist or finger-snapping can trigger this; making it highly undetectable and greatly decreasing the chance of one avoiding it. Despite its flexibility and the number of people it can trap, it does not lose out on sheer potency. Though, Shintai has also displayed the ability to use it on certain individuals within a group by pointing at them. Once placed under it, it alters a subject's perception of good/evil, right/wrong and friend/enemy, causing them to often question and hesitate striking someone they know is an enemy or developing aggression and intolerance for their own friends. At its weakest, it is able to create rifts in teams and hamper their teamwork and strategy and
Antithesis.title: Antithesis

Arasushin.description: Arasushin (荒らす真, Arasushin; Literally meaning "to invade reality") is the power residing within the eyes of Shura Uchiha —the son of the infamous Sayuri Uchiha. It is a of the highest caliber; other illusionary techniques are said to dull in comparison. Shura refers to this technique as his "true power" and claims that no one who has ever experienced it has lived to tell the tale. The illusion works to disrupt the five basic senses all at once, making it appear as though a certain event is taking place, when in reality, Shura's opponent has been left immobilized. Unlike many other techniques derived from the Mangekyō Sharingan, Arasushin does not require eye contact to perpetrate the enemies defense. Instead, it attacks a certain radius around the user itself; effecting all of those within range, not unlike the . This itself is the techniques greatest flaw, as it fails to imprison those
Arasushin.title: Arasushin

Arudainai.description: Arudainai (在る堕以内 [アロディニア] Arudainai; Literally meaning "Degenerating into less than being") is the name coined by Makoto Suehiro for the form of combat that Yaeka Sakamori employs whenever she attempts to truthfully harm someone. A devastating combination of immaculate Taijutsu and Genjutsu, it is a fighting style that truthfully degenerates the opponent into nothing more than a shell of their former selves, all because of this form's sheer capability. Although named something else by Shōga, he, as a Genjutsu specialist, reached the same conclusion Yaeka had through his years of experimentation. *The name of this form was coined by Waterkai, therefore the coining by Makoto Suehiro was a tribute to him. The name actually takes inspiration from the term known as Allodynia, defined as "a pain due to a stimulus which does not normally provoke pain." Quite evidently, this parallels with the m
Arudainai.title: Arudainai

Ascending Buddha's Judgement.description: The Ascending Buddha is a technique long since forgotten by shinobi, a once feared initiator for one of the most powerful Genjutsu in existence. The user can begin the technique by summoning a huge statue which has laid hidden in Mount Myōboku for ages, bringing it into the battle. The user is required to siphon off a huge amount of chakra to bring the statue into existence, and an improper distribution of chakra will lead to the failure of the technique. Upon summoning the titanic construct, the user, perched atop the head of the statue, forms a series of hand signs which causes the entire statue to be enveloped in a blinding yellow light, signalling the first stage of the Genjutsu. This blinding light renders all who behold it (even from a distance) incapable of movement, as the powerful Genjutsu overloads their brains and rends them vegetative instantly. Simultaneously, a low chant is
Ascending Buddha's Judgement.title: Ascending Buddha's Judgement

Autumn Fall.description: The Autumn Fall (落葉飘零, Rakuyō Hyōrei) is a sleep inducing genjutsu and works similar to . The user caused large amount of leaves to fall down from the sky. Anyone who sees enough of these leaves fall, they will fall into a deep sleep. Because it's a genjutsu, victims cannot be woken in conventional ways, meaning they will continue to sleep even if extensive combat is going on around them. Only by dispelling the genjutsu, such as with the Genjutsu Cancel, can victims regain consciousness. If targets are attentive enough, they can similarly dispel the genjutsu themselves before the leaves have lulled them to sleep. __NOEDITSECTION__
Autumn Fall.title: Autumn Fall

Bad Mercy.description: Bad Mercy is Genjutsu crafted by Amena Shiranami to exploit her enemies’ emotional vulnerabilities. Amena uses this to apply her targets into a vivid illusion where they witness their own allies turning against them, begging for forgiveness as Amena’s silhouette looms over them with a sadistic grin. This Genjutsu is not physically damaging, but it induces intense guilt, confusion, and hesitation—perfect for disrupting enemy coordination or breaking morale mid-battle. Many targets freeze or falter, unable to distinguish illusion from reality. Amena uses this moment to reposition, strike, or interrogate. However, A sharp physical shock can break the illusion. Targets with enhanced sensory perception may resist or detect the illusion.
Bad Mercy.title: Bad Mercy

Banga.description: Banga is an extremely powerful genjutsu created by . When the users activates Banga the target is trapped in a dream like reality and a unique book/manga/novel materializes in front of the user. This book allows the user to observe and control the dream like reality by illustrating the panels and individual frames of the book. The user controls every aspect of the dream-like world, its characters and how they act, what they can and cannot do, the locations and characteristics of people as well as animals, and the events of the story as well as how it starts and ends. The target is completely at the users mercy, even if they're aware they are trapped in a fake dream-like world they cannot escape by any normal means, such as their chakra flow being altered by internal or external forces.

Banga.title: Banga

Barrier-Style Genjutsu.description: By performing the correct sequence of hand seals for precise chakra control, the user can perform a B-rank ninjutsu which combines barrier ninjutsu and genjutsu which creates a large circular barrier in which hides whatever hides within it from but can sense anything interacting and/or entering the barrier. The size of the barrier can range from ten to one hundred meters tall, and from three to two hundred meters around the user who is the anchor point for the technique which moves wherever the user is. It is effective against Sensor Types and even dōjutsu like the Byakugan from vast distances; however, within two hundred meters, the technique becomes less effective in hiding whatever is inside the barrier and the illusion will fail if the user moves since they are the constant epicenter of the technique. Because it is classified as a B-rank technique, it is also uses up vast amounts of

Benediction of Avidya.description: This genjutsu is a rare move that works on two folds reversing a genjutsu and also casting one. Its original design was to dispel genjutsu. For the first half the opponent must successfully capture Raido within a genjutsu. Regardless of the style whether it is auditory, or visual. Once this link is established, Raido closes his eyes in the form of a prayer. Once this happens a symbol appears on Raido's forehead and it glows a eerie blood red hue. This prayer, or genjutsu allows for Raido to link himself to not only his opponent as he can sense dukkha, but link himself and the caster to the . From here with the aid of Yama he can input his genjutsu over his opponents and cast the genjutsu via dukkha and Yama. This action exposes the caster to the mental deterioration and torment of the souls trapped in the Naraka Realm, sharing in their agony of their punishment. Whisking them away to a w
Benediction of Avidya.title: Benediction of Avidya

Benzaiten (Tsuna).description: is a technique which is seemingly derived from the very powerful , invented by Tsuna Uchiha. Banzaiten unlike Tsukuyomi doesn't require eye contact, but captures those within the vicinity. This technique allows Tsuna to open the route of his target(s) mind and manipulate their memory. Tsuna is capable of erasing memory, editing memory, or even "input" memories. By editing, Tsuna can make it appear as if something happened back then, when it really didn't. When inputting new memories, Tsuna usually implements things into his opponents life to make them believe it. In a battle, he once added a memory that he was there during the dying moment of the opponents family. Lastly, by erasing memories, he can completely remove them without a doubt, or fluke. (弁才天 or 弁財天) Also known as Benten, she is the goddess of everything that flows: words (and knowledge, by extension), speech, eloquence, and m
Benzaiten (Tsuna).title: Benzaiten (Tsuna)

Blade Concealed in Glamor.description: The user traps their target inside a genjutsu in which the user proceeds to use a kunai to deliver a swift slash while the opponent is fully immobilized.
Blade Concealed in Glamor.title: Blade Concealed in Glamor

Blade Regalia of Blood-stained Purity.description: Upon manifesting both Junketsu and Senketsu, Yoshida executes a sword technique that requires exactly 369 strikes to the body. To begin the attack, Yoshida activates his Eternal Mangekyō Sharingan and catches the opponent in Tsukuyomi. He then hits the opponent with Junketsu first and then Senketsu and alternates between before landing the last strike with both swords. While in Tsukuyomi, the opponent only experiences 1 strike in order to confuse the opponent while they receive the remaining 368.
Blade Regalia of Blood-stained Purity.title: Blade Regalia of Blood-stained Purity

Bladesong Technique.description: is a signature technique of Tōjirō Ryōgi, which utilizes the practitioner's blade as a medium for inflicting . The technique is activated by across the surface of a blade, which is then emitted into the surrounding environment as a high frequency pulse. While inaudible to the human ear, this signal ensnares victims in an illusion of the wielder's own desire. The complexity, form, and intensity of the genjutsu are dependent on both the practitioner's performance and mastery of this technique, allowing it to be utilized in a wide variety of scenarios. Tōjirō commonly uses this technique to misdirect his enemies or outright incapacitate lesser opponents. Due to the method this technique is performed, it is rare for it's activation to be noticed by even veteran shinobi, and the technique can be initiated even in the heat of combat. Furthermore, while Tōjirō normally targets specific individu
Bladesong Technique.title: Bladesong Technique

Blue Lotus Datura Seal.description: The Blue Lotus Datura Seal (青ロータス作用封印, Aorotasu Genkakusayōfūin) is a Genjutsu and Fūinjutsu created by Yua Shimura as a way to seal the Seven-Tails. The sealed entity, within it's vessel, is constantly being subdued rather than one exceptionally powerful seal keeping it dormant for long periods of time. The sealed Seven-Tails is constantly plagued with Genjutsu to specifically disorient, nauseate, and disrupt its own chakra. The Tailed Beast is, under the seal, barely coherent. This keeps the Tailed Beast almost unable to communicate entirely with its vessel, nor makes it able to consistently access the Tailed Beast's own chakra without some sort of rhythmic based subversion, as it requires less proper thinking from the subdued beast. However, it does in turn, prevent the Tailed Beast from gaining control over its .
Blue Lotus Datura Seal.title: Blue Lotus Datura Seal

Blue Lotus Style: Dance Of The Petals.description: Doujinn transports the victim to a mist covered lake, where they see him holding a blue lotus. Suddenly, the lotus splits and the petals spin around the victim. Doujinn then takes one of his blades and strikes with slow but elegant blows cloaked in Freezing Release chakra.
Blue Lotus Style: Dance Of The Petals.title: Blue Lotus Style: Dance Of The Petals

Brain Hypnosis: Inverted World.description: There are 2 ways Aoi Uchiha can do this technique. The first way is by eye contact with his Sharingan, Aoi uses this technique and centers it around the brain, then what this genjutsu does is close off all the points in the chakra pathway system that enter the brain. Then that's when the genjutsu takes effect, it messes up all 5 of your senses, everything is inverted, you have no sense of direction. Since this part of the technique is cast through eye contact, it can be broken by someone else easily. The second part of this technique is more advanced than the first, and is more stronger. By making contact with the opponent's head, Aoi funnels his chakra in the form of genjutsu into the person's head, then with a simple hand sign, the genjutsu starts. From then on, his chakra closes off the points in the chakra network that leads to the brain. It has the same effect, it messes up your 5 s
Brain Hypnosis: Inverted World.title: Brain Hypnosis: Inverted World

Bringer-of-Brightness Technique.description: The technique creates a very bright white light which blinds the eyesight of everyone except the user. The user can use this to gain the upper hand, or to make a hasty retreat, or to set up for a more complicated attack without fear of interruption. It's intensity even blinds the Sharingan and the Byakugan for its duration.
Bringer-of-Brightness Technique.title: Bringer-of-Brightness Technique

Bringer-of-Darkness Technique.description: {{JutsuInfobox |ref= |image=Bringer-of-Darkness Technique.png |named=Yes |kanji=黒暗行の術 |romaji=Kokuangyo no Jutsu |english tv=Genjutsu: Infinite Darkness Jutsu |other names= |other jutsu=Yes |derived jutsu= |jutsu rank=A |jutsu classification=Genjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary |jutsu range=Short, Mid |users= |hand signs=Tiger |debut manga= |debut anime= |novel debut=Naruto: A Shinobi Story |game debut= |jutsu media=Anime, Manga, Game, Movie }} The user places a hallucinatory darkness on a target's eyesight, causing them to see nothing but black; the sensation likened to being at the bottom of a deep hole. Because the target cannot see, they are very vulnerable to attack. Although this handicap is dangerous even to the likes of the Third Hokage, it is not insurmountable, as the Third is able to sense attacks to try to defend himself and smell his attackers in order to st
Bringer-of-Darkness Technique.title: Bringer-of-Darkness Technique

Bringer-of-Nature Technique.description: is a powerful genjutsu developed by Asuna Kurama during her time in the . This technique is primarily evoked in conjunction with Asuna's Phantom Projection Technique as she creates projections of the different nature transformations. Through this technique, it'll cause the target to believe they are suffering from the effect of the real thing even though it's simply an illusion. For instance, Asuna can project fire onto the target, which'll have no physical or mental effect on the target. By casting this technique along side it, the target will not only feel that they are being burned but also see the burns as well; an additional effect of the illusion. Due to the fact this technique is casted through her Kekkei Genkai, the brain falls victim to the illusion and reacts accordingly. If a target is severely burned the brain will begin an inflammatory response which could have an adverse ef
Bringer-of-Nature Technique.title: Bringer-of-Nature Technique

Brutal Mind Affect Technique.description: An advanced genjutsu utilized by the members of the Kurama Clan, by weaving the needed hand seals, the user can influence the sensation of their victim’s recently experienced pain. To be precise, they can manipulate where the pain has been felt and move the feeling to another area of the body. By pouring chakra into the cerebral nervous system, the user can redirect messages between the brain and pain receptors in the body, thus controlling exactly where the target feels pain in spite of the location of the actual physical trauma. Like its , this genjutsu can also manipulate the intensity of these signals. A paper cut to the finger can be relocated to mimic the sensation of being slashed through the eyes, pulling out a strand of hair can create the feeling of having one’s tooth ripped out, and something as simple as a tap to the finger could be made to feel like a stab to the heart. As t
Brutal Mind Affect Technique.title: Brutal Mind Affect Technique

Bubbled Existence.description: Using the palm of his hand as a medium, Shūrin casts a genjutsu. After directing their palm outwards towards his target, bubbles and foam start emerging from Shūrin's body. Before the target can notice, they are covered from the bottom up in a sea of froth as their head is encapsulated by a bubble with limited air inside. Inside this illusion, the opponent cannot seem to pop this bubble encasing their head, as the oxygen levels inside it rapidly decrease, the target tends to lose consciousness and falls asleep. The feeling of being asphyxiated is replicated inside this genjutsu. As an additional stage, Shūrin can also make it appear that they are being dragged downwards by what can be vaguely described as a frothy quick-sand, which causes them to struggle more and further spent the limited air inside the bubble, thus knocking them out quicker. * This technique is a metaphor for 'living i
Bubbled Existence.title: Bubbled Existence

Burning Blood.description: This technique, originally developed by Yokōkaze Fuyutama to be used as an interrogation method, allows the user to inflict a painful illusion upon their victim. Requiring Sharingan eye contact as an initiation this genjutsu will assault a target with a burning sensation throughout their cardiovascular system. The intensity of this pain can be altered by the user to the degree that lesser opponents may pass out from trauma, though it can stagger nearly anyone. As stated before Yokōkaze created this technique as a "harmless" torture method to be used to extract information when invading the target's mind would be difficult or impossible. When combined with a injection of saline, the victim is more likely to believe the sensation is a reality. While not usually utilized for combat, a variant of this technique can be used to make the victim visualize a wound they have already received burst
Burning Blood.title: Burning Blood

Cactus Genjutsu.description: Using a nearby ' pollen, the user places anyone who comes in contact with it under a strong genjutsu that is hardly noticeable due to the technique's inconspicuous execution. In this genjutsu, the victim has the impression to cross an area over and over again while in reality, it does not move at all. The technique can be countered by marking an area within the genjutsu, so that the never-ending circle can be noticed. Once noticed, the technique can be easily dispelled. * Sly Mind Affect Technique
Cactus Genjutsu.title: Cactus Genjutsu

Cat Genjutsu.description: The user puts the opponent in a genjutsu where the whole place changes inside the opponent's mind. A new scenery and skilled cats are created illusory and although it is not real, they can fight against the victim.

Cat Genjutsu.title: Cat Genjutsu

Chakra Ghost Technique.description: With , the user is able to cast a genjutsu involving the creation of silhouettes or illusory beings as a means of distraction. The entities are so realistic that they even have their own chakra pathway system, which can fool even the "all-seeing" Byakugan. Where a shadow is attacked, it automatically disappears like a ghost and then reappears. This technique can also become more effective when used in conjunction with Hiding in Mist Technique. *Wind Release: Sand Cloud Whirlwind

infobox.jutsu classification: Kekkei Genkai~Ranmaru's Kekkei Genkai, Dōjutsu, Genjutsu
infobox.users: Dei Chinoike, Bourei, Haruki Fūma~Manga, Ranmaru Clan~Novel

Chakra Ghost Technique.title: Chakra Ghost Technique

Chakra Pressure Genjutsu.description: Chakra Pressure Genjutsu is a technique used by Raido to take complete control of the opponent's bodies. To use he must, physically exert the force of his chakra. This technique is often used as a way of psychologically affecting one's opponent, as a strong chakra can cause great stress on a target, chakra can instill great fear into those that feel its presence, with this he can paralyze an opponent just by focusing pressure through their stare or presence. As they are stresses, instilled with fear and paralyze a shadowy figure of the user appears before them forcing them under a genjutsu. An image resembling a massive armored beast appears in front of the opponent and grasps them as it begins "assimilating" them into itself. This breaks the opponent's will. Afterwards, the opponent is left incapacitated. According, to Takumi this technique also have some traumatizing effects on the tar
