Chakra Pressure Genjutsu.title: Chakra Pressure Genjutsu

Chaotic Illusion: Demonic Touch.description: Demonic Touch is another 'physical' Genjutsu, which involves the user needing to touch the target(s). The Genjutsu makes it seem as if the user is lost within a hellish realm, and the mental pain they feel actually impacts the bodies internal organs. Skilled users are able to trap the target(s) in the Genjutsu until an outside source comes and assists.
Chaotic Illusion: Demonic Touch.title: Chaotic Illusion: Demonic Touch

Coercion Sharingan.description: {{JutsuInfobox |ref= |image=Coercion_sharingan.png |named=Yes |kanji=威圧写輪眼 |romaji=Iatsu Sharingan |literal english=Coercion Copy Wheel Eye |other jutsu=Yes |parent jutsu=Genjutsu: Sharingan |jutsu classification=, Dōjutsu, Genjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Offensive |jutsu range=Short |users= |debut manga= |debut anime= |game debut= |jutsu media=Anime, Manga, Game }} With a single glance of the Sharingan, this technique forces a nightmarish genjutsu on the victim, overpowering them and bringing them to their knees. Even the usually emotionless Sai was deeply affected by this genjutsu. As for Ryuuki, the potent and fearsome nature of tailed beast chakra allowed him to perform this technique with a lot more power than most Uchiha. He was once able to bring an entire army of shinobi to their knees all at once with ease when they all looked at his eyes. He is also able to add his Kill
Coercion Sharingan.title: Coercion Sharingan

Crimson Leaf Dream.description: Kurenai attacks her opponent with a triple combo attack dealing an elbow strike and two kicks before fading into a mist in front of the opponent and then appearing again behind them in a pink mist and striking them with a kunai in the back which then sends the opponent into the air.
Crimson Leaf Dream.title: Crimson Leaf Dream

Curse Technique: Jashin's Alter.description: This technique is a Curse Technique, and is limited to the worshippers of Jashin within the Jashin Cult. This Jutsu is a Curse Technique unique to Zuie, limiting it to her alone. By using the approiate hand-seals, Zuie will cast the genjutsu. The Genjutsu is fiendish, as it replays itself in different manners; but ending in the same end result, doing so a total of seven times in a row. It places the enemy in a body; their chained to wall; barbed spikes will gouge through their chest and ribs, along with the limbs and throat; allowing only gurgled screams and few words. Before them... lies the love or chosen best-friend of the foe on a sacrifical alter; that of Jashin's type. Corpses lie all around the alter... and Cultists appear everywhere. The victim will scream before the foe's eyes, but the spikes being barbed prevent sliding off the spikes to help stop the event. The Cultists will g
Curse Technique: Jashin's Alter.title: Curse Technique: Jashin's Alter

Curse of Hatred.description: Curse of Hatred is a powerful genjutsu that is casted on the user. When used they lose their sense of humanity and go berserk. The user's presence becomes so ominous and evil that even a tailed beast can be unnerved by it. Their physical strength and healing rate both increase drastically, allowing them to deal out devastating attacks while shrugging off horrific injuries. With each strike landed in the enemy hated from the use is forced into the opponent's body. Causing them to be corrupted by the users hatred. [http://naruto.wikia.com/wiki/Curse_of_Hatred Curse of Hatred] on Narutopedia.
Curse of Hatred.title: Curse of Hatred

Cute Ladies in the Cloud.description: Cute Ladies in the Clouds is a Genjutsu technique created by Kazuhiko Kajimoto. This technique was created to tease Kentarō. He ended making this a primary technique when he is in trouble The Genjutsu seals the target in a mental world where he ends up in a hot spring with a bunch of attractive ladies. Perverts typically fall victim to this technique trapping them in this Genjutsu for a long time if they don't realize if it's a Genjutsu. It only works on people that are attracted to females.
Cute Ladies in the Cloud.title: Cute Ladies in the Cloud

Dance of the Fallen Leaves.description: is a technique developed by Koyone Takamori, which simultaneously employs the practitioner's and prowess. The technique is activated when the user is seemingly struck by an attack. Upon contact with the assault the individual bursts into countless leaves along with an incredibly bright flash of light. Additionally, if the blinding burst of light wasn't enough to force the opponent off their guard, the illusory leaves produced by the explosion furiously swirl around the target continuously impairing both their sight and hearing. Taking advantage of the target's distraction, the user then swiftly delivers a critical sword strike to the opponent. While this technique is far less covert than most of Koyone's other genjutsu, the speed it is performed compensates for the lack of subtlety. This is to say mere seconds that the technique is active the user would have to quell their natural respon
Dance of the Fallen Leaves.title: Dance of the Fallen Leaves

Dance of the Moonless Sky.description: is a technique which combines the user's and prowess. Unlike most genjutsu, which ensnare victims through sight or sound, the illusory effect of this technique is activated when the victim's body or equipped items come into physical contact with the practitioner's sword. Upon contact the victim is effectively blinded, albeit extremely temporarily. Unlike this blindness only lasts for a single second once contact between the two parties is broken. While seemingly insignificant, due to its brief duration, losing a second of sight in a heated close range fight could very well be equal to death. Furthermore, each clash the practitioner makes with opponents will result in the aforementioned momentary blindness, which could quickly crush an opponent's morale. Since this illusion is only active for an incredibly short window of time, and it coincides perfectly with the clash of the combatants'
Dance of the Moonless Sky.title: Dance of the Moonless Sky

Dance of the Powdered Snow.description: is a simple, yet potentially overwhelming, technique that employs the practitioner's and abilities simultaneously. Unlike many genjutsu, which utilize sight or sound as a medium to entrap their opponent, this technique instead initiates its effects when the user's blade comes into contact with either the victim themselves or their equipped items. Upon activation an aspect of one of the target's senses is distorted ever so slightly, to the degree that a novice combatant wouldn't be hindered by its effect and even a veteran would be hard pressed to notice the mental impact. While useless on its own this technique's true purpose is to amplify the selected sensory distortion through multiple applications of this weak technique in succession. In addition to slowly crippling the opponent's perception, which can easily cause the technique's illusory nature to be overlooked, the effects of Dance
Dance of the Powdered Snow.title: Dance of the Powdered Snow

Dance of the Rising Sun.description: is a simple technique that combines a rudimentary level and proficiency in order to disorient and disrupt opponents. This is accomplished by simultaneously engaging an opponent with a precise barrage of sword strikes and generating unexpectedly bright flashes of illusory light. Unlike standard genjutsu practices, which are focused on ensnaring opponents for extensive periods of time, this technique effectiveness is capitalized on immediately. Drawing an opponent into their illusion after they've laid their eyes upon the practitioner's blade, the illusionist is able to activate a sudden blinding light that engulfs the area on command. Effectively robbing the individual of their vision for a moment the user is able to land strikes with increased efficiency. Even if the technique's illusory component is openly revealed the genjutsu can be reapplied each time the target makes eye contact wit
Dance of the Rising Sun.title: Dance of the Rising Sun

Dark Hazard.description: The user makes a single glance at the target, the target finds them in a dark room with the greatest fear. In order to end the genjutsu, the target can either stab themselves or commit suicide.

infobox.users: Mategai Ryou, Shiroitsuchi Ryou, Mochi Uzumaki, Mubi Ryou, Obito Ryou, Nise

Dark Hazard.title: Dark Hazard

Dark Night in the Rainy Season.description: *Name: *Type: A-rank, Offensive, Short to Mid-range (0-10m) *User(s): Aiko Saru *Hand Seals: Half Tiger *Debut: None The target is put under the illusion of being in a pitch black room while rain slowly fills up the room. Plays on the fears of drowning, inevitable death, and slow death.
Dark Night in the Rainy Season.title: Dark Night in the Rainy Season

Dark Release: Eye of the Moon.description: Usable only during the night, when the moon is present, Kaasage uses chakra stored by his Inhaling Maw to create an orb of black energy that resembles a star in his palm. Kaasage throws the orb into the sky where it appears to consume the moon. If the target watches this event then they will find themselves locked in a Genjutsu that dulls their senses and surrounds them in a world of inky black nothingness. The only way the target can break free of this technique is to cause a deep enough pain that their dulled pain receptors can feel it, or by disrupting their flow of chakra.
Dark Release: Eye of the Moon.title: Dark Release: Eye of the Moon

Daze.description: Daze is Juro Uchiha's own Genjutsu, and one of his signature techniques. Unlike most Genjutsu, Daze is unique in a key manner—it works upon touch. Any form of contact the user makes on another opponent puts the opponent in a powerful Genjutsu. Daze is praised as one of the most creative Genjutsu ever created by several shinobi who have watched Juro's utilisation if the technique. The versatility of this technique is its most prized asset. It can be transferred by means of a punch, or a mere touch. The only condition is that the user's skin must make contact with the opponent. Juro also is capable of outting an enemy in this Genjutsu by means of blocking their taijutsu attacks. Since he was naturally not very skilled at Taijutsu, Juro used this technique frequently to end taijutsu battles at the very beginning. The illusion cast by the Genjutsu is a realistic one where the environment tur
Daze.title: Daze

Death Circus.description: A lethal genjutsu that often comes by surprise to those who have never seen it. The genjutsu power is mostly from the element of surprise. Unlike most genjutsu that sffect the visual and auditory senses, this genjutsu focuses on capturing all five of the human senses. Giving the feel of a Carnival based theme which can be molded by the will of the user. The genjutsu's ability to display varying attractions based on circus lore often make the idea of discovering the genjutsu quite difficult. So far as witnessed by the those trapped there have been three aspects to the genjutsu all of which can result in severe damage to the brain, and result in cardiac arrest and later death. Within these dreamworld Dōkeshi is truly at his most powerful, allowing him to use his abilities in the genjutsu to fluctuate and blur reality, and take multiple forms within these dreams. He can even steal the power
Death Circus.title: Death Circus

Demonic Curse: Mindsweeping Destruction.description: This is a very powerful genjutsu, known as one of the most powerful non-Sharingan genjutsu in the world. This technique is one of Otoshi Nagare's signature techniques and makes him very well known as a deadly opponent. This technique was used on Saphiro Kimza to make him unable to learn Kimza Clan jutsu at a young age and is a major plot device. After forming the needed hand signals, the user draws a triangular symbol in their palm with their blood and then touches the target with any portion of their hand. This enables them to view a long list of memories the user knows of. Then, using their chakra and a special mental seal, the user can lock away these memories or even destroy them, forcing the user to either remember it after a long while, or never know it again. This technique can also erase any jutsu the target has learned, as well as erasing the training process, forcing even the m

infobox.hand signs: Tiger, Dog, Horse, Monkey, Rat, Ox, Tiger, Dragon, Ox, Boar, Tiger, Bird, Monkey, Hare, Horse, Tiger, Hare.

Demonic Curse: Mindsweeping Destruction.title: Demonic Curse: Mindsweeping Destruction

Demonic Flute: Banshee Call.description: The user places a target under a genjutsu using their Demonic Flute that involves the victim being subjected to high pitch screeches. The target will feel as if their eardrums are bursting.
Demonic Flute: Banshee Call.title: Demonic Flute: Banshee Call

Demonic Flute: Phantom Sound Chains.description: {{JutsuInfobox |ref= |image=Mateki - Mugen Onsa.png |named=Yes |kanji=魔笛・夢幻音鎖 |romaji=Mateki: Mugen Onsa |english tv=Demon Flute: Chains of Fantasia |viz manga=Musical Genjutsu: Chains of Fantasia |jutsu rank=B |jutsu classification=Genjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary |jutsu range=Short, Mid, Long |users= |debut manga= |debut anime= |game debut= |jutsu media=Anime, Manga, Game, Movie }} This is a genjutsu that relies on the sound of a flute. Given that the means of transmission is sound-based, it has a large range of effectiveness, on top of which it can be applied even without knowledge of the enemy's position, which makes for an exceedingly convenient technique. However, the sound can be blown away by powerful Wind Release techniques, effectively negating the activation of the genjutsu. Whoever hears this technique will be assailed by the vivid sensation that they bec
Demonic Flute: Phantom Sound Chains.title: Demonic Flute: Phantom Sound Chains

Demonic Flute: Voices of Deception.description: Using the Demonic Flute, the user casts a genjutsu on a target, which makes the victim hear sounds, voices or whispers based on the user's choice. This can be used to distract, confuse or psychologically torture the target.
Demonic Flute: Voices of Deception.title: Demonic Flute: Voices of Deception

Demonic Illusion.description: could refer to any of the following genjutsu: * Demonic Illusion: Cajolery of Glamour * Demonic Illusion: Descending Hell Technique, or Demon Illusion: Fire Jutsu. * Demonic Illusion: Double False Surroundings Technique, or Genjutsu: Double Optic Delusory. * Demonic Illusion: False Surroundings Technique, or Genjutsu: Optic Delusory. * Demonic Illusion: Flower Mist, or Demon Illusion: Flower Haze, used in video games. * Demonic Illusion: Flying Shadow, used in video games. * Demonic Illusion: Hell Viewing Technique, or Demonic Illusion: Death Mirage Jutsu. * Demonic Illusion: Mirage Crow, or Demon Illusion: Mirage Raven. * Demonic Illusion: Mirror Heaven and Earth Change * Demonic Illusion: Nail Paralysis, used in video games. * Demonic Illusion: Shackling Stakes Technique * Demonic Illusion: Steaming Multistoried Building, also Mirage Genjutsu, Giant Clam Mirage, and Giant Clam: Mirage.
Demonic Illusion.title: Demonic Illusion

Demonic Illusion: A Conjured Tale.description: Initially, Kemuri creates a large amount of thick smoke chakra that can cover an area. Once the stage has been set, she begins her illusion, creating a tale that is tailored to the target, one that penetrates the walls they have created in their mind. This technique plays upon the subtlety of the senses, as the user creates shapes that move within the smoke, appearing then disappearing, only to come closer to the target before blending in with the smoke once more. Put simply, she wreaks havoc on the opponents, using the smoke as a medium to recreate their fears, the plight of loved ones, conjuring up the beings from the very smoke she uses. Thus the target becomes a portion of the tale that she weaves. The longer the user remains within the genjutsu, the more strained their physiological health becomes. It becomes a cycle, while the available smoke becomes available resource for follow u
Demonic Illusion: A Conjured Tale.title: Demonic Illusion: A Conjured Tale

Demonic Illusion: A Desire for Drink.description: Making the hand seals for the illusion, Zaikyou submerges the opponent into a desert like area with a touch of the hand. Activating his scorch release and putting it on his "low" setting, he presses his hands against the opponent, letting his scorch evaporate just about all of the water in the opponent's body, leaving him/her severely dehydrated when they wake up out of the genjutsu, though most of the water will have been replenished by time or have not been lost in the first place.
Demonic Illusion: A Desire for Drink.title: Demonic Illusion: A Desire for Drink

Demonic Illusion: A Hundred Demons Wande.description: Inojin fixates himself onto a single target, putting them under a genjutsu, in which Inojin draws 100 quadrupedal beasts of different shapes and sizes. Upon contact with the opponent, the creatures splatter, covering their target with a heavy and sticky ink-like substance. After a while, a large slough of ink opens up beneath the opponent's feet and the ink-like liquid on their body pushes them towards the ground, creating a very realistic drowning scenario. * The name for this technique was borrowed from one of Sai's techniques from the Ultimate Ninja Heroes games.
Demonic Illusion: A Hundred Demons Wande.title: Demonic Illusion: A Hundred Demons Wandering at Night

Demonic Illusion: Alternating-Current Wi.description: After performing the required hand seals, this genjutsu seizes command of the target's sense of perception. Once trapped in the genjutsu the target's attacks seemingly bend around the user almost as if refusing to connect with their intended victim. Additionally, the user can freely distort the surroundings making it appear as though they were manipulating the surroundings in order to avoid confrontation or attack. It is a powerful illusionary ability, as it remains in effect even after the target realizes they are within genjutsu, requiring an outside force to break the target from the illusion. * Oshikiri notes that this genjutsu is the specialty of the Anbu division, the Special Investigative Task Force. * An "alternating-current winding" machine is a type of turbine.
Demonic Illusion: Alternating-Current Wi.title: Demonic Illusion: Alternating-Current Winding

Demonic Illusion: Ascending World Techni.description: Once the jutsu is cast, the illusion traps the target in a world entirely submerged in water. The target then struggles to breathe but is unable to do so and upon seeing the surface, tries to swims toward it, but is pulled back down by an unseen force that keeps on dragging the target deeper and deeper into the submerged world until the target drowns and is completely unconscious due to the lack of air to breathe, this jutsu seems to cause the target in the real world to go unconscious as well.
Demonic Illusion: Ascending World Techni.title: Demonic Illusion: Ascending World Technique

Demonic Illusion: Banquet Technique.description: The Demonic Illusion: Banquet Technique is an ocular reality-bending Genjutsu that requires the Sharingan Kekkei Genkai. Neira creates an illusionary world where the target is entrapped and faced with potent illusions that fools all senses, causing victims to experience fake scenarios so accurately that it creates "perfect physics" for the target, allowing it to trick even, highly skilled combatants. When targets made direct eye contact with Neira’s sharingan, they are put into the illusionary world. Two spectral, geisha-like figures float above in circles, pouring sake into a large jar. The haunting sound of the liquid hitting the jar is the catalyst for the technique, causing intoxicating hallucinations to emerge within banquet’s victims as they see the world around them and themselves dissolving. Banquets intoxicating effects can affect multiple targets at once.
Demonic Illusion: Banquet Technique.title: Demonic Illusion: Banquet Technique

Demonic Illusion: Barrier of Moonlit Nig.description: Demonic Illusion: Barrier of Moonlit Night (魔幻・月夜結界, Magen: Tsukiyo Kekkai) is the Mangekyō Sharingan technique awakened within the left Mangekyō of Nasuka Uchiha. This technique is literally barrier genjutsu. First, Nasuka either flashes her left eye or weaves the Tiger, Phoenix signs. A black barrier appears at the focal point of her vision. From here, she could make the barrier take on three properties. The first property is to trap anyone within the boundaries of the barrier in the genjutsu world of Tsukuyomi. Unlike normal Tsukuyomi, her barrier variant can affect more than one person at the same time since it is a setting-type instead of her having to stare into the eyes of an adversary. She could mark a specific area with her Mangekyō Sharingan and provide chakra to delay the formation of the barrier until someone walks onto or near the "tripwire", triggering the trap. The second
Demonic Illusion: Barrier of Moonlit Nig.title: Demonic Illusion: Barrier of Moonlit Night

Demonic Illusion: Basilisk's Nest.description: It is a powerful murasaki sharingan illusion that uses the essence of Yin to enclose the victim in a basilisk nest-like cosmic, the victim is eaten by a serpent that plays with the target in its lair, it not only dies in the illusion, but also really dies. This technique can be strengthened by using it with a rinegan when the user benefits from this option, his illusion will be almost real.
Demonic Illusion: Basilisk's Nest.title: Demonic Illusion: Basilisk's Nest

Demonic Illusion: Beast.description: Using their Kyōgan, the user appear to turn himself into a giant monster that devours the target pulling them into a world of darkness.
Demonic Illusion: Beast.title: Demonic Illusion: Beast

Demonic Illusion: Beast Tamer Technique.description: Demonic Illusion: Beast Tamer Technique (魔幻・猛獣使いの術, Magen: Mōjūdukai no Jutsu) is a well-known Genjutsu. Its purpose is to restrain the target in its place using pain. Once the hand seals are performed, the technique will take place. If the target moves an inch, they would be electrified with an illusionary electric shock for exactly five seconds. This technique can be broken by normal means, the challenge is to tolerate the pain caused by the technique. Most would remain still in order to avoid the electric shock as it is very painful. The pain should prevent the target from even attempting to break the technique and from moving at all.

infobox.hand signs: Tiger → Snake → Rat → Snake → Tiger → Ram

Demonic Illusion: Beast Tamer Technique.title: Demonic Illusion: Beast Tamer Technique

Demonic Illusion: Bell Cricket Technique.description: The Demonic Illusion: Bell Cricket Technique is a genjutsu created by Kirie. It projects a high-pitched tone over a wide area, overloading the hearing of anyone in range and knocking them unconscious.
Demonic Illusion: Bell Cricket Technique.title: Demonic Illusion: Bell Cricket Technique

Demonic Illusion: Black Hole.description: This technique uses the Ketsuryūgan to subject an opponent in a genjutsu where they will witness a appear above them and believe that they are being sucked in.
Demonic Illusion: Black Hole.title: Demonic Illusion: Black Hole

Demonic Illusion: Black Nirvana.description: * Name: Demonic Illusion: Black Nirvana (Magen: Kuro Nehan) literally "Genjutsu: Black Nirvana" * Type: A-Rank, Supplementary * Range: - * Classification: Genjutsu * Handseals: None. Activated when the opponent looks at Seijun's feathers. * Users: Seijun Togiretogire Seijun loses several feathers when he flaps his wings, when he is in his second state of the Lunar Cursed Seal. If his opponent looks at a feather, they begin to feel the same effects as Kabuto's Nirvana Temple; they will fall into a deep sleep if they do not release the Genjutsu within 60 seconds.
Demonic Illusion: Black Nirvana.title: Demonic Illusion: Black Nirvana

Demonic Illusion: Bloody Dream.description: After you perform the hand seals, the illusion may take effect against your opponent or not because the opponent may not look at you. If the opponent did happen to look at you, the illusion takes effect and brings your opponent to the illusion. The effects of your opponent are seeing the aggressive alternate, weird natural disaster, and the opponent’s vision is reddish or bloody filled with gore.

infobox.users: Hoshiko Uchiha, Daichi Kurama,Haru Hyūga,Naoki Nara, Kenjiro,Yumi Uchiha, Ishiki Sanagi, Nozomi Uchiha, Sakiko Uchiha,

Demonic Illusion: Bloody Dream.title: Demonic Illusion: Bloody Dream

Demonic Illusion: Bloody Hands.description: This jutsu gives the victim a nightmare of them standing over their dead loved ones with their blood on their hands. The image is shaky and resembles a dream with a high pitch scream in the background. This jutsu is hard to get out of once your in it due to the fact it changes your chakra fluctuation so stopping your chakra flow is useless. The way to remove yourself is to calm yourself down and allow the jutsu's abstract nature to become clear, it is then easily broken. As easy as this sounds in actuality it is quite difficult due to vividness and horror this genjutsu causes. Time in this genjutsu also runs slower so by the time you awaken your opponent is probably close enough to kill you or has sealed you and taken you prisoner.
Demonic Illusion: Bloody Hands.title: Demonic Illusion: Bloody Hands

Demonic Illusion: Butterfly Dream.description: A that is not used solitary but rather to augment or sustain an already-existing one, developed by Shisui Uchiha. When the victim of said pre-existent illusion remarks he is in fact under the effects of one, he will attempt to break it. Depending on the skill level and determination of the opponent and the complexity of the genjutsu, this may or may not succeed. When the user notices there is a very likely chance of his opponent breaking free from the genjutsu, he may infiltrate his opponent's mind within the already-existing genjutsu. The influence of the is needed to not disturb the workings of the original technique. After having done this, the user creates the illusion of the previous genjutsu having been broken, giving the victim a false sense of security, making them even more susceptible to the original illusion. Should the opponent still see through the user's tactics, this techn
Demonic Illusion: Butterfly Dream.title: Demonic Illusion: Butterfly Dream

Demonic Illusion: Cajolery of Glamour.description: {{JutsuInfobox |named=Yes |image=Sai Trapped.png |kanji=魔幻・蠱惑の甘言 |romaji=Magen: Kowaku no Kangen |literal english=Demonic Illusion: Cajolery of Glamour |game names=Evil Illusion: Enhancing Flattery |other jutsu=Yes |derived jutsu= |jutsu classification=Genjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary |jutsu range=Short, Mid |users= |debut anime= |novel debut= |game debut= |jutsu media=Anime, Manga, Novel, Game }} Demonic Illusion: Cajolery of Glamour is a speech-induced genjutsu. It allows the user to put their opponent under an illusion using only words and speech. By infusing chakra into the tongue of the user, any target within auditory range of the user will become easily swayed in a post-hypnotic trance of their will and self-assurance; forcing them to face their innermost trauma as realized by the user's words in an effort to mentally break their spirit. Once told to look behi
Demonic Illusion: Cajolery of Glamour.title: Demonic Illusion: Cajolery of Glamour

Demonic Illusion: Casting Emotions.description: is a that alters the target's emotions. Upon weaving the appropriate hand-signs, the illusion takes effect. Through , the user is able to channel false emotions into the target's subconscious which allow the user to manipulate how the target reacts to certain stimuli. The illusion remains active until either the caster releases it or the target dispels it; allowing the user to manipulate the target multiple times without forming the hand-signs again. *Asuna primarily uses this technique on herself in order to properly express emotions.
Demonic Illusion: Casting Emotions.title: Demonic Illusion: Casting Emotions

Demonic Illusion: Cerberus.description: A genjutsu that causes the target to see a large demonic hell hound, the hell hound will then give chase to the target and will not stop until the target has been captured. One the demonic hound gets a hold of its target, it will then proceed to tear the victim limb from limb, causing the victim to scream out in pain and horror. The user can apparently show the victim more than one hell hound , which makes the jutsu even more dangerous and the pain felt by the victim when they are being tore apart is intensified due to the increased number of hellhounds. This jutsu requires quite a bit of chakra and cannot be used more than two or three times at most. A hellhound is a demonic dog of Hell, found in mythology or in fiction. Hellhounds typically have features such as an unnaturally large size, a black fur color, glowing eyes, super strength or speed, ghostly or phantom characteristics, and
Demonic Illusion: Cerberus.title: Demonic Illusion: Cerberus

Demonic Illusion: Cold Embrace.description: A powerful genjutsu created by Kamu Shinsen, it has the ability to confound even the most skilled shinobi. Kamu uses this genjutsu in two situations: if the opponent is with a team or if he is alone. If he is with a team, he separates the members of the team and casts the genjutsu on his target. The victim will see one of his teammates injured so, if he rushes to his aid and touches him, the teammate will turn into a Water Release spear that will pierce the target's heart. If the opponent is alone, the genjutsu will illustrate an innocent, such as an old man or a wounded child. The illustrated person looks so real, that will fool even the greatest shinobi. The genjutsu can be broken if the victim is fast enough to dodge the water spear, though it is extremely difficult. Also, he doesn't stop and touch the person, it's absolutely ineffective.
Demonic Illusion: Cold Embrace.title: Demonic Illusion: Cold Embrace

Demonic Illusion: Crawling Transfusion.description: The genjutsu can be performed by eye contact alone. The main use of this genjutsu is to have the target believe their blood has been replaced with ravening maggots. This jutsu possesses a substantial number of self-inflicted wounds by the target, as the "maggots" can follow the blood stream through the body and appear anywhere.While under the genjutsu, the target believes themselves grazed by an enemy or friendly shuriken.Many possibilities can be utilized given the user's method of choice. The target can be led to believe that maggots are filling up their lungs, causing the brain to think their lungs are full and unable to draw fresh air while they throw up imaginary maggots. While in another case the maggots could swarm the individuals' brains, leading that victim to draw a kunai (in real time) and proceed to stab themselves to stop the infestation.
Demonic Illusion: Crawling Transfusion.title: Demonic Illusion: Crawling Transfusion

Demonic Illusion: Crimson Demon Divinati.description: The Demonic Illusion: Crimson Demon Divination Mirage (魔幻: 紅邪鬼魔法 蜃気楼, "Magen: Kujakumahō Shinkirō") is a powerful multipurpose medical genjutsu that fools the body into attacking itself, essentially producing within them an [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Autoimmune_disease autoimmune disease]. It is characteristically dangerous because those trapped in it are fully aware of their doom and yet are unable to unravel themselves. Medical ninjutsu can be either Yin Release or Yang Release; only one person has successfully merged the two, producing Yin-Yang Release medical techniques. Like any genjutsu, this one controls the chakra in one's central and peripheral nervous systems; but there is a catch: medical genjutsu effects chakra on the cellular level down to the smallest of cells, not just the system itself. This one even targets the immune system. The ability to control the complex buildi

infobox.jutsu classification: Genjutsu, Medical Ninjutsu, Medical Genjutsu (II), Kinjutsu,

Demonic Illusion: Crimson Demon Divinati.title: Demonic Illusion: Crimson Demon Divination Mirage

Demonic Illusion: Crimson Labyrinth.description: Demonic Illusion: Crimson Labyrinth (悪魔のイリュージョン：クリムゾンの迷宮 Labyrinth of Crimson: Illusion of Devil) is perhaps one of Soru's most infamous techniques. As well as one of his most flexible as well. Using it for a multitude of purposes, it's one of the only illusions in existence that can last for months in reality while appearing to be eternity in the victims mind. Soru developed this technique at a young age, and perfected it during the Chuunin exams. He used it on the young Akimichi and forced him into a coma. A fate many count as lucky. It works by adding a bit of the users chakra into several parts of the brain. Each part responsible for controlling one of the five senses. These signals create the absolute illusion of a gigantic maze rising from the ground. His Maze consist primarily of pitch black marble and strange symbols throughout. What makes his jutsu unique is it's ability to chan

infobox.parent jutsu: Demonic Illusion: Deadly Reflections,  Seventh Day!

Demonic Illusion: Crimson Labyrinth.title: Demonic Illusion: Crimson Labyrinth

Demonic Illusion: Dark Charade.description: This causes the victim, or victims, to hallucinate dark shapes moving in the corner of their sight, which will promptly disappear when focused on. By doing so the practitioner is able to break an opponent's concentration at the task at hand, weakening them at the same time. Furthermore, if this technique is used to a greater degree, and under the right conditions, it can even inspire fear as the target begins to witnesses multiple shadows lucking in their peripheral vision, that never appear to be there.
Demonic Illusion: Dark Charade.title: Demonic Illusion: Dark Charade

Demonic Illusion: Delusions of Grandeur.description: Although Raido hates genjutsu, this particular one is among his most deadly. When used by an opponent it allows them to believe they have more chakra and than they naturally do which can lead to fatigue on the target as they are led in a false sense of security. The real danger of this genjutsu is when it is used to conjuncture with a genjutsu. Once Raido is caught under a genjutsu, this jutsu real abilities become lethal as it allows Raido to make a connection with the person controlling the flow of his chakra, this jutsu allows him to build a connection and once this jutsu activate the user of the genjutsu the user will be taken to a realm of nothing but Sharingan all staring at him as this appears in the mind. The damage tthat would have been inflicted on Raido is then transferred back to the user giving them severe mental damage depending on the level of genjutsu. The higher rank the
Demonic Illusion: Delusions of Grandeur.title: Demonic Illusion: Delusions of Grandeur

Demonic Illusion: Depth Haze.description: Demonic Illusion: Depth Haze (魔幻・かすみ, Magen: Kasumi) is a simple utilized by those of the Kurama Clan. Upon casting the technique, the user manipulates the target's . The technique was designed to be used in conjunction with other techniques and fighting styles. Varying from user to user, it is often seen in conjunction with and . However, in recent years, many have been gifted enough to perform the technique with , and sometimes even .
Demonic Illusion: Depth Haze.title: Demonic Illusion: Depth Haze

Demonic Illusion: Descending Hell Techni.description: {{JutsuInfobox |image=Demonic_Illusion_Descending_Hell_Technique.png |named=Yes |kanji=魔幻・地獄降下の術 |romaji=Magen: Jigoku Kōka no Jutsu |english tv=Demon Illusion: Fire Jutsu |game names=Demon Illusion: Hellfire Jutsu |jutsu classification=Genjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu range=Mid |jutsu class type=Supplementary |users= |hand signs= |debut anime= |jutsu media=Anime, Manga }} This technique causes the illusion of a tremendous ball of fire falling from the sky into a designated area. The targets involved in the illusion literally feel the ball's hot temperature getting closer. * The hand seals used for this technique are the same as those used for the basic Summoning Technique.
Demonic Illusion: Descending Hell Techni.title: Demonic Illusion: Descending Hell Technique

Demonic Illusion: Dirge of The Exiled.description: Demonic Illusion: Dirge of The Exiled is a collaborative technique created by the Gleeful Twins as a way to mentally subdue their opponents in a powerful, double genjutsu. First, Tsukai casts Demonic Illusion: Descending Hell Technique, creating a massive fireball in the sky. To prevent the target from trying to escape, Tsuji casts Demonic Illusion: False Surroundings Technique, creating chains out of nowhere that clasp on to the target's legs, preventing them from escaping. As their escape proves futile, the fireball drops down on them, ending the genjutsu. This technique is capable of tearing away at even the most proficient genjutsu defenses, thanks in part to two genjutsu techniques being cast in unison.

infobox.hand signs: Tiger, Rabbit, Horse, Ram In Unision
infobox.parent jutsu: Demonic Illusion: Descending Hell Technique, Demonic Illusion: False Surroundings Technique

Demonic Illusion: Dirge of The Exiled.title: Demonic Illusion: Dirge of The Exiled

Demonic Illusion: Doppler effect.description: A unique and perplexing jutsu Raido discovered and created in his battle with Kohana Uzumaki While battling her, he learned that you can recalibrate the auditory sense of the human ears by readjusting the amount of decibels they receive and reflect if back and disrupt the flow of sound. By charging chakra in both of his hands, he can clap them together and it sends a sound in every direction once you hear this clap the perception of sound changes. The closer the object is the farther away the sound will appear to the ear and the farther away the object is the louder it will appear, this causes mass hysteria and makes the target paranoid as they wont be able to rely on the hearing sense as it has been disabled. Though it appears one can still use the eyes, it can also be paired in conjunction with other genjutsu as well. When used in conjuncture with the Bringer of Darkness Technique this
Demonic Illusion: Doppler effect.title: Demonic Illusion: Doppler effect

Demonic Illusion: Double False Surroundi.description: {{JutsuInfobox |image=Double False Surrondings.PNG |named=Yes |kanji=魔幻・二此処非の術 |romaji=Magen: Nijū Kokoni Arazu no Jutsu |english tv=Genjutsu: Double Optic Delusory |other jutsu=Yes |parent jutsu=Demonic Illusion: False Surroundings Technique |jutsu classification=Genjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary |users= |debut anime= |novel debut=Naruto: A Shinobi Story |jutsu media=Anime, Novel }} This technique places another illusion within another illusion created by the user. If and when the target dispels the first illusion, they will not realize that a second is in place.
Demonic Illusion: Double False Surroundi.title: Demonic Illusion: Double False Surroundings Technique

Demonic Illusion: Doublespeak Incense.description: Utilizing his special smoke bombs that contains extracts of the blue hallucinogenic flower as a medium, Shintai can simply put his target(s) under this subtle but effective genjutsu. After catching a whiff of the chakra-laced hallucinogen, the victim is unable to detect Shintai with all of their senses, including their ability to detect chakra, while they are slowly filled with memories of guilt and regret. As more time passes, one is pushed farther and farther into a state filled with self-pity, anger and regret, which disables them emotionally as a shinobi. This combined with the psychological trick of them believing that Shintai is truly invisible puts a toll on their mind and often leads to them giving up. Shintai is known for using this as an ANBU while preparing to capture a high-value target, as other lethal methods could lead to failure of the mission. Even after moving from the
Demonic Illusion: Doublespeak Incense.title: Demonic Illusion: Doublespeak Incense

Demonic Illusion: Dream Eater Technique.description: {{JutsuInfobox |named=Yes |image=Dream Eating Technique.png |literal english=Dream Eater Technique |english tv=Dream Eater Jutsu |viz manga=Dream Feasting Jutsu |game names=Dream Eater Jutsu |other names=Banquet of Spirits |jutsu rank=A |jutsu classification=Ninjutsu, Genjutsu, Kinjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Offensive, Supplementary |jutsu range=Short, Mid, Long |users= |hand signs= |jutsu media=Anime, Manga, Game, Movie }} The Dream Eater Technique is a ninjutsu technique that allows the user to increase the power of a pre-existing genjutsu. The Dream Eater Technique is a ninjutsu technique that is used with genjutsu techniques. It can only be used if the target is already in a Genjutsu. It allows the yin energy that is creating the genjutsu the victim is currently in to feast on the target's mental and spiritual energy to weaken their defenses against genjutsu, increasing the
Demonic Illusion: Dream Eater Technique.title: Demonic Illusion: Dream Eater Technique

Demonic Illusion: Dream Mist.description: One of the most powerful genjutsu, the user dispels a colorful mist with a loud noise that covers up a huge area. Once the mist is affects any of the target's five senses (seeing, feeling, smelling, hearing, tasting it), the target is then taken to a place where their wildest dreams are chilled. With that distraction, the user is able to torture the target. Maomi Hōzuki uses this technique by combining them with her Hydrification Technique. Tsuki Uchiha makes the mist stronger by using her fan to expand the range and speed of the mist.

infobox.users: Meio Yuki, Maomi Hōzuki, Tsuki Uchiha

Demonic Illusion: Dream Mist.title: Demonic Illusion: Dream Mist

Demonic Illusion: Drowning.description: A simple genjutsu that can give someone the impression he is drowning. Even if he is fighting for his life and swims towards the surface, it looks to him like his is getting farther from the surface.
Demonic Illusion: Drowning.title: Demonic Illusion: Drowning

Demonic Illusion: Drowning in Smoke.description: Using her ability to create smoke, Kemuri makes a light, almost insubstantial smoke that is almost undetectable. By mixing it into the air that the opponent breathes, the genjutsu packed smoke can find its way into the opponent's body. When the genjutsu starts, the opponent(s) finds themselves in the exact same place that they were prior to the genjutsu's activation. Then slowly but surely, smoke starts to appear around, thickening until the opponent's view is obscured. As the smoke builds, it starts to enter the opponent's nostrils and mouth as they continue to breathe, before starting to enter their ears. Further along, the smoke starts to congregate around the opponent before forcing its way in, suffocating them from the inside out, and displacing the oxygen and nitrogen in their bloodstream. This is considered to be a very brutal technique as the opponent wakes up afterwards in a col
Demonic Illusion: Drowning in Smoke.title: Demonic Illusion: Drowning in Smoke

Demonic Illusion: Earth-Shaking Hand.description: This illusion is a rather simple, but highly effective paralysis-type illusion. While rarely given a name, Yaeka has done so for her own entertainment. By making physical contact with an individual, such as through a handshake, the individual's chakra network is able to be controlled with much more ease for a single moment. In that moment, the user is capable of paralyzing the individual through the said illusion. While only lasting temporarily, it can lead to the development of fear within the individual, something which may be exploited through psychological warfare.
Demonic Illusion: Earth-Shaking Hand.title: Demonic Illusion: Earth-Shaking Hand

Demonic Illusion: Eight Scattering Rains.description: This is a powerful illusion that can put a target inside a dream-like limbo for an extended period of time, while completely suppressing his chakra.
Demonic Illusion: Eight Scattering Rains.title: Demonic Illusion: Eight Scattering Rains

Demonic Illusion: Emotions Manipulation.description: Demonic Illusion: Emotions Manipulation (魔幻・感情手捌き, Magen: Kanjoutesabaki) is a vigorous Genjutsu well-known in Kirigakure, yet it has its fair share of users scattered around the shinobi world. This technique was feared during the second shinobi war. It's a technique that affects the subconscious of the target making it hard to overcome if the target does not realize he's being manipulated. Despite its strength, it only applies basic use of Yin Release and Genjutsu. This technique applies primary use of Genjutsu. The user simply weaves the required hand seals in order to cast a Genjutsu upon his opponent and lock them in a series of false illusions. Simply, the user starts to channel false phrases and ideas into the subconscious of the target through Yin Release energy. These distorted messages allows the user to manipulate the opponents emotions or affect them strongly at least. The use
Demonic Illusion: Emotions Manipulation.title: Demonic Illusion: Emotions Manipulation

Demonic Illusion: Endless Torments.description: Demonic Illusion: Endless Torments The user is able to cast a very strong illusion, which in terms of strength and difficulty of recovering from this technique is equal to tsukuyomi. A person who is drawn into this illusion for a quarter of an hour is constantly tortured, this technique is great for interrogation or tormenting.
Demonic Illusion: Endless Torments.title: Demonic Illusion: Endless Torments

Demonic Illusion: Eternal Hell.description: Demonic Illusion: Eternal Hell is the most powerful genjutsu in Kuukoyo's arsenal. Compared to most of her other genjutsu, Eternal Hell is different because it remains unbroken as long as Kuukoyo decides to keep it up or the victim manages to gather enough willpower to break through the illusion. Demonic Illusion: Eternal Hell is capable of retching the victim's perception of the world in any ways; however, the illusion always will change the victims perception so that he or she will see the world as his or her worst nightmare. This includes making the victim see his or her loved ones dead etc. If not broken, the effects of this genjutsu get increasingly worse, until the world has become a living hell for the victim. The main weakness of this jutsu is that it can only be casted once on one person; if that person manages to break the genjutsu once, Eternal Hell cannot be casted on him or
Demonic Illusion: Eternal Hell.title: Demonic Illusion: Eternal Hell

Demonic Illusion: Eternal Slumber.description: Douko activates his Sharingan and covers his sword in a special chakra. He begins to slice around his opponent, creating pockets of chakra. As it begins to turn into total darkness, the pockets of chakra turn black and open into eyes, showing a Sharingan. The victim becomes shocked, and passes out.

infobox.jutsu classification: Kekkei Genkai~Sharingan, Genjutsu, Dojutsu, Kenjutsu, Chakra Flow

Demonic Illusion: Eternal Slumber.title: Demonic Illusion: Eternal Slumber

Demonic Illusion: Ethereal Body Imperial.description: The Demonic Illusion: Ethereal Body Imperial Sending is a boundary-dismantling technique developed by Princess Minabe.[citation needed] Upon kneading the chakra necessary to activate the technique, the user weaves a Seal of Confrontation and removes the boundaries between reality and illusion within their personal space. To a degree, this allows the user to control their own state of existence.[citation needed] For the duration this technique is active, any negative events that occur to one's body is rendered null and void, granting the user a sort of pseudo-immortality. Sustained injuries merely fade like mist[citation needed] while fatal injuries simply disperse the body for it to reform elsewhere.[citation needed] Even with her powerful chakra inherited from her , Princess Minabe can only keep the technique active for ten minutes[citation needed] with her descendants ranging from anyw
Demonic Illusion: Ethereal Body Imperial.title: Demonic Illusion: Ethereal Body Imperial Sending

Demonic Illusion: False Armament.description: ---- The False Armament technique is a simple, yet useful, genjutsu in which the user creates the illusion that they (or someone else) are armed with a weapon when they, in fact, are not. This technique comes in handy when trying to maintain one's status as a threat: An armed opponent isn't one that can be attacked carelessly. It helps to act as a deterrent to those who would otherwise attack the user. ---- Users who employ this technique are not limited to simply manifesting generic swords and weapons. The user can create weapons (and even objects) of their own imagination and design. This means that the user can pretend to have a legendary sword they don't have, can pretend to have a scroll they don't have, etc. Additionally, this technique can be used to fool others into thinking the user has attacked an killed someone else. For instance, because a sword created through this jutsu is
Demonic Illusion: False Armament.title: Demonic Illusion: False Armament

Demonic Illusion: False Being Technique.description: {{JutsuInfobox |named=Yes |image=|image=Demonic Illusion False Being Technique.jpg |kanji=魔幻・居る非ずの術 |romaji=Magen: Oruazaru no Jutsu |literal english=Demonic Illusion: False Being Technique |english tv=Genjutsu: Sensory Delusory |other jutsu=Yes |related jutsu= |jutsu classification=Genjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary |jutsu range=Short, Mid |users= |jutsu media=Anime, Manga, Movie }} The Demonic Illusion: False Being Technique (魔幻・居る非ずの術, Magen: Oruazaru no Jutsu) is a Genjutsu that gives deception to an individual's actual position in their surroundings. This is done through interrupting the flow of chakra within the individual's brain as to the actual position of the user. In this regard, the user can be a significant distance away from the illusion, and the illusion can still be active. Of course, at this point, the control over the illusion would be very sloppy and
Demonic Illusion: False Being Technique.title: Demonic Illusion: False Being Technique

Demonic Illusion: False Surroundings Tec.description: {{JutsuInfobox |ref= |tabber2=Yes |image1=False Surrondings 1.png |caption1=Those affected perceiving to be on the 3rd floor... |image2=False Surroundings 2.png |caption2=...but this a merely an illusion... |image3=False Surrondings 3.png |caption3=...as they are actually on the 2nd floor. |named=Yes |kanji=魔幻・此処非の術 |romaji=Magen: Kokoni Arazu no Jutsu |english tv=Genjutsu: Optic Delusory |game names=Evil Illusion: Misleading Jutsu |other jutsu=Yes |derived jutsu= |jutsu rank=C |jutsu classification=Genjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary |jutsu range=Short, Mid, Long |users= |debut manga= |debut anime= |game debut= |jutsu media=Anime, Manga, Game }} This is a genjutsu that allows the user to trick others into mistaking the place they're in for another. This technique's main feature is that it can be cast over an extensive surface, therefore any and all who step into the il
Demonic Illusion: False Surroundings Tec.title: Demonic Illusion: False Surroundings Technique

Demonic Illusion: Fear Incarnated.description: A unique technique indeed. Soru's, Demonic Illusoin: Fear Incarnated is one that uses the targets own mind. Soru begins by casting an illusion that releases a special chemical in his targets brain. The chemical causes fear within the human body. This level of fear causes his target to see what they fear the most come to life. However, Soru's Demonic Illusion: Fear Incarnated holds a special property. Because the fear is so real within the subconscious, conscious awareness and foolish ambition will not suffice in stopping the fear. Soru can use this technique to invoke heart attacks, force the body into a fight of flight stage, or even drive someone insane.
Demonic Illusion: Fear Incarnated.title: Demonic Illusion: Fear Incarnated

Demonic Illusion: Feigning Sleep Techniq.description: Shikadai fixates himself onto a single target, putting them under a genjutsu, in which the opponent experiences a very realistic feeling of sleep deprivation. There are two ways to execute this technique: #Shikadai continuously increases the sleeping sensation the opponent feels, making them fall asleep. #Shikadai induces rapid sleep deprivation symptoms, forcing the opponent to experience such after-effects like hallucinations and lack of concentration. * This technique was named after one of Gaara's techniques. While Gaara's technique induces sleep onto the user, this technique induces sleep onto the opponent.
Demonic Illusion: Feigning Sleep Techniq.title: Demonic Illusion: Feigning Sleep Technique

Demonic Illusion: Five Senses Manipulati.description: It is a Genjutsu created to affect the senses of the target, or their sensitivity. For instance, the user can manipulate the five senses of the target which are Sight, Hearing, Touch, Taste, Smell. The user can affect those by increasing or decreasing their sensitivity, for example, the user can decrease the sight to the point where the Target is blind, or increase its sensitivity to the point where the smallest flash would feel like you're looking directly at the sun. The user can decrease the sensitivity of the hearing of the target to the point where he is deaf or increase it to the point where the slightest sound may cause him great torture as he would hear it very loudly. The user can also increase the sensitivity of touch to the point where it increases pain, making a small scratch feel like someone cut his arm off. Or decrease the sensitivity of touch causing numbness in the body

infobox.users: Ikari Uzumaki, Yūzuki, Junsui,Yuugetsu,Hideyoshi Nara, Kyousuke, Sakura Kurama, Ruka Yamanaka

Demonic Illusion: Five Senses Manipulati.title: Demonic Illusion: Five Senses Manipulation

Demonic Illusion: Flower Mist.description: Kurenai traps the opponent in a flower bud and detonates it in a flowery explosion.
Demonic Illusion: Flower Mist.title: Demonic Illusion: Flower Mist

Demonic Illusion: Flower Seen in the Mir.description: This genjutsu reflects the victim’s perspective of the world, making the victim perceive the world as if the victim is an image in a mirror. Thus everything the victim perceives is inverted front to back. For the victim, every action around them is perceived by them in a backward manner, retracing the path traveled to get from point A to point B.
Demonic Illusion: Flower Seen in the Mir.title: Demonic Illusion: Flower Seen in the Mirror

Demonic Illusion: Flurry of the Flame.description: ---- Demonic Illusion: Flurry of the Flame is a genjutsu in which the user conjures a magnificent flurry of beautiful flower petals that float around the surrounding area. The (oftentimes red) flower petals are burning as they drift through the air; their embers light up each flower petal, as they dissolve into nothingness. If these flowers touch the victim, they burn them slightly. This technique is good for distraction; the petals distract the eyes and the tiny amounts of pain received from the petals can also distract the victim, if only for a moment. The flowers can also come in the form of actual flower petal-shaped bodies of flames, rather than flower petals that are being burned away. These flame petals hurt a bit more if touched by them and are brighter. However, they provide much less initial confusion and shock. They are also easier to see and notice, given their bright nature,
Demonic Illusion: Flurry of the Flame.title: Demonic Illusion: Flurry of the Flame

Demonic Illusion: Flying Shadow.description: Kurenai casts the opponent under her genjutsu, making the opponent confused. Asuma then strikes them with his Flying Swallow, knocking the opponent out.

Demonic Illusion: Focus Distortion.description: This , requiring eye contact, slowly robs the victim of their ability to visually focus on the surrounding environment, effectively disrupting their ability to properly react to their opponents. This technique initially manifests itself as a slight blurriness around moving objects, that eventually escalates to the inability to focus on any object. As the effect is not instantaneous, are more likely to believe the effects of the illusion as reality. Due to the perceived visual blur, victims of this technique often demonstrate decreased accuracy and reaction time, which can put an individual at a significant disadvantage. Saisei Uchiha has shown significant proficiency in this technique, ensnaring multiple foes with this technique before dispatching them.
Demonic Illusion: Focus Distortion.title: Demonic Illusion: Focus Distortion

Demonic Illusion: Forced Servitude.description: A genjutsu that was developed by Miyuki Murakami, who taught it to various members of her clan. It allows the user to manipulate a person against their will. After the hand seals are formed, the user performs whatever action they please. Miyuki typically used this technique to force captives to follow her, but she had other, more novel uses for it as well. As with all genjutsu, it is augmented by the Ketsugan when active, making it quite difficult to escape.
Demonic Illusion: Forced Servitude.title: Demonic Illusion: Forced Servitude

Demonic Illusion: Forest Pillow Techniqu.description: Unique to the members of the Hanazoe Clan, this technique gives the user the ability to call upon the roots of a big tree from the surface below. The roots release strong, toxic spores, which envelop the target, causing them to fall into a deep sleep. While the target's asleep, the spores start infecting their immune system. An extended period of time passed in this genjutsu can lead to muscle atonia and hallucinations.
Demonic Illusion: Forest Pillow Techniqu.title: Demonic Illusion: Forest Pillow Technique

Demonic Illusion: Four Corner Sealing.description: This is a powerful genjutsu that Aichi Goron created to overcome the weakness in her Sharingan. This allows her to copy almost any elemental technique, genjutsu, or taijutsu she wants to. After encountering a certain jutsu and weaving the needed hand signals, the user places themselves and their target under an illusion that they are replaying the last events of their fight. The target's body is slowed down severely, allowing the user to memorize the hand signs, chakra level,and/or actions needed for the technique. After the technique can be viewed and memorized, the user seals it into their eye, and then further into their memory banks for quick access. All the while, less than a second has passed. Both the user and the target are relieved from the genjutsu and the battle continues. The user can review an entire battle from this technique to learn many jutsu and make adjustments to thei
Demonic Illusion: Four Corner Sealing.title: Demonic Illusion: Four Corner Sealing

Demonic Illusion: Fox's Wedding Techniqu.description: Contrary to its name, this particular illusion of the Demonic Illusion series is utilized to impale the victim with numerous illusory blades that cause a paralysis effect to be induced onto them. It begins with a simple snake hand seal, which will have no immediate effects; however, a gradual flow of clouds will come over the area where Reitsura and her victim lie. At a sudden point in time, raindrops begin to form, which will eventually become piercing blades that leave the enemy helplessly exposed. However, the length of the Genjutsu makes it difficult to use practically unless you have an ally with you. *While the direct translation, "Fox's Wedding", was used for the purposes of this article, Kitsune no Yomeiri can also refer to a "rain shower while the sun shines."

Demonic Illusion: Fox's Wedding Techniqu.title: Demonic Illusion: Fox's Wedding Technique

Demonic Illusion: Garden of The Emperor.description: ---- Demonic Illusion: Garden of The Emperor is a genjutsu in which the user conjures a magnificent wisteria tree in full bloom; surrounding wisteria trees are conjured and mimic the wondrous environment of a beautiful, royal garden. The flowers hanging from the tree branches sway gently in a soothing breeze, encouraging victims to observe their beauty, allowing themselves to become distracted, although this is not an effect of the genjutsu itself, rather human nature; it can be avoided. However, from the victim's peripheral vision, the swaying wisteria flowers can seem like potential incoming attacks, as their eyes are distracted by the flowers' movements. Thus, users who use bladed weapons (such as the naginata), and are delivering a series of rapid and confusing strikes, can benefit from this genjutsu, as their opponent will think that they are being attacked from more angles than the
Demonic Illusion: Garden of The Emperor.title: Demonic Illusion: Garden of The Emperor

Demonic Illusion: Garden of the Underwor.description: The is the name given for the generic agricultural genjutsu of the . Rather than a single technique, they are instead a set of illusions carefully passed down through the generations since the Clan's founding.
Demonic Illusion: Garden of the Underwor.title: Demonic Illusion: Garden of the Underworld

Demonic Illusion: Gaze of Terror.description: Demonic Illusion: Gaze of Terror (魔幻・恐怖の凝視, Magen: Kyōfu no Gyōshi) is a unique Genjutsu, utilized by Yūzuki in order to intimidate or paralyze her opponents. The mechanics of the Genjutsu are rather simple, yet effective. It's a Genjutsu that cannot be utilized by many people. It's only used by those with extremely potent killing intent. The Genjutsu is employed by mere eye contact with the target. As soon as eye contact is established, a connection between the user Yin and the target Yin is formed. The user then transfers their killing intent to the target, which would cause them to drown into a sea of terror, without even seeing any illusions. They would feel as if death was right by them as if an invisible presence is coming at them. This would often lead the target to extreme fright and sometimes temporary paralysis. They would feel as if a monster is slowly shocking them, yet they
Demonic Illusion: Gaze of Terror.title: Demonic Illusion: Gaze of Terror

Demonic Illusion: Glitching Out.description: is a technique invented by Kenja Anjerika the former Third Queen (三番皇后, Sanban kōgō, Lit Meaning: Third Empress) during her reign. This technique won her many battles and won great respect from her enemies and allies. A unique technique created by the third queen of yukishiogakure has been described very powerful genjutsu that has been considered to valuable to lose even with the third queen's body missing after her expedition to the bloody lilies country, many believe kenja destroyed her own body to keep hidden secrets from enemies she made in the past. Its a unique genjutsu created as a means for the user to trick their opponent by creating a illusion of the scenerio going on now and make the opponent believe they are actually there when really isn't, the opposed "caster" would taunt, evade and counter the enemies attacks till the enemy strikes down the caster only to result in them gl

Demonic Illusion: Glitching Out.title: Demonic Illusion: Glitching Out

Demonic Illusion: Great Stasis.description: When preformed, the user will trap the target in a barrier, once in the barrier the genjutsu starts. The target's subconscious will be sent into the genjutsu while the target's body will be a barrier that soon solidifies into a crystal sphere where the body will levitate. Inside the genjutsu world, the target(s) are surrounded from all sides by four Shinigami, with their mind and body completely sealed between their hands in an illusionary cube of water. Once the user gives the order the Shinigami will place the kanji for stasis on every side of the cube. Once this is done, the target mind will be trapped in the water cube for life. When the jutsu is a success, the target body in the physical world will be destroyed by a strange force.
Demonic Illusion: Great Stasis.title: Demonic Illusion: Great Stasis

Demonic Illusion: Guilty Penance Stare.description: This technique forces the target to feel excruciating pain for anything they feel guilty about while under its effects. The intensity of the pain the pain they experience is directly proportional to the level of guilt the target feel, thus the more guilty the target feels, the more intense the pain. Even though this technique causes no physical damage to the body, it can rendering whoever falls victim to it defenseless. If the target has no guilt, this technique has not effect.
Demonic Illusion: Guilty Penance Stare.title: Demonic Illusion: Guilty Penance Stare

Demonic Illusion: Hang in the Balance.description: is a that disrupts the target's sense of balance. Basic in nature, upon weaving the proper hand-seals, the user must touch the target to induce the illusion. Once completed, the user gains full reign over the target's sense of balance or .
Demonic Illusion: Hang in the Balance.title: Demonic Illusion: Hang in the Balance

Demonic Illusion: Harvester of Sorrow.description: This genjutsu requires the use of the Sharingan and is one of the most powerful genjutsu currently in Ryoji’s possession. This technique is best used after Ryoji has trapped an opponent inside their own mind by using his Mangekyo technique Brahma. Once the victim is brought to the desolate illusionary world, Ryoji himself will then enter the targets mind, once there he will activate the jutsu, this causes the entire illusionary world inside the opponents mind to change, the sky becomes pitch black with a full moon in the background, the atmosphere becomes much more darker and colder, leaving the victim in a sense of despair. While the victim looks on Ryoji himself will begin to change, he first starts melting and some sort of black liquid starts pouring out of his body, once Ryoji completely disappears the liquid then reforms it self changing into some sort of phantom like creature with
Demonic Illusion: Harvester of Sorrow.title: Demonic Illusion: Harvester of Sorrow

Demonic Illusion: Heart of the Cards.description: Demonic Illusion: Heart of the Cards (魔幻・カードの心臓部; Magen: Kādo no shinzō-bu) is a unique genjutsu developed by Jushiro Kurama in order to enhance his own card manipulation. During his time in the Hōzuki Castle, Jushiro was given a deck of cards to entertain himself throughout his life-sentence. Throughout his sentence, Jushiro became quite skilled in manipulating these cards; doing nifty tricks. Eventually Jushiro realized he could use these cards in battle, very similar to how a magician uses his own deck to entertain a crowd. But Shinobi are very skilled beings in which basic deception will usually not be enough. Because of this, Jushiro invented this basic genjutsu. Using this technique, Jushiro is able to use illusions to deceive his opponents. Very similar to a magician, Jushiro will trick his opponents into believing what it is not there or vice versa. Many times when it appears he
Demonic Illusion: Heart of the Cards.title: Demonic Illusion: Heart of the Cards

Demonic Illusion: Heavenly Fog.description: A that creates a large volume of a smoke like fog which encompasses a ten meter area with the user at its center, the area becomes a black spot to sensors outside the area and to sensors inside who attempt to sense it creates a kaleidoscope effect due to the yin chakra being spread through out the area. The user is able to manipulate the five senses of those trapped inside the technique to a varying degree which depends on the number of targets as well as the users mastery of the technique, because the technique is created using the users body as a catalyst for producing the fog it is impossible to break the illusion unless they find a way to disrupt the users internal chakra flow. The only known downside to the technique is that every change in the targets senses costs the same amount of chakra as reactivating the technique. Ruka being the creator of the technique boasts the highest deg
Demonic Illusion: Heavenly Fog.title: Demonic Illusion: Heavenly Fog

Demonic Illusion: Heavenly Mirage.description: An advanced version of the Clone Technique, and a jutsu which combines ninjutsu with genjutsu. When a target gets target, the victim will begin to see mirages of clones. Its ability to create clone capable of performing real damage without expending additional chakra serves as the main benefit of the jutsu. Ebisu uses this technique extensively for confusing multiple opponents and gain control of the fight, using this jutsu as a step in a multi-step strategy which makes him not only formidable but powerful as he conserves his chakra and prolonging or ending combat with minimal effort. Soru Kurama can use these clones as distractions or tools to confuse. Usually, the mirages disappear after a single hit; however, when combining it with his kekkei genkai, these mirages have the ability to inflict physical harm. This technique can be used on objects as well, making copies appear. Either the
Demonic Illusion: Heavenly Mirage.title: Demonic Illusion: Heavenly Mirage

Demonic Illusion: Hell Sensing Technique.description: {{JutsuInfobox |image=Sensory_Overload.png |named=Yes |literal english=Demonic Illusion: Hell Sensing Technique |english tv=Sensory Overloading Jutsu |viz manga=Demonic Illusion: Hell Sensing Jutsu |game names=Demonic Illusion: Hell Sensing Jutsu |other names=Demonic Illusion: Price of Power |jutsu rank=B |jutsu classification=Genjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Offensive |jutsu range=Short, Mid |hand signs= |users= |jutsu media=Anime, Manga, Game, Novel, Movie }} Demonic Illusion: Hell Sensing Technique is a genjutsu that uses all the victim's senses against them, which includes their physical senses and any extra senses they may have like the ability to sense chakra. The enemies in the area perceive the discharge of yin energy as blinding light that blankets
Demonic Illusion: Hell Sensing Technique.title: Demonic Illusion: Hell Sensing Technique

Demonic Illusion: Hell Viewing Technique.description: {{JutsuInfobox |ref= |image=Hell Viewing Technique.png |named=Yes |kanji=魔幻・奈落見の術 |romaji=Magen: Narakumi no Jutsu |english tv=Demonic Illusion: Death Mirage Jutsu |game names=Evil Illusion: Death Mirage Jutsu |jutsu rank=D |jutsu classification=Genjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary |jutsu range=Short |users= |hand signs= |debut manga= |debut anime= |novel debut= |movie debut= |game debut= |jutsu media=Anime, Manga, Novel, Game, Movie }} This technique subjects targets to visions of their greatest fear, regardless of whether or not they are aware that they are afraid of it.
