Demonic Illusion: Hell Viewing Technique.title: Demonic Illusion: Hell Viewing Technique

Demonic Illusion: Helpless Maiden Techni.description: ---- The Demonic Illusion: Helpless Maiden Technique is a genjutsu in which the user conjures a "damsel in distress" scenario. Upon becoming caught in the user's genjutsu, the victim will see (or sometimes only hear) a woman who has landed herself in trouble. The illusory woman, usually the user themselves (unless the user prefers to depict someone else), is typically found bound and gagged (or in some predicament) by the victim. The victim can touch, feel, see, and hear the "helpless maiden". Additionally, the illusory damsel can also move, speak, and act as any normal person would. ---- Context is very important when using this technique, and its usually considered an "out-of-combat" technique. If one is to initiate combat, this technique should usually be performed beforehand. This technique is very good at distracting and catching an opponent off-guard. Technically, one could rig a r
Demonic Illusion: Helpless Maiden Techni.title: Demonic Illusion: Helpless Maiden Technique

Demonic Illusion: Hidden Past.description: Murakumo Kurama uses the Kekkei Genkai of his family lineage to cast a genjutsu on to his opponents. Unlike the genjutus cast by the Sharingan, Murakumo does not need direct eye contact to cast this jutsu, and because of his Kurama Clan lineage allows the genjutsu to phsysically hurt those under its effects. Murakumo Kurama has named it the ability to "rewrite history", and mentioned it to be one of the most powerful Genjutsu within his arsenal. Once the Genjutsu has been cast, Murakumo Kurama is freely able to manipulating his opponents mind into believing whatever he chooses. Because of the capabilities granted by the Kurama Clan's Kekkei Genkai, scars or visual defects can be applied to add further believability. Murakumo Kurama was first shown using it doing the liberation of Tonika Village, making Kabuto Yakushi believe his invasion was sucessful with Murakumo Kurama himself being c
Demonic Illusion: Hidden Past.title: Demonic Illusion: Hidden Past

Demonic Illusion: Hundred Samurai.description: Murakumo Kurama uses the Kekkei Genkai of his family lineage to cast a genjutsu on to his opponents. Unlike the genjutus cast by the Sharingan, Murakumo does not need direct eye contact to cast this jutsu, and because of his Kurama Clan lineage allows the genjutsu to phsysically hurt those under its effects. The foundation of this jutsu revolves around the creation of silhouettes or illusory beings that resemble that of a hundred samurai, hence the name. The entities are so realistic that they even have their own chakra pathway system, which can fool even the "all-seeing" Byakugan. When one of these entities is attacked, it vanishes like a ghost and then reappears.
Demonic Illusion: Hundred Samurai.title: Demonic Illusion: Hundred Samurai

Demonic Illusion: Hypnotic Whisper.description: Demonic Illusion: Hypnotic Whisper allows the user to manipulate targets through spoken words. By infusing chakra into their tongue, the user places anyone within hearing range under a subtle Genjutsu, inducing a hypnotic trance that leaves them highly susceptible to suggestion and control. *[https://keepyourpantsongohan.tumblr.com/post/170439568877/timeline-of-naruto-universe Timeline of Naruto Universe] *Anime-edited image source credits to: [https://photopea.com/ Photopea,] [https://naruto.fandom.com/ Narutopedia], [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Masashi_Kishimoto Masashi Kishimoto], & [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Osamu_Kobayashi_(illustrator) Osamu Kobayashi]
Demonic Illusion: Hypnotic Whisper.title: Demonic Illusion: Hypnotic Whisper

Demonic Illusion: Immortal Chain Torture.description: After forming the needed hand signal, the user stares into the target's eyes. This sends them into the world where they are suspended in a deep, dark pit, held up by black chains attached with large barbed hooks. At the user's will, the pit begins to spread out, and as a result, pulls onto the hooks piercing the target's flesh, tearing their skin, muscles, bones, and even whole limbs apart. The pit continues to expand until the target is torn into many pieces in an explosion of blood and fall into the pit. The genjutsu usually ends there, but it can be taken further where the target can be painfully repaired and penetrated by the hooks again, starting the cycle over. At the end of this genjutsu, the target suffers immense mental and psychological damage.
Demonic Illusion: Immortal Chain Torture.title: Demonic Illusion: Immortal Chain Torture

Demonic Illusion: Infinitesimal Controll.description: The Demonic Illusion: Infinitesimal Controlling Awareness is a Mangekyō Sharingan technique awakened within the right Mangekyō of Nasuka Uchiha. Tying in with her other Mangekyō Sharingan technique, Demonic Illusion: Barrier of Moonlit Night, this is also barrier genjutsu. In order to activate this technique, Nasuka either flashes her right Mangekyō Sharingan or weaves the Tiger, Phoenix signs. An invisible silver barrier appears at the focal point of her vision. This barrier only has one property. It entraps anyone within it with the genjutsu Kotoamatsukami. It also entraps anyone who walks into the barrier from outside. The perks of this barrier include the ability to freely control those within the barrier without the victims' knowledge. The second perk is the fact the genjutsu is still in effect even if the barrier was dismantled. However, the genjutsu wears off after fifteen minutes
Demonic Illusion: Infinitesimal Controll.title: Demonic Illusion: Infinitesimal Controlling Awareness

Demonic Illusion: Insect Pit.description: The Demonic Illusion: Insect Pit is a genjutsu used by the Aburame clan. The user creates an illusion of insects disguised as the ground. When an opponent steps on the specific area, the ground will cave in, revealing numerous insects that envelope them as they descend underground. * This technique takes inspiration from the method used by Shino Aburame against in '. * Poison Moth Genjutsu
Demonic Illusion: Insect Pit.title: Demonic Illusion: Insect Pit

Demonic Illusion: Inverted world.description: This jutsu causes the target to feel as if they were trapped in another world. The power is an optical illusion which is caused by looking into Hiro's Sharingan and by channeling his chakra into his opponent, the genjutsu begins by black rose petal's flying at the enemy after the rose's disappear's the genjutsu takes place trapping the opponent in an Inverted World. It inverts an opponent's sense of direction Hiro describes this technique as something like a trump card, the sense of direction is changed, the opponent's eyesight and where they get cut is reversed as well. The effect can be targeted at a specific opponent.
Demonic Illusion: Inverted world.title: Demonic Illusion: Inverted world

Demonic Illusion: Killing Intent Techniq.description: This technique projects the users killing intention over a wide area, causing those within its range to be paralyzed with fear. Targets feel and fear as though they are being attacked though nothing is physically happening to them. The more the target fears, the more intense the technique becomes, to the point where their fear kills them.
Demonic Illusion: Killing Intent Techniq.title: Demonic Illusion: Killing Intent Technique

Demonic Illusion: Killing Intent of the.description: This genjutsu artificially enhances the user's Killing Intent to the level that one has the impression they are facing the full wrath of the Kyuubi no Youko itself. The technique is classified as a Kinjutsu because of the widespread panic it is bound to incite.
Demonic Illusion: Killing Intent of the.title: Demonic Illusion: Killing Intent of the Nine Tails

Demonic Illusion: Kunoichi Harem.description: Demonic Illusion: Kunoichi Harem is a A-Rank genjutsu cast by female users of genjutsu, limiting it to kunoichi alone. Kureiji Kurama respectively mastered this technique when leaving Iwagakure, and has since then placed it in a scroll for teaching purposes. It seems she has made several scrolls teaching this technique to many other kunoichi's who want their foes destroyed with a twist. When casting the illusion, the foe is seemingly dispersed to a new location and receives amnesia so they have no memory of being teleported; the location of a royal bed-room or other type of home-stead. In the room resides a dresser, a fire-place, and several stained glass windows; featuring a large bed upon a large platform; with the enemy appearing in the illusion of said platform. On the bed lie three or more kunoichi, all in seductive allure and temptation. The genjutsu will cause the foe to lose thei
Demonic Illusion: Kunoichi Harem.title: Demonic Illusion: Kunoichi Harem

Demonic Illusion: Light Apparition.description: Mia Tsuki usually uses this technique at night or in darkness. She uses this with the combination of another genjutsu called Bringer-of-Darkness. When she uses the hand seals required for this technique she summons to what appears to be ghost that has aura that appears to be frequent flashing lights. They will come at the enemy and grab there body and strangle or pull them down to the ground. The opponent can see them since they give off alot of light and can attack, making them disappear. The opponent can use their chakra to release this genjutsu or real physical pain. This genjutsu was made to scare the opponent to make them paralized or with a weak heart die of fright.
Demonic Illusion: Light Apparition.title: Demonic Illusion: Light Apparition

Demonic Illusion: Limbo.description: Demonic Illusion: Limbo is a sound-based genjutsu that is simple in concept, but is incredibly powerful due to its capabilities. The user accumulates Yin Release chakra into the hand of their choosing and snaps their fingers to initiate the technique. Once the user snaps their fingers the accumulated Yin chakra is released as a subtle far-reaching, 360 degree invisible sound wave, that is low in frequency but is high enough in frequency to still penetrate the inner ear of living organisms, meaning that even though the target may not be able to actually hear the sound produced, the brain still registers it as a low frequency sound. Once effected, the victim or victims regardless of number or skill who hear it, fall under the genjutsu's influence. Within the genjutsu the victim's mind and body are frozen in a black and white dreamscape that takes the form of the actual physical location th
Demonic Illusion: Limbo.title: Demonic Illusion: Limbo

Demonic Illusion: Lunatic Chains.description: This genjutsu requires the use of the Sharingan. Once the illusion is successfully cast, the opponent becomes trapped within a mental world created by the user. Within the illusion, several chains materialize around the victim’s body, binding them in place and preventing them from moving freely. The chains then begin pulling in multiple directions, creating an overwhelming sensation of pressure and intense pain within the victim’s mind. Although the effects are entirely illusory, the victim’s brain perceives the pain as real, making it extremely difficult to maintain concentration or resist the genjutsu. Because of the intense psychological and sensory effects it produces, this technique can be used to incapacitate opponents and, in fictional interrogation scenarios, pressure a target into revealing information.
Demonic Illusion: Lunatic Chains.title: Demonic Illusion: Lunatic Chains

Demonic Illusion: Magnet Prison.description: Shai Uchiha activates his Sharingan and creates an illusion where he produces clones that surround his target. The clones attach chains around the target, causing them to be unable to move. In reality, he touched the target with his Magnet Release chakra and trapped their movement.
Demonic Illusion: Magnet Prison.title: Demonic Illusion: Magnet Prison

Demonic Illusion: Melting Point.description: This genjutsu requires the Sharingan and eye contact to be activated. The target is caught in a mind world created by the user, where an endless rain of acid pours. This jutsu seems to manipulate time in the opponent's mind to an extent, and the acid that hits their skin in the Genjutsu causes very real pain. The rain falls fast and hits like needles, melting the skin off the user. However, the victim is unaffected in the real world, though the pain the victim felt doubles when the Genjutsu ends.
Demonic Illusion: Melting Point.title: Demonic Illusion: Melting Point

Demonic Illusion: Memory Displacement.description: This technique was created by Aoi Uchiha. By making eye contact with his opponent, Aoi puts them under this genjutsu where they are paralyzed from spikes stabbing them in pressure pints around their body, and they also have no contentious in the Genjutsu world. Though what Aoi does is he connects to the persons' brain through their eyes, and he can veer into their memory up to a months time. Not only that, but that part of their memory is then implanted into Aoi's memory, nothing happens to the persons' memory, but after the genjutsu is finished, the paralysis part of the genjutsu takes effect for over half a day. In Aoi's memory, when he looks at the memory he just basically stole, instead of the person that he took the memory from being there, he is there. Whatever they know in that time span, Aoi now knows, that includes a technique or something valuable. If its a technique he has to
Demonic Illusion: Memory Displacement.title: Demonic Illusion: Memory Displacement

However, direct eye contact can still be applied when using this technique. It is said to be able to cause mirages and Fata Morganas. In fact, its name has become almost synonymous with "mirage": in Japanese, the word for "mirage" is .
Demonic Illusion: Mirage Lamprey.title: Demonic Illusion: Mirage Lamprey

Demonic Illusion: Mirror Heaven and Eart.description: {{JutsuInfobox |ref= |tabber=Yes |image1=Tree Binding Death.png |caption1=The user casts a genjutsu… |image2=Illusion Reflect.png |caption2=…only to have it casted back on them. |named=Yes |kanji=魔幻・鏡天地転 |romaji=Magen: Kyō Tenchi-ten |game names=Illusion: Rotation of Heaven and Earth |other names=Genjutsu Reflection |other jutsu=Yes |parent jutsu=Genjutsu: Sharingan |related jutsu=Demonic Illusion: Mirror Heaven and Earth Shatter |jutsu classification=, Genjutsu, Dōjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary |jutsu range=Short |users= |debut manga= |debut anime= |game debut= |jutsu media=Anime, Manga, Game, Movie }} When a genjutsu is used on them, the user quickly decrypts the genjutsu with their Sharingan to understand how it works. They then perform an identical genjutsu on their attacker, causing a . Since most genjutsu are used to confuse victims, this reversed genjutsu deals
Demonic Illusion: Mirror Heaven and Eart.title: Demonic Illusion: Mirror Heaven and Earth Change

Demonic Illusion: Mirror Heaven and Eart.description: The user of this technique encrypts a type of into a genjutsu that destroys the technique from the inside out, thus negating the technique altogether. Like its counterpart, one needs the preemptive ability of the Sharingan to read through an opponent's genjutsu and destroy it in an instant. Comparatively, it also deals a great amount of mental damage to the user, considering the speed at which the Sharingan user is able to counter and destroy a genjutsu. It is also possible for the user to layer their own genjutsu on top of the technique, leading the enemy to believe their genjutsu hit.
Demonic Illusion: Mirror Heaven and Eart.title: Demonic Illusion: Mirror Heaven and Earth Shatter

Demonic Illusion: Mirror Image Body.description: This genjutsu requires the Sharingan and eye contact to be activated. Once the genjutsu has been initiated the illusion traps the victim in a white empty room like space, once there a mirror will appear in front of the victim and then the victim looks at the reflection of his own image in the mirror, then suddenly the victim is then trapped inside the mirror. The user will then appear in this white room and with a snap of his finger the mirror will shatter pieces along with the victim. The victim will feel the sensation of their entire body being broken into hundreds of pieces, the purpose of this jutsu is to weaken a targets defense as well as to render their vision slightly so that they are unable to battle properly.
Demonic Illusion: Mirror Image Body.title: Demonic Illusion: Mirror Image Body

Demonic Illusion: Mirror of Beasts and D.description: is a powerful created by the Noble for the purpose of combating enemy illusions. Being a clan who made genjutsu their mainstay, with their appearing sporadically in each generation, the Kurama Clansmen are taught from a young age to understand the beauty and power of illusions: how they work, the effects they can bring about, and just how truly devastating one can be under the right circumstances. As such, they would go on to develop their own technique for the purpose of not only breaking any and all enemy genjutsu, but also reverting them back against the original caster. Mirror of Beasts and Deities is a powerful technique that combines the principles of , reversion, with that of , stitching. It is not like that "decrypts and reflects" genjutsu as there is no way for the user to automatically understand how the spell being used on them works. Instead, this technique works by completel
Demonic Illusion: Mirror of Beasts and D.title: Demonic Illusion: Mirror of Beasts and Deities

Demonic Illusion: Mirror of Revealing Li.description: Demonic Illusion: Change of Heart (魔幻・心変わり, Magen: Kokorogawari) is a powerful genjutsu granted to those who wield the Nenmu. This is a powerful technique granted to those who have mastered the kekkei genkai of the Kurama Clan. Using their overwhelming power in Yin Release, the user is able cast a genjutsu on themselves which allows them to reflect any genjutsu casted upon them back to the caster. Unlike other techniques, that decrypt the genjutsu after being caught within it, this technique prevents the user from being trapped within the false reality. Upon reflecting the technique, the user is able to manipulate the technique to the fullest extent, even if the technique was casted through another Kekkei Genkai. It is as if they casted the technique themselves. While this technique causes the target to have a high amount of mental damage due to the confusion and the actual effect of the
Demonic Illusion: Mirror of Revealing Li.title: Demonic Illusion: Mirror of Revealing Light

Demonic Illusion: Mirrored Stare.description: A very deceptive technique which works only when faced against multiple targets. Soru creates an AOE Genjutsu which replaces his appearance with the appearance of someone else. It works better by making his target see their teammate where he stands and him where they stand. He can further the illusion by manipulating the sounds they make, causing the target to also hear and feel him instead of the person who he replaced his appearance with. Soru can make an opponent's whole team mimic his appearance and voice. When combine with substitution technique, Soru has forced brothers to kill each other.
Demonic Illusion: Mirrored Stare.title: Demonic Illusion: Mirrored Stare

Demonic Illusion: Mist Cloud of Discord.description: Demonic Illusion: Mist Cloud of Discord is a Genjutsu that must be used when the environment is either; naturally enveloped by a thick cloud of mist or cast upon using Hiding in Mist Technique. While having the victim struggle to navigate and surveying through the mist that surrounds them, the user traps them within a genjutsu by using the mist their constantly looking at as a medium to mesmerize them, this induces the genjutsu. When used, the genjutsu show no immediate changes, however this technique causes a target or targets to, while walking in what they believe to be the right direction, walk in completely different location then what they thought they were going. As they pass one part of the area into the next, the trees, rocks, even the ground they walked on and other things within the surrounding environment constantly shift around outside their field of vision to block off exit
Demonic Illusion: Mist Cloud of Discord.title: Demonic Illusion: Mist Cloud of Discord

Demonic Illusion: Moon Seen on the Water.description: This genjutsu changes the victim’s perspective of the user’s presence, according to the user’s discretion. The user can make the victim believe their anywhere within the victim’s line of perspective. This allows the user to take any action within the victim’s presence without their real body being truly perceived by the victim.
Demonic Illusion: Moon Seen on the Water.title: Demonic Illusion: Moon Seen on the Water

Demonic Illusion: Nail Paralysis.description: {{JutsuInfobox |image=Nail_Paralysis1.png |named=Yes |other jutsu=Yes |game names=Demonic Illusion: Nail Paralysis |parent jutsu=Tsukuyomi Mode |jutsu classification=, Dōjutsu, Genjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Offensive |jutsu range=Short, Mid |users= |jutsu media=Game }} The user, while in Tsukuyomi Mode, summons large white spikes to impale any opponent within the barrier from above. * Demonic Illusion: Shackling Stakes Technique
Demonic Illusion: Nail Paralysis.title: Demonic Illusion: Nail Paralysis

Demonic Illusion: Nobuyuuki Interrogatio.description: The Demonic Illusion: Nobuyuuki Interrogating Technique is a technique used by Nobuyuuki Ken to interrogate captured POW. After performing a simple handseal, Ken will stare down his target unknowingly casting a Genjutsu on them. The target will then have visions of medevial-style torture at the hands of Nobuyuuki when in turn, Nobuyuuki is standing next to them watching them freak out. The technique is designed so that after hours of false torture, the victim will spill out information.
Demonic Illusion: Nobuyuuki Interrogatio.title: Demonic Illusion: Nobuyuuki Interrogation Technique

Demonic Illusion: Oblivion Scribe.description: This technique, restricted to wielders of the , allows the user to peer into a target's subconscious and interact with their memories. In particular, users of this technique can view the memories of their target and modify them as well. Saisei Uchiha has demonstrated that in order to utilize this technique a target must be both conscious and immobile. Therefore, it cannot be performed in combat due to the necessary amount of focus that it requires. Additionally, this technique appears to be stressful on the user's chakra and eyes if performed for long extents of time, as witnessed through Saisei's usage. As the memories of any given individual are complex and interlocked, modification must be performed cautiously to prevent the target from undergoing an intense amount of mental strain. Failure to proceed with caution can easily result in the user being forced from the target's subconscio
Demonic Illusion: Oblivion Scribe.title: Demonic Illusion: Oblivion Scribe

Demonic Illusion: One Thousand Broken Mi.description: A powerful genjutsu used by a few members of the Murakami Clan. After the needed hand seals are formed, the target(s) is/are placed under the illusion that they are surrounded by a giant, 360-degree mirror, which reflects themselves and their surroundings. The mirror will then slowly break into pieces, then break into even smaller pieces, and continue subdividing until there are countless shards surrounding the target, all of which reflect the target and his surroundings. This greatly confuses and disorients the target. Once the shards have finished dividing, they will fly at the victim and stab him, causing great mental shock.
Demonic Illusion: One Thousand Broken Mi.title: Demonic Illusion: One Thousand Broken Mirrors

Demonic Illusion: One's Own Fears Revela.description: A genjutsu known only to Miyuki Murakami. After performing the necessary hand seals, Miyuki places the target in an illusion that forces them to tell her their worst fears. The illusion usually entails the target being shackled to an iron post, with a very dark, grey sky, and booming thunder. Miyuki is standing in front of the target, but is visible only as a silhouette except for her Ketsugan, which glows a deep, bloody red. Once the victim tells Miyuki their worst fears, Miyuki can alter the illusion to reflect the fears of her victim. As with all genjutsu, the One's Own Fears Reincarnation is enhanced by her Ketsugan to the point of being virtually unbreakable. With the death of Miyuki, the sole user, during the Murakami Clan Massacre, the technique has been lost forever.
Demonic Illusion: One's Own Fears Revela.title: Demonic Illusion: One's Own Fears Revelation

Demonic Illusion: Onset of Madness Techn.description: The Demonic Illusion: Onset of Madness Technique is a powerful genjutsu. Targets experiences illusions of deep-seated fear towards the user, causing victims to doubt everything, lose control of all rational thought, and see visions of their deepest fears. It prods and incites madness deep within their mind and heart, leading them to act out in mayhem, attacking everyone and everything indiscriminately. This technique can be targeted at or neglected from specific opponents, making it ideal for use in group fighting. However, the unpredictable state of those affected by it can be dangers to allies and enemies alike.

infobox.parent jutsu: Demonic Illusion: Operation of Parallel Worlds

Demonic Illusion: Onset of Madness Techn.title: Demonic Illusion: Onset of Madness Technique

Demonic Illusion: Operation of Parallel.description: Demonic Illusion: Operation of Parallel Worlds is a genjutsu fighting style invented by . It traps targets within a genjutsu which can be exploited for one of various purposes.
Demonic Illusion: Operation of Parallel.title: Demonic Illusion: Operation of Parallel Worlds

Demonic Illusion: Orchid Sky.description: Kazaki puts the victim in a genjutsu world, through use of his Sharingan, which puts the victim under the false pretense of being burnt to death as the world burns around them. He used this technique as a method of torture.
Demonic Illusion: Orchid Sky.title: Demonic Illusion: Orchid Sky

Demonic Illusion: Piercing Shooting Star.description: The user of this technique appears before their opponents as a spirit, showing off hair that seems to be littered with stars. The stars soon leave the hair, striking through the targets. Once the genjutsu is over, the opponents discover they have been pierced by fierce wind and blades.

infobox.jutsu classification: Kekkei Genkai~ Sharingan, Kenjutsu, Genjutsu, Ninjutsu, Dojutsu

Demonic Illusion: Piercing Shooting Star.title: Demonic Illusion: Piercing Shooting Stars

Demonic Illusion: Ravenous Hunger.description: The user first must get a good look at the area the opponent is standing in, creating the illusion that the ground is destroyed and the enemy is propelled several hundred meters into space. The enemy is then tied up with four belts and an the Legendary Beast of the Delusional Forest, opens a hole in space and comes out of it, reaching to grab the enemy and devour him . This jutsu is used to break down the mind of the enemy and even induce pain as once the beast captures you in its razor sharp teeth it may already be too late. This jutsu affects both the Hearing and Sight aspect of the senses.

infobox.users: Mazoku Mao, Raizo Ozunu , Terrax, Saikuron, Tsuki no Ai

Demonic Illusion: Ravenous Hunger.title: Demonic Illusion: Ravenous Hunger

Demonic Illusion: Revelation of the Mind.description: This Genjutsu creates a disruption in the senses of sight and hearing within an intended target. Such an effect may be capable of activating through a simple distraction, at which the Rat hand seal allows the necessary preparation to create a disruption within the victim's chakra control. The user is then subsequently able to create a hallucination that they are actually seeing the user, or another individual, right in front of them. While that is the basis of the technique, a more common application of it is to allow for the victim to reveal information based on their relationship with the person they are talking to; as well as this, one could use it as a means to force the other individual into doing something through simple persuasion.

infobox.users: Futaba, Rika Mizuki, Shisui Uchiha (Cloud), Miyako Yamanaka, Reitsura, Chinka, Tenko Kuroboshi, Haruka Hakai, Akazuki Uzumaki

Demonic Illusion: Revelation of the Mind.title: Demonic Illusion: Revelation of the Mind Technique

Demonic Illusion: Riveted Torment.description: This genjutsu allows Shūrin to cast the image of the victim(s) being placed naked in a cage as they are held down by their loved ones. Shūrin projects his distorted voice in this genjutsu world and asks the victim a series of questions, if they lie or fail to answer, they perceive their loved one's hammering down rusted nails through their body; this genjutsu can perfectly mimic the painful sensation of having a nail pierce through one's flesh and bone as it is hammered into their body. This genjutsu not only renders them immobile but also slowly breaks down the target(s) willpower as Shūrin extracts information from them. However, if the target keeps resisting or lying, the pain can be intensified ten-fold, which may actually cause their body's go to into a state of shock; as such, long-term exposure to this interrogation genjutsu would cause them to fall into a state of coma. * While m
Demonic Illusion: Riveted Torment.title: Demonic Illusion: Riveted Torment

Demonic Illusion: Sandstorm.description: This is a genjutsu developed by Mikoto of Sunagakure. The user first stands in front of the opponent, and slowly disperses into the Sand; disappearing from sight. Afterwards, the victim finds themselves in a sandstorm, robbing them of their sight. This technique was capable of even robbing those with "Aided Eyes" sight. Only extremely skilled Genjutsu users, such as Itachi or Kurenai, can somewhat resist it; but even they are forced to wait until the genjutsu eventually ends. Mikoto can only hold the genjutsu for 8 minutes straight.
Demonic Illusion: Sandstorm.title: Demonic Illusion: Sandstorm

Demonic Illusion: Scattering Butterflies.description: The is a unique genjutsu devised by to serve as an illusionary follow-up maneuver to be used in conjunction with her techniques. This illusionary technique starts right after Aki creates the spectral creatures: directing the butterflies to rush toward a target or spread to cover an area upon being manifested onto the field. During their fluttering about, they will subtly produce waves of that immediately activate a genjutsu: ensnaring anyone who has the misfortune of perceiving their presence. Be it sight, hearing, or even the detection of the special chakra that is used to produce them: the moment anyone in the butterflies vicinity detects them, they will be dragged into a genjutsu of Aki's choosing. It should be noted that this technique is not a single genjutsu, but rather a group of them. In a complex maneuver that combines the principles of and , the spells are cast one-by-one and s
Demonic Illusion: Scattering Butterflies.title: Demonic Illusion: Scattering Butterflies

Demonic Illusion: Screaming Bloody Murde.description: This is a powerful genjutsu that was developed by the Murakami Clan. It is one that requires highly adept chakra control to perform, as even the slightest slip in concentration can result in the dissipation of the genjutsu. After the user executes the hand seals, the victim will fall under the illusion that the people closest to them have been brutally murdered. The illusion usually entails four or five people, who are typically pierced with kunai, have been deformed by severe beatings, and are soaked from head to toe in blood. The genjutsu is accordingly severely traumatic. When used by a ninja who has an activated Ketsugan, the genjutsu's power is augmented to the point of being comparable to Tsukuyomi.
Demonic Illusion: Screaming Bloody Murde.title: Demonic Illusion: Screaming Bloody Murder

Demonic Illusion: Self Sustaining Genjut.description: This is Aoi's strongest jutsu in his arsenal. By first weaving the specific hand signs, Aoi makes a genjutsu centered around himself while at the same time making a clone. Then right in the process of making the clone he merges it with the genjutsu, so when the clone is created, there isn't a poof of smoke, instead there is this clear substance that comes from the clone when created and settles into the clone. To a sensory type ninja, or a ninja with a dojutsu that can see chakra, they would see the clone a a regular clone. But in combat it is totally different, no attacks work on it, they just phase through, not even Fuinjutsu works on this technique. Its like the clone isn't real, an illusion to some people, people's first reaction is to weave the release hand sign to release a possible genjutsu, but that doesn't work. When the clone attacks, all of its attacks works on the target, it
Demonic Illusion: Self Sustaining Genjut.title: Demonic Illusion: Self Sustaining Genjutsu

Demonic Illusion: Sense Deprivation.description: Once the genjutsu is cast, it will automatically target one of the opponent’s senses by blocking the opponents mind from receiving the information from their body. While including the sense when performing the jutsu helps a user focus, it is actually unnecessary to do so and not doing so can make it harder for the target to realize which sense isn't working. Unfortunately, losing sense is fairly easy to notice, so this jutsu does not see much field use. As a result, they are more often used for genjutsu training or when performing Torture & Interrogation where the target cannot break the genjutsu. The main purpose of this jutsu is to deprive an opponent of their senses or one aspect of their sense as listed below. The genjutsu affects a specific sense, so there are versions for each sense. *On (Sound) *Shiryoku (Sight) *Nioi (Smell) *Konomi (Taste) *Sesshoku (Touch) *Kutsuu (Pain)
Demonic Illusion: Sense Deprivation.title: Demonic Illusion: Sense Deprivation

Demonic Illusion: Sensory Deprivation.description: Demonic Illusion: Sensory Deprivation (魔幻感覚遮断, Magen: Kankakushaden) is a genjutsu that is commonly used by shinobi as an interrogation tactic. This technique cuts the target off from all sensory perception — sight, touch, smell and hearing, it's all out of their reach when under this illusion, all they have to keep them sane is the luxury of conscious thought.
Demonic Illusion: Sensory Deprivation.title: Demonic Illusion: Sensory Deprivation

Demonic Illusion: Sexy Technique.description: The user uses their Sharingan to cast a genjutsu on the target of what first seems to be numerous girls in swimsuits standing around the target which then turn into wolves.
Demonic Illusion: Sexy Technique.title: Demonic Illusion: Sexy Technique

Demonic Illusion: Shackling Stakes Techn.description: {{JutsuInfobox |ref= |image=Orochimaru Caught In The Shackling Stakes.PNG |named=Yes |kanji=魔幻・枷杭 |romaji=Magen: Kasegui |english tv=Demonic Illusion: Shackling Stakes |other jutsu=Yes |parent jutsu=Genjutsu: Sharingan |jutsu classification=, Genjutsu, Dōjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary |jutsu range=Short |users= |debut manga= |debut anime= |game debut= |jutsu media=Anime, Manga, Game, Movie }} The Demonic Illusion: Shackling Stakes Technique is an ocular genjutsu described as being a type of . By first establishing direct eye contact with the opponent using the Sharingan, the user will then put them into an illusionary world. The victim will be tormented with the sensation of having spikes driven through their limbs, taking away their body's freedom. At the same time, the physical pain accompanying the illusion reveals the greatest use this technique has is primarily f
Demonic Illusion: Shackling Stakes Techn.title: Demonic Illusion: Shackling Stakes Technique

Demonic Illusion: Sharingan's Mirror.description: This technique is an advanced form of Demonic Illusion: Mirror Heaven and Earth Change. It is only available by having a fully mature, three-tomoe Sharingan. There are two versions of the technique: One used against projectile attacks, and one used against close-quarters attacks. It is able to deflect any attack, no matter what shape or size, and uses little chakra. However, there is a 10-second period where it is unusable.

infobox.parent jutsu: Demonic Illusion: Mirror Heaven and Earth Change
infobox.users: Itami Uchiha, Hiroshi Nakano, Ameno Shirokami,  Tatsuya,Chika Hikaru,

Demonic Illusion: Sharingan's Mirror.title: Demonic Illusion: Sharingan's Mirror

Demonic Illusion: Sheer Cold.description: The Demonic Illusion: Sheer Cold is an A-rank, Supplementary Genjutsu technique used by Mr. and Mrs. Cutter. This technique will affect all of the living being within range of the user. This genjutsu will manipulate the opponent's sense of touch to make him/her believe that he/she is very cold, chilling him/her to the bone. The victim is rendered incapable of moving his/her body and will become incredibly sleepy due to how cold he/she is. (Jutsu created by User:Cyberweasel89, but is welcome to be used by others)
Demonic Illusion: Sheer Cold.title: Demonic Illusion: Sheer Cold

Demonic Illusion: Snake Bind Death.description: The Demonic Illusion: Snake Bind Death is a B-rank, Supplementary Genjutsu technique used by Anko Mitarashi. This technique is a variant of Kurenai Yuhi's Demonic Illusion:Tree Binding Death . At first, the user will appear to dissolve into hundreds of small snakes that will slither away or burrow underground. After a short period of silence, hundreds of large snakes, both in thickness and length, will erupt from the ground around the user's target and fasten themselves on him/her, making the target resemble a living snake tree of sorts. The user will then appear right above the target and finish him/her off with either a kunai knife or a weapon of his/her choice. Kurenai Yuhi helped Anko develop this technique and appears to be able to break it very easily. This technique is noted to be broken only by the target's pain, due to the target's arm being restricted. Thus, the target cannot p
Demonic Illusion: Snake Bind Death.title: Demonic Illusion: Snake Bind Death

Demonic Illusion: Spatial Awareness.description: is a that allows the user to manipulate the target's . While applications vary, users can influence the target's spatial awareness by increasing or decreasing the proximity the targets perceive an object, attack, or other to be. The user can also adjust the distance; making it only slight by adjusting the distance in millimeters or drastic by adjusting it by meters. The applications are vast as the user can utilize this technique in conjunction with nearly every other ninja art.
Demonic Illusion: Spatial Awareness.title: Demonic Illusion: Spatial Awareness

Demonic Illusion: Sphinx Riddle Techniqu.description: The user puts their hand on the target's head, putting them under a genjutsu. While the target is under the effects of the illusion, the user can read their minds and even see their past life experiences. * is a creature from who guarded the city of , and only those who could answer its riddles could pass.
Demonic Illusion: Sphinx Riddle Techniqu.title: Demonic Illusion: Sphinx Riddle Technique

Demonic Illusion: Spider Lily Pacificati.description: ---- The Demonic Illusion: Spider Lily Pacification Technique is a genjutsu in which the user conjures a sizable quantity of red spider lilies. The lilies sway gently in a soothing breeze, encouraging the victim to observe their beauty. If the victim looks at the spider lilies, they'll feel a compulsion to continue looking at them; a sudden feeling of calmness begins to take over. This genjutsu pacifies the victim, draining their will to resist and diminishing their desire to fight or argue. It makes them more compliant to the user's demands and easier to persuade. Even if victims become aware that they are trapped in a genjutsu, they will be discouraged from breaking themselves free as a result of the overwhelming feeling of peace they are experiencing. The longer the victim continues to look at the spider lilies, the stronger the effects of the genjutsu will grow. ---- While this techn
Demonic Illusion: Spider Lily Pacificati.title: Demonic Illusion: Spider Lily Pacification Technique

Demonic Illusion: Spider Thread Binding.description: ---- Demonic Illusion: Spider Thread Binding is a genjutsu technique in which the user manifests and controls spider-silk threads in order to bind their target or manipulate their movement. The victim will be chased and attacked by the silk; if caught, they'll be tied up in the silk and immobilized, however, breaking the genjutsu will result in the threads "being cut" and disappearing, releasing the victim from the paralysis. This technique is often confused for a non-genjutsu binding technique and thus, victims oftentimes don't catch on to the fact that this is a genjutsu. This is even more prevalent in the cases of those who can actually create and manipulate spider-silk threads. ---- Ordinarily, this technique doesn't require handseals, or at the very most, the seal of confrontation. However, if the user decides to weave the handseals, "Dog → Hare → Tiger", they can spring the silk-th
Demonic Illusion: Spider Thread Binding.title: Demonic Illusion: Spider Thread Binding

Demonic Illusion: Spike Trap.description: This ensnares an opponent into hallucinating that they have set off a trip wire, which results in their immediate impalement via a large spike. The shock, coupled with the illusory pain, is enough to disable most opponents if the illusion is believed. Tejina has shown that the perceived realism of this technique can be increased if the opponent has recently witnessed a trap.
Demonic Illusion: Spike Trap.title: Demonic Illusion: Spike Trap

Demonic Illusion: Steaming Multistoried.description: {{JutsuInfobox |ref= |image1=Ohamaguri mist.png |caption1=The Giant Clam exuding its mist... |image2=Ohamaguri mist 2.png |caption2=...through which the user casts their genjutsu. |tabber=Yes |kanji=魔幻・気蒸の楼閣­ |named=Yes |romaji=Magen: Kijō no Rōkaku |english tv=Mirage Genjutsu |game names=Giant Clam Mirage |other names= |jutsu rank=B |jutsu classification=Genjutsu, Collaboration Techniques |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary |jutsu range=Short, Mid |users= |debut manga= |debut anime= |game debut= |jutsu media=Anime, Manga, Game }} A , where the user, in tandem with their Giant Clam, is able to manifest realistic mirages by manipulating the light reflecting off the steam that it produces. As it is impossible for observers to distinguish from the real thing through normal methods, this technique is ideal for concealing the actual location of either individual, resulting in confusi
Demonic Illusion: Steaming Multistoried.title: Demonic Illusion: Steaming Multistoried Building

Demonic Illusion: Swirling Vortex.description: This genjutsu requires the Sharingan and eye contact to be activated. The target is caught in a mind world created by the user, and an image of a fully-matured Sharingan appears behind the user, and the target feels the sensation of being sucked into it, and when this happens, they feel pain as if being cut one thousand times over.
Demonic Illusion: Swirling Vortex.title: Demonic Illusion: Swirling Vortex

Demonic Illusion: Temple of Naraka Techn.description: This technique intends to stop a target in their tracks in order to allow for an easy hit or kill. This technique also implores a cursed element, defiling the mind of the recipient and overwhelming them with the corrupted chakra of Cal's Cursed Seal of Naraka. The ambient natural energy from his Cursed Seal has a potent effect on said target's mental state, making them more suggestible and vulnerable. Cal uses this technique as a failsafe to counter other high-level Genjutsu used against him.
Demonic Illusion: Temple of Naraka Techn.title: Demonic Illusion: Temple of Naraka Technique

Demonic Illusion: Thunder Pulse.description: This is one of Rej's most powerful and brutal genjutsus, as it causes the victim both psychological harm and potential paralysis. What happens is that Rej traps the opponent in a genjutsu, and then strikes them with a thunderbolt, one that pierces their heart. The "thunderbolt" then fills the opponent's heart, and causes it to beat rapidly, until the heart breaks out of the opponent's chest.
Demonic Illusion: Thunder Pulse.title: Demonic Illusion: Thunder Pulse

Through use of this technique, a simple pinch can feel like an amputation, a punch in the gut can feel like organs exploding, actual damage can feel like death. The primary phase entails the target hallucinating that they have died, and are being tortured by all of the demons of the underworld. The secondary phase is the more powerful of the two. It entails the user manipulating the pain receptors in the brain, which causes the target to feel as if they are experiencing pain from every cell in their body. Miyuki Murakami, due to her Ketsugan, had taken the technique to a whole new level. Being the moon is the highest point and source of light, there is no true blind spot a person can evade or avoid its rays. His chakra is then send outward in invisible waves of the moon that can place multiple people under his illusion or just a desired target, it requires more energy and focus to bypass others who are in the way of these waves. Those snared by this genjutsu are encased in the realm of and can experience either paralysis, image projections, or pain.

The target's comrades proceed to walk/crawl across the wire leading to the victim. With the added weight the wire cut even deeper than before. From below more wire is added; thrown across the target's belly, thighs and looping around the neck by the comrades. As a unit they begin to pull while the dances continue across the wire to their imprisoned comrade, the victim screams for his friends to stop, but they continue oblivious to the harm they are causing.

Flower Blade Ginjutsu.description: The Flower Blade Ginjutsu is a technique developed by Happosai Hanju. It is a Genjutsu technique that works off the sound of Happosai drawing and re-sheathing his sword. Before battle or in the middle of it Happosai will create hand seals for the Genjutsu. The seals then allow his chakra to be carried over through sound. when somebody hears his sword draw or sheathed they see themselves as being suddenly cut down by his blade. In there mind they are bleeding to death on the ground or have had there head separated from there body. During this brief moment Happosai rushes forward and usually actually cuts them down. Weather nor not you get out of the Genjutsu in time to defend yourself depends on your personal skill with dealing with Genjutsu. Most of the time however people never escape as there bodies soon join there mind.
Flower Blade Ginjutsu.title: Flower Blade Ginjutsu

Flower Ninja Art: Mirror Flower Water.description: {{JutsuInfobox |named=Yes |image=Flower Ninja Art Maximum Cutting.JPG |kanji=花忍法・強化裁 |romaji=Hana Ninpō: Kyōka Sai |english tv=Flower Ninja Art: Mirror Flower Water Move |other jutsu=Yes |parent jutsu=Flower Ninja Art |jutsu classification=, Genjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Offensive |jutsu range=Short, Mid |users= |debut anime= |jutsu media=Anime }} The user casts an illusion which surrounds the target in flower petals and darkens the surroundings around them.
Flower Ninja Art: Mirror Flower Water.title: Flower Ninja Art: Mirror Flower Water

Foreseeing Mind's Eye Technique.description: The Foreseeing Mind's Eye Technique is a jutsu created by Gen Nakaido due to his intrigue of the Sharingan. Takeru Higashiyama learned it later on due to his Yin-Yang Release training. This technique is a powerful skill and takes a lot of mental concentration and a large amount of chakra to initiate. This technique is also known as the 'False Sharingan'. First, the user must channel chakra into his or her mind and retinas. They must close their eyes in order to see that their vision becomes light blue over time. As soon as that happens, they need to use that chakra to stimulate many optic and memory nerves in their brain. If this is done correctly, there should be a tingling sensation at the back of their eyes. Shortly afterwards, with their eyes still closed, the user will tap into the opponent's mind and the user will the see the opponent's motives as if they were doing it at that exac
Foreseeing Mind's Eye Technique.title: Foreseeing Mind's Eye Technique

Forest of the Shadows.description: This is the second technique the In'ei was able to develop, in which she creates a genjutsu world to trap the opponent inside. Her skill with it is proficient enough that she can change the shape, size and scope of the genjutsu world so that it could go from covering one person to an entire village. Once locked inside, the place itself starts to manifest the opponent's worse nightmares and greatest fears, causing them to slowly go mad.
Forest of the Shadows.title: Forest of the Shadows

Freezing Release: Chilling Paradise.description: Doujinn sends his victim to an illusionary beautiful snowy mountain range. Then, the ground turns into ice and the victim is instantly frozen. In reality the victim was struck with Freezing Release chakra and are frozen.

infobox.jutsu classification: Kekkei Genkai~Rinnegan~Freezing Release, Ninjutsu, Genjutsu, Dojutsu

Freezing Release: Chilling Paradise.title: Freezing Release: Chilling Paradise

Frost Release: Arctic Solar Eclipse.description: By focusing one's own flow of unto the palm of their hands, the user must then cross both arms towards the ground before even attempting to perform the said itself. Once performing the necessary , the said opponent will then become immediately trapped in a powerful . This effect lasts only for as long as the user maintains direct eye contact with their said combatant. When finally accumulating enough chakra, the will then show its victim a solar eclipse emanating the sun's blazing light causing what we know today to be . This lifelike exposure to it's light can bring about permanent if not severe damage to the , leaving the opponent at the wielder's mercy. * Frost Release: Cryogenic Zero * Frost Release: Manipulation
Frost Release: Arctic Solar Eclipse.title: Frost Release: Arctic Solar Eclipse

Frozen Inferno.description: An unique technique employed by Suisan Yuki, this jutsu allows the Death Guard member to trap for an indefinite amount of time someone inside an ice cube. He uses Yang Release to keep the victim alive, feeding him life saving energies and Yin Release to put him into a genjutsu, in order to keep his mind intact. It is said that this power was sought even by Orochimaru.

infobox.jutsu type: Ice Release, Yang Release, Yin Release

Frozen Inferno.title: Frozen Inferno

Futsunushi (Ash).description: Futsunushi (経津主, Haven-Passing Lord) is the first of Kotoshiro's two Mangekyō Sharingan techniques... :More Coming Soon... *Futsunushi (経津主, Haven-Passing Lord) is a Shintō kami of Fire and Lightning, and is a general of Amaterasu. This technique parallels that based on Kogo's usage with the consuming of the Fire Release nature, thereby giving it lightning-like speeds and brightness.
Futsunushi (Ash).title: Futsunushi (Ash)

Gambit Zero.description: This genjutsu was created by both Raido Uchiha and Takenshi Uchiha in order to discourage the use of genjutsu on each other. This genjutsu which coincides another as well, allows you to dispel any genjutsu that affects the mind by simply putting yourself through a simple brand of hypnosis that essential allows you to snap back to reality, once you do that it then allows you to overwrite the genjutsu and traverse the effect back on the user. The genjutsu then asks for a key as when the genjutsu used on the user has been captured within not only the genjutsu but this one is almost as if they become locked in. The Advent of the World Hypnosis locks them in and the only way to escape is by using the Advent of the World Hypnosis to release oneself from the jutsu, or release the jutsu all together. This is Raido's best and perhaps most dangerous genjutsu, as the only way to escape is to know t
Gambit Zero.title: Gambit Zero

Gedō Arts.description: As a wielder of the Rinnegan, Raido benefits greatly from its abilities. In its own right it allows one to wield the Six Paths Technique, and other various advantages in battle. Raido however after studying in the shrine of the Sage, created a different style that uses the Rinnegans powers and abilities. Naming it the Gedo Arts, while Raido has yet to fully explain to anyone the motive behind these Arts, it is know that the Rinnegan and impeccable mastery of each of the Six Path is required. Based on Raido's prowess with the Rinnegan the Gedo Arts abilities of covers a considerable distance. From barriers that destroy the Yang abilities of Ninjutsu removing their physical form, or destroying the Kekkei Genkai, or ninjutsu and even dojutsu. As of now Raido study is constantly in pursuit of the study of the Outer Path, and the possibilities are endless. Raido can do great harm to those who
