Gedō Arts.title: Gedō Arts

Genjitsumi.description: This technique is considered the pinnacle of Genjutsu. It is the most dangerous Genjutsu that was used by Junsui. This technique ventures beyond the confines of Genjutsu. This technique is used and was developed by Kyōsuke after learning Creation of All Things, then recreated by Junsui using his supreme talent in Yin-Yang Release without the requirement of learning Creation of All Things. He managed to fuse it with his extraordinary Genjutsu skills. This technique is considered one of the most lethal techniques in all history. It is basically applying Creation of All Things to his Genjutsu to make the illusions reality. This technique has not limits except that it is applied through Genjutsu not only the user's pure imagination, that seems to be the only limitation to the technique. If an attack is launched in the Genjutsu and this technique was applied, this attack with turn into realit
Genjitsumi.title: Genjitsumi

Genjutsu.description: is one of the main categories of jutsu which use chakra. Genjutsu are employed in the same fashion as ninjutsu, however, the effects of genjutsu are not real, being only illusions experienced by those who fall victim to it. According to the Second Mizukage, genjutsu falls under the broad category of Yin Release. Genjutsu is created when a ninja extends their chakra flow through the cerebral nervous system of their opponent to control their mind's chakra, causing a disruption in their five senses. This is frequently used to create false images and/or trick the body into believing it has experienced physical pain, however there are plenty of other uses depending on the situation. Genjutsu can also manipulate others — similar to brainwashing — by feeding the victim illusive suggestions. Most genjutsu is performed visually, requiring the target make eye contact with the caster. Other methods
Genjutsu.title: Genjutsu

Genjutsu Barrier Technique.description: is technique utilized by Asuna Kurama to summon a that serves as a medium to cast . Upon forming the technique specific , the user is capable of conjuring an intangible barrier of varying radius; the size is entirely dependent on the chakra put into the technique. Once summoned, the user can cast various genjutsu through the barrier, bypassing some of the parent technique's usual requirements. Additionally, due to the barrier constantly produce , the target must exit the barrier in order to break free from the illusion. Despite this technique's versatility, it is not without weakness. This technique requires a considerable amount to sustain and with every passing moment it grows ever so smaller. Secondly, complex genjutsu can't use this technique as a medium.
Genjutsu Barrier Technique.title: Genjutsu Barrier Technique

Genjutsu Binding.description: {{JutsuInfobox |image=Genjutsu Binding.png |named=Yes |kanji=幻術縛り |romaji=Genjutsu Shibari |literal english=Illusion Technique Binding |english tv=Paralysis Genjutsu |jutsu classification=Genjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary |users= |debut anime= |game debut= |jutsu media=Anime, Game }} As the name suggests, the user binds the opponent in a genjutsu, rendering them incapable of movement. This genjutsu can be used on more than one target at the same time. Once the target is bound, the user or an ally can rush up to the enemy, able to easily deliver a devastating killing blow.
Genjutsu Binding.title: Genjutsu Binding

Genjutsu Communication.description: {{JutsuInfobox |image1=Genjutsu Communication.png |caption1=The technique depicted in the manga. |image2=Genjutsu Communication Anime.png |caption2=The technique depicted in the anime. |tabber=Yes |named=Yes |kanji=幻術通信 |romaji=Genjutsu Tsūshin |literal english=Illusion Technique Communication |viz manga=Genjutsu Transmission |jutsu classification=Genjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary |jutsu range=Short, Mid, Long |users={{Users |canon=Yes|list= |fanon=Yes|list2= }} |debut manga= |debut anime= |jutsu media=Anime, Manga }} This technique is a projection-type genjutsu used as a means of communication. The user creates an image of themselves which appear corporeal and even the immediate surroundings can be altered by the user. often use this technique as a means to meet with multiple members at once, compensating for the fact that a group may not always be in close proximity
Genjutsu Communication.title: Genjutsu Communication

Genjutsu Dissipation.description: {{JutsuInfobox |named=Yes |image=Genjutsu Dissipation.png |kanji=幻術解 |romaji=Genjutsu Kai |english tv=Release |other names=Genjutsu: Release |jutsu classification=Genjutsu |jutsu class type=Supplementary |hand signs=Tiger or Clap Hands |users= |debut manga= |debut anime= |novel debut=Naruto: A Shinobi Story |jutsu media=Anime, Manga, Novel }} is the least harmful option for combating genjutsu. The user must stop the flow of chakra in their body before applying an even stronger power to disrupt the flow of the genjutsu user's chakra within one's own body. If skilled enough, the user can also apply a sudden surge of their own chakra into the affected person's body to release them from the genjutsu. Its effectiveness depends on the user's skill, knowledge, and talent in genjutsu.
Genjutsu Dissipation.title: Genjutsu Dissipation

Genjutsu Protect.description: {{JutsuInfobox |image=Genjutsu barricades.png |named=Yes |kanji=幻術プロテクト |romaji=Genjutsu Purotekuto |literal english=Illusion Technique Protect |english tv=Genjutsu Block |jutsu classification=Genjutsu |jutsu class type=Supplementary |users= |debut manga= |debut anime= |game debut= |jutsu media=Anime, Manga, Game }} The user can use this technique to place mental blocks the target's mind that contains valuable information in case the one with the information is captured and interrogated. According to Inoichi Yamanaka, it is very effective against truth serums. Additionally, as seen with Kyōshi Takamori, this technique can be employed to ensure that a target's memories and mind aren't tampered with by another individual's means. To this end, the technique can even be applied to the practitioner of the skill. This allows complete protection from even the strongest illusions. Feng Dào uses
Genjutsu Protect.title: Genjutsu Protect

Genjutsu Sharingan: Suiageru.description: This technique is exclusive to Keiji Kunitsu, it involves trapping the opponent in a Genjutsu world and siphoning their chakra. While their chakra is being used for the Genjutsu the user activates a secondary technique placed inside the Genjutsu to siphon the opponents' chakra supply. With their chakra being rapidly absorbed, it will cause the opponent to quickly collapse due to chakra exhaustion in a few seconds.

infobox.jutsu classification: Kekkei Genkai~Sharingan~Dark Release, Genjutsu, Dōjutsu, Chakra Absorption Techniques

Genjutsu Sharingan: Suiageru.title: Genjutsu Sharingan: Suiageru

Genjutsu: Amano Iwato.description: This technique requires the use of the Sharingan and direct eye contact. The opponent is trapped alone in an illusory dimension in which will be put face to face with an incomplete and shapeless version of the Sharingan wielder's Susanoo. In order to the technique to be fully utilized, the wielder must activate his Mangekyō Sharingan allowing the form of Susanoo hold the victim with one of his hands, gagging their then. There is no knowledge about the final effects of this technique, even though the body of the victim trapped in genjutsu becomes completely motionless and in shock in the real world. Apparently, this technique can also be involuntarily activated when the wielder needs to defend itself quickly as when Tenmaku had to defend himself against the group of Hunter-nin who tried to assassinate him. The same way as for users who have not fully awakened Susanoo the form of the gigan
Genjutsu: Amano Iwato.title: Genjutsu: Amano Iwato

Genjutsu: Bell Clone.description: After the opponent has heard the sound of bells, the opponent begins hallucinating that the caster has the ability to duplicate themself causing confusion.
Genjutsu: Bell Clone.title: Genjutsu: Bell Clone

Genjutsu: Bell Sound Clone.description: {{JutsuInfobox |image=Bell Ring Genjutsu.png |named=Yes |kanji=幻術·鈴音分身 |romaji=Genjutsu: Suzune Bunshin |literal english=Illusion Technique: Bell Sound Clone |jutsu classification=Genjutsu, Clone Techniques |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary |jutsu range=Mid |related jutsu=Genjutsu: Bell Clone |users= |debut anime= |game debut= |jutsu media=Anime, Game }} The user utilizes the ringing of small, circular bells to produce a sound wave that travels through the eardrum directly into the target's brain. This genjutsu will paralyze the victim while at the same cause them to see multiple images of the user. This will make it difficult for the target to focus as well as distinguish the real one from the illusionary clones. The user can then take advantage of this opportunity to follow up with an attack outside the genjutsu. * While unnamed in the anime, this technique was named in '.
Genjutsu: Bell Sound Clone.title: Genjutsu: Bell Sound Clone

Genjutsu: Blood Release.description: The Genjutsu: Blood Release (幻術・血遁, Genjutsu: Ketton) is a technique of Muketsu's that enhances his already significant prowess within Genjutsu. By making contact with an enemy through one of the plethora of weapons he has available through his manipulation over blood, Muketsu can impart his own blood into an opponent. This leaves a small quantity of chakra within an opponent's body. In doing so, Muketsu is able to subsequently direct his own chakra into an opponent's brain with much more ease as a result of some chakra already being present to accelerate and empower the Genjutsu being cast.
Genjutsu: Blood Release.title: Genjutsu: Blood Release

Genjutsu: Blue Rose Petal Realm.description: This is a technique Ryūza created based off his love for blue roses. Ryūza begins by taking out one of the many blue roses he carries and tossing it at the opponent. All of the petals fly off the rose in a flurry and envelop the opponent. This is a smell based genjutsu so as soon as the opponent smells a rose petal they are trapped. The genjustu then pulls them into a mirror version of the world where everything is made of blue rose petals. the petals begin to slowly fly around them in a giant twister. They then begin to stick onto the opponent slowly wrapping around them until they are cocooned. This technique immobilizes opponents for Ryūza to then finish off.
Genjutsu: Blue Rose Petal Realm.title: Genjutsu: Blue Rose Petal Realm

Genjutsu: Body Distortion.description: This technique is used to slow the target’s movements by placing them under a genjutsu that convinces them their brain is unable to properly send signals to the rest of their body. As a result, the target perceives their limbs as becoming increasingly sluggish, causing their overall movements and reaction speed to slow dramatically. Although the paralysis is entirely illusory, the mind instinctively limits the body’s movements, making the effect appear real and leaving the target vulnerable to follow-up attacks.
Genjutsu: Body Distortion.title: Genjutsu: Body Distortion

Genjutsu: Burning Alive.description: After performing the required hand seals, the user casts a powerful genjutsu that causes the target to perceive themselves as being completely surrounded by darkness. Moments later, a seemingly bottomless pit opens beneath their feet, causing them to fall into its depths. As the illusion intensifies, the target feels their body become completely paralyzed, unable to move or escape. At the bottom of the abyss, they are engulfed by intensely burning flames, experiencing the overwhelming sensation of being consumed by fire. Although the flames inflict no physical injuries, the extreme perceived pain and mental trauma can leave the victim immobilized, disoriented, and vulnerable to the user’s next attack.
Genjutsu: Burning Alive.title: Genjutsu: Burning Alive

Genjutsu: Cloud.description: Developed by Izumi Ito in her time as ANBU, Genjutsu: Cloud has Izumi create an illusionary clone of herself to charge the opponent, which then explodes into a cloud that stays in battle. This is partly to distract the opponent, but also serves to obscure vision on the battlefield. The cloud left behind by this technique can then be combined with other, more offensive jutsu, such as Lightning Release: Lightning Cloud.
Genjutsu: Cloud.title: Genjutsu: Cloud

Genjutsu: Disintigration.description: This genjutsu requires eye contact to be activated. The illusion traps the victim in a dark empty space where their body is made and begins to disintegrate from toe to head while the user is watching. The technique will make it harder for the target to move properly.
Genjutsu: Disintigration.title: Genjutsu: Disintigration

Genjutsu: Dragon Assault.description: Genjutsu: Dragon Assault is a genjutsu created by Agnihem that conjures an illusionary dragon that attacks the user's enemy.

infobox.users: Yū, Yūrei, Takumi Mazoku, Sakeme Uchū, Haruki Fūma

Genjutsu: Dragon Assault.title: Genjutsu: Dragon Assault

Genjutsu: Dream.description: A Genjutsu that has two stages: 1.) If the user waves the Ram (Hitsuji) hand seal, similar to the Infinite Tsukuyomi, those under the influence of the Genjutsu: Yume will experience dream worlds where their deepest desires are fulfilled. Even though the Genjutsu can be broken, the opponent will temporarily lose their bloodlust and desire to fight, leaving them vulnerable for at least one minute. The technique does not require eye contact, nor physical contact, if the opponent is within 200 feet from Ameno, they'll be trapped by the Genjutsu. Ameno is able to select her opponents by their chakra, with this she doesn't trap everyone, but only the ones she means to. 2.) If the user waves the Seal of Confrontation hand seal, the opponent will be trapped into a Genjutsu where the user controls what happens, however this technique can be used only to generate good feelings in the opponent. Sim
Genjutsu: Dream.title: Genjutsu: Dream

Genjutsu: Endless Storms.description: Genjutsu: Endless Storms is a powerful genjutsu performed with the Mangekyō Sharingan dōjutsu. This is one of the signature techniques used by Asana Uchiha. After making eye contact with a target, Asana traps them in a shadowy world with a red moon and its illumination with thunderstorms. and relaying destruction due to her unprecedented ability. From the outside, the target's eyes turned dark red as a sign that they're in the Genjutsu. This technique grants the caster the ability to even see the opponent's weakness of their prowess. This ability simply overpowers the opponent in the technique and from the outside world. Asana noted that this technique had a low chance of anything breaking out of it.
Genjutsu: Endless Storms.title: Genjutsu: Endless Storms

Genjutsu: Enter.description: Soru can enter another persons Genjutsu by inserting a bit of his own chakra into the targets brain. At first, it caused many to die from overload. But through careful practice and a mastery, Soru was even able to intercept powerful Genjutsu users and save many of his own men.
Genjutsu: Enter.title: Genjutsu: Enter

Genjutsu: Eye of the Uchiha.description: This is one of Dezku's most powerful jutsu it is the only jutsu known that is able to intercept or cancel out the famous Uchiha Clan's Sharingan. If they are met with this genjutsu, reality for them will warp and bring forth their deepest fears to reality and it is deadly and has been known to kill. This jutsu only works on the Sharingan it also works on the Mangekyō Sharingan but it is unknown if it will work on the Eternal Mangekyō Sharingan. The drawback is that it takes time and it only works if they have their Sharingan activated, it also takes a lot of chakra to perform this.

infobox.hand signs: Dog, Monkey, Ox, Tiger, Snake, Tiger, Dog, Ox

Genjutsu: Eye of the Uchiha.title: Genjutsu: Eye of the Uchiha

Genjutsu: Five Hundred Shades Of Sharing.description: A long-range defensive genjutsu cast through the Sharingan. The user projects hundreds of overlapping afterimages of their own chakra across the battlefield, creating the illusion that they exist in countless different locations at once. To anyone caught within the genjutsu, the user’s true position becomes impossible to distinguish, as every movement produces a multitude of convincing illusions that mirror the user’s actions with perfect accuracy. The technique is primarily defensive, forcing opponents to waste attacks on false images while concealing the user’s actual location. Projectile attacks and long-range ninjutsu are frequently redirected toward illusions, allowing the user to evade without excessive movement. The greater an opponent relies on visual perception, the more effective the technique becomes, as even experienced shinobi struggle to identify the genuine target amidst t

infobox.parent jutsu: Genjutsu: Sharingan|jutsu classification=Kekkei Genkai~Sharingan, Genjutsu, Dōjutsu|jutsu type=Yin Release

Genjutsu: Five Hundred Shades Of Sharing.title: Genjutsu: Five Hundred Shades Of Sharingan Technique

Genjutsu: Flash Bell.description: This Genjutsu is activated after the opponent hears the sounds of bells. After this happens, the opponent begins imagining that the caster is moving at incredible speeds attacking them. In reality, the opponents reflexes are dulled due to the intense sound while the caster is moving at average speeds.
Genjutsu: Flash Bell.title: Genjutsu: Flash Bell

Genjutsu: Flesh Decay.description: The is a potent genjutsu originally created by and practiced by the members of the . Simple in execution, the only requirement is that the caster make contact with their target; from there, those affected are pulled into a genjutsu wherein the view their flesh rotting away. Starting off as flaking and peeling, the symptoms gain in speed and intensity as contact persist: the victim eventually seeing their entire body being shredded if they do not manage to break free of the illusion. The technique was developed for the purpose of warding off opponents who employ advanced taijutsu such as the or . However, in later years it has been used more aggressively and creatively than its original designations.
Genjutsu: Flesh Decay.title: Genjutsu: Flesh Decay

Genjutsu: Flower Petal Escape.description: {{JutsuInfobox |image=Genjutsu Flower Petal Escape.png |unnamed=Yes |jutsu classification=Genjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary |jutsu range=Short |users= |hand signs= |debut anime= |game debut= |jutsu media=Anime, Manga, Game }} When trapped inside of a genjutsu or wishing to appear trapped, the user uses this technique to dissolve their body into many flower petals, which then consume the enemy's body.
Genjutsu: Flower Petal Escape.title: Genjutsu: Flower Petal Escape

Genjutsu: Galaxy Rift.description: This genjutsu makes the victim feel like he is getting sucked into a space-time rift, stuck floating in an inescapable portion of space. Because there is no air in space, their body will unintentionally choke itself to death. The jutsu can be broken if the user believes that it is all fake. For anyone looking at the victim, the person will have glassy eyes and will have their hands around their throats, kneeling before the user.
Genjutsu: Galaxy Rift.title: Genjutsu: Galaxy Rift

Genjutsu: Ghost Fire.description: {{JutsuInfobox |image=Genjutsu Ghost Fire.png |named=Yes |kanji=幻術・燐火 |romaji=Genjutsu: Rinka |literal english=Illusion Technique: Ghost Fire |other jutsu=Yes |parent jutsu=Fire Release: Flint Yagura Technique |jutsu classification=Genjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary |users= |hand signs= |debut manga= |debut anime= |novel debut= |game debut= |jutsu media=Anime, Manga, Novel, Game }} Using their flames, the user manipulates the flames into an illusion of a dog-cat hybrid.
Genjutsu: Ghost Fire.title: Genjutsu: Ghost Fire

Genjutsu: Hell's Kingdom.description: this genjutsu makes the opponent seems as if the were in a demon world geting rip to Sherds by diffrent Demons
Genjutsu: Hell's Kingdom.title: Genjutsu: Hell's Kingdom

Genjutsu: Hypnotic Influencer.description: Hypnotic Influencer Is a Genjutsu that Shinobi with the Yin Release and Yang Release can use, it makes the opponent think that the user is someone they look up to and respect, someone like the hokage, the user won't turn into them but the opponent thinks they are that person, requires a low level genjutsu skill, using this jutsu with the Sharingan does make you look like that person but only in the eyes of the opponent.
Genjutsu: Hypnotic Influencer.title: Genjutsu: Hypnotic Influencer

Genjutsu: Inner Demon Lust.description: {| align=center style="background:transparent;" | valign=center | This article, , is property of Jumpy Naruto. |} Genjutsu: Inner Demon Lust (心テクニック：内面的な悪魔欲望) is a jutsu that is both a physical as well as mental attack.The user shoots a large flaming ball of fire at the opponent that resembles a huge gaping demon.But because the opponent is in a genjutsu he/she believes that it is an angelic being coming towards him/her with all the materialistic possessions they desire.This jutsu is classified as a Fire Release jutsu.After completing the sequence of jutsu,the user forms a hand seal much like Sasuke's when he uses Fire Release: Great Fireball jutsu.
Genjutsu: Inner Demon Lust.title: Genjutsu: Inner Demon Lust

Genjutsu: Kekkai.description: Genjutsu: Kekkai is a kekkai jutsu technique used to erect a field of chakra around the user that is visible only to doujutsu. Once breached, the opponent is immediately trapped in a powerful, incredibly versatile genjutsu. The illusion takes no specific form and is able to make use of the full spectrum of capabilities and effects accessible to genjutsu. It is one of the most potent illusion techniques that exist. If stronger forms of chakra are used with this technique, the effect becomes more severe depending on the intensity of the chakra. Thus, when intensified with sufficiently strong chakra, this technique will equal or exceed even the sharingan in terms of the strength of the illusion. It is nearly impossible to release so long as the user maintains the technique and the target(s) lay within the barrier, as the user can simply establish another illusion immediately. Even if the ba
Genjutsu: Kekkai.title: Genjutsu: Kekkai

Genjutsu: Ketsuryūgan.description: {{JutsuInfobox |image=Genjutsu_Ketsuryūgan.png |named=Yes |kanji=幻術・血龍眼 |romaji=Genjutsu: Ketsuryūgan |game names=Illusion: Blood Dragon Eye |other jutsu=Yes |derived jutsu= |jutsu classification=, Genjutsu, Dōjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary |jutsu range=Short |users= |debut anime= |novel debut= |game debut= |jutsu media=Anime, Manga, Game }} By touching or establishing eye contact with a target, the Ketsuryūgan user locks them within a genjutsu for various purposes. Along with being able to manipulate victims to affect their sense of reality, the user can brainwash them into mindless drones with a set order to follow, or trap them into a dream-like state. For more defensive means, this technique can create a powerful barrier against mind reading, protecting information from being acquired. Only another equally power dōjutsu-user can break through and repel this mental
Genjutsu: Ketsuryūgan.title: Genjutsu: Ketsuryūgan

Genjutsu: Killing Intent.description: This genjutsu is created by casting a genjutsu while exuding pure killing intention, in a sense creating a more vivid and "malleable" version of the original skill. It is used primarily as a means to mentally torture the victim by showing them several ways the user might kill them. If employed during combat, it often makes the victims become paranoid and being forced into a defensive stance or even retreat.
Genjutsu: Killing Intent.title: Genjutsu: Killing Intent

Genjutsu: Kitsune.description: By looking the opponent in the eye while she is in her half transformation, Ayumi can trap the opponent into a genjutsu of her choosing. The genjutsu can have various effects ranging from simple paralyzation or knocking out the opponent to great psychological damage. Once the opponent is in the genjutsu, Ayumi can control the illusion with ease. It is said that the illusions created by this technique are so detailed that many victims confuse it with reality. *This is based off of a Kitsune's incredible ability to create illusions. *Genjutsu: Sharingan
Genjutsu: Kitsune.title: Genjutsu: Kitsune

Genjutsu: Loony Time.description: This genjutsu was created by an unknown person, but he/she was assumed as genjutsu expert and had shown strong hints of being patient of asylum. Its effects on victims are similar to Multi-Personality Disorder, but in offensive version and with sinister twist. According to the medic's report, there have been several gennins and chuunins acting 'crazy','insane','loony',and other words. Hence the name, 'Loony Time'. Strangely, this genjutsu only work effectively on person with organized mind and not on person with 'messy' mind. This theory had been tested on several 'volunteers', the ones with different level of organized mind. And the medics have concluded that 'the more organized your mind, the more loony and twisted your mind go' and it seem to be fitting as the genjutsu user(s) would perform the handseal sequences and place on their palm on target's face, transfering his/her chakra int
Genjutsu: Loony Time.title: Genjutsu: Loony Time

Genjutsu: Mangekyō Sharingan.description: Is the advanced version of Genjutsu: Sharingan, in which it it considered to be ten times more powerful than it's previous stature, instead deployed through the usage of the Mangekyō Sharingan. Similarly to it's predecessor, this genjutsu requires direct eye contact to properly initiate and provides a handful of prestigious effects towards the victim, such as possessing enough power to render them unconscious instantaneously, as well as the ability to manipulate the target's physical and mental actions to a certain extent. Classified as a dōjutsu of the highest caliber, it is not beyond the likes of others to confuse such a technique for the signature power of a Mangekyō Sharingan, such as Amaterasu or Tsukuyomi. However, because it is considerably more powerful than the original version, the technique does indeed place a degree of stress upon the eyes of the user, though not nearly enou

infobox.users: Sayuri Senju, Temari Uchiha, Takashi Ringo, Raito Suchuwato, Narai Suchuwato

Genjutsu: Mangekyō Sharingan.title: Genjutsu: Mangekyō Sharingan

Genjutsu: Mirage.description: Kurenai stands up straight with her head bowed and her hands to her chest. As she stomps on the ground, pink leaves surround her, and the area is enveloped in a pink mist. The opponent is confused as to where Kurenai went. Suddenly, the opponent is punched back and as the opponent is spinning backwards Kurenai appears in front of them and attacks the opponent in mid-air.
Genjutsu: Mirage.title: Genjutsu: Mirage

Genjutsu: Mist.description: The user creates an illusionary clone that charges towards the opponent, jumps and then explodes in a cloud of cherry blossom petals.
Genjutsu: Mist.title: Genjutsu: Mist

Genjutsu: Monochrome.description: Upon eye contact, Asana activates her Mangekyō Sharingan and plunges the target’s perception into a black-and-white world — stripping away all color, warmth, and emotional resonance. In this monochrome realm, time appears slowed, sound becomes muffled, and the victim’s movements feel heavy, as if they are wading through thick ink. The illusion is not just visual — it manipulates the target’s emotional state, inducing a creeping sense of dread and inevitability. This makes it especially effective for breaking an opponent’s morale before a decisive strike. This ability is required to have direct eye contact to initiate. The cost of high chakra due to Mangekyō Sharingan strain. Having risks of accelerating the deterioration of her eyesight.
Genjutsu: Monochrome.title: Genjutsu: Monochrome

Genjutsu: Mutual Drowning Separation.description: After letting himself get trapped in a Genjutsu, the user with a simple gesture of the hand casts this technique, while in the illusion world; which by some means correlates to them activating this technique in the real world. This technique has been described as an Illusion Hijacking Technique as it instantly overrides any A-rank or lower genjutsu and makes it seem like the opponent's illusion world is shattering, as it is hit by a massive tsunami and it begins to rain heavily; flooding the entire world. In this illusion, both the user and his opponent appears to drown endlessly in a bottomless pit of an ocean until one of their brains give up and they pass out in the real world. This genjutsu is known to trigger all the five human senses and emulates the sensation of being drowned. It has been confirmed that this illusion hijacking aspect is achieved by casting an illusion on both the
Genjutsu: Mutual Drowning Separation.title: Genjutsu: Mutual Drowning Separation

Genjutsu: One Thousand Deaths.description: One Thousand Deaths is a dangerous genjutsu capable of inflicting a tremendous amount of pain and suffering. With this jutsu it's possible to make the target suffer the pains from several ways of dying in only a blink of an eye, making it somewhat similar to Tsukuyomi. To activate this jutsu, Kitsunekamen only has to make an eye contact with the target. This jutsu usually cannot be escaped, but certain dōjutsu can be theoreticized to be immune to it's effects or to be able to overcome it. Kitsunekamen, despite her ability with genjutsu, can only use this jutsu once in about 8 hours. Once the jutsu has been activated, the user can select from many ways of torment for the target. The effects of this jutsu can be split up to three phases. #Phase One: Painful Death (位相一・痛い死に Isou Ichi: Itaishini) - Phase One uses the pains from ways of death meant to be especially painful bodily. Being expos
Genjutsu: One Thousand Deaths.title: Genjutsu: One Thousand Deaths

Genjutsu: Pleasure.description: Using her Sharingan, Niyo entraps her opponent through eye contact. With the genjutsu, the opponent's negative and hostile feelings towards Niyo are rewired into pure admiration and love for her. After gaining the trust of her enemies, Niyo can then execute them when she pleases.
Genjutsu: Pleasure.title: Genjutsu: Pleasure

Genjutsu: Rinnegan.description: Using their Rinnegan, the user is able to cast a genjutsu strong enough to take control of the nine tailed beasts simultaneously. Unlike other genjutsu, this technique apparently does not subdue the mind of the victim. It can also be used to cast the illusion of an attack onto a victim, resulting in its collapse and a loss of consciousness.
Genjutsu: Rinnegan.title: Genjutsu: Rinnegan

Genjutsu: Rinnegan (KK9999).description: Genjutsu: Rinnegan is a Dōjutsu of the Rinnegan and a much more powerful version of the Genjutsu: Sharingan. It can only be used by those who have awakend their Rinnegan from the Sharingan (people with implanted Rinnegan are unable to use it). This technique allows the user to paralyze one ore more opponents with a single glance. Once an opponent is inflexible, the technique causes similar effects as with Tsukuyomi: The opponent's mind will be trapped in a nightmarish illusion in which the user stabs them with a thousand swords for felt 72 hours. This will cause them physical and psychological pain in the real world, incapacitating them. It even works on multiple enemies and powerful non-human beings like the Tailed Beasts.
Genjutsu: Rinnegan (KK9999).title: Genjutsu: Rinnegan (KK9999)

Genjutsu: Rinnegan (Sigma).description: Using his Rinnegan, is able to cast a genjutsu strong enough to take control of the nine tailed beasts simultaneously. Hagoromo Ōtsutsuki stated that Sasuke can use this technique through a single glance. Unlike other genjutsu, this technique apparently does not subdue the mind of the victim. It can also be used to cast the illusion of an attack onto a victim, resulting in its collapse and a loss of consciousness. * (Mother Wikia's Version) * Genjutsu: Sharingan
Genjutsu: Rinnegan (Sigma).title: Genjutsu: Rinnegan (Sigma)

Genjutsu: Sadistic Oath Of Pain.description: After looking directly at Raygen's eyes, everything around you will turn black and you'll be strapped on a wall full with rusty spikes. Raygen will ask you a couple of questions or force you to confess. In this illusion, Raygen will do cruel experiments on your body, like amputation of limbs and stopping half the way, removal of vital organs and injecting certain types of toxins in the eyes. This is real in the illusion, but nothing of it will be visible in the real world. This genjutsu can be cast just by looking in the eyes, but when you touch the opponent, the effect will be much more effective. When the victim is talking in the illusion, he can also be heard in the real world. Raygen often uses this jutsu for interrogation, or to make someone regrets for what he has done.
Genjutsu: Sadistic Oath Of Pain.title: Genjutsu: Sadistic Oath Of Pain

Genjutsu: Seigaio.description: Genjutsu: Seigaio is the generic use of genjutsu employed by wielders of the Seigaio. By making direct eye contact with someone, the user is able to trap them inside of a genjutsu of their own choosing to achieve different effects. This is commonly used for immobilization more than anything else, however it has also been used for erasing the short term memory of others. * Sui commonly causes her targets to find themselves inside of a world seemingly covered by water with sakurau trees growing up and out of the water's surface. When immobilizing someone it appears as if the person's body has fused with one of the trees, the very branches wrapping around them and shackling them in place.
Genjutsu: Seigaio.title: Genjutsu: Seigaio

Genjutsu: Seigan (Snow).description: The user of this threads a hallucinatory world of swords and mechanical gears, making it seem as if the one who executed the had just transported their opponent to another dimension altogether. When said enemy becomes distracted by the change of scenery is the time at which the wielder can the warp the reality for the them, essentially distorting their sense of what's real and what's not real.
Genjutsu: Seigan (Snow).title: Genjutsu: Seigan (Snow)

Genjutsu: Self-Concealment.description: is a special Genjutsu created by Nisshou Fuyutama in order to hide in plain sight. The technique is always active and is unique in that it is able to fool even the Sharingan. It allows the caster to mask their appearance from all those who observe them. While in the presence of others, the caster can choose to have individuals know their identity, however, once they leave their presence, the person would forget ever meeting the caster. It is cast by using a high-frequency sound that effects the in those caught in the range of the Jutsu. Nisshō developed it to hide his actions during his adventures through time as well as his time infiltrating the Shinobi Union. This is based on the Noble Phantasm of Saber of Red (Mordred)
Genjutsu: Self-Concealment.title: Genjutsu: Self-Concealment

Genjutsu: Sharingan.description: {{JutsuInfobox |ref= |image=Genjutsu Sharingan.png |named=Yes |kanji=幻術・写輪眼 |romaji=Genjutsu: Sharingan |literal english=Illusion Technique: Copy Wheel Eye |other jutsu=Yes |derived jutsu= |jutsu classification=, Genjutsu, Dōjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Offensive, Supplementary |jutsu range=Short |users={{Users |canon=Yes|list= |fanon=Yes|list2= }} |debut manga= |debut anime= |novel debut= |movie debut= |game debut= |jutsu media=Anime, Manga, Novel, Game, Movie }} Genjutsu: Sharingan broadly refers to a range of genjutsu performed with the Sharingan. It has also been shown to be performed through the Sharingan's higher evolutions: the Mangekyō Sharingan and the Rinnegan. By establishing eye contact with a target, the Sharingan user traps them within a genjutsu which can be exploited for one of various purposes, such as: causing instantaneous — but temporary — loss of consciousnes
Genjutsu: Sharingan.title: Genjutsu: Sharingan

Genjutsu: Starry Night.description: By gathering chakra in two points of the body, both thumbs, and touching the opponent with both thumbs, Ikido can cast a Genjutsu on his opponent. Once in the Genjutsu, it is difficult to escape by one's self, of course unless this person has amazing chakra control and can sense Genjutsu. The Genjutsu casts an illusion on the victim, showing a field, a barn, and a starry sky. However, the victim seems to be paralyzed on the field and can only watch as each star comes colliding down repeatedly with no end, each impact making the victim feel as if getting crushed by a meteor. However, in reality, the victim is paralyzed, giving Ikido a chance to strike. However, after one strike, the victim is back in reality and the Genjutsu ends.
Genjutsu: Starry Night.title: Genjutsu: Starry Night

Genjutsu: Sylph.description: Genjutsu: Sylph a unique method of using Genjutsu developed and used by Akari Murakami. It allows her to trap any who come into contact with one of her Wind Release techniques to be trapped in a Genjutsu of her choosing. She usually uses this technique alongside Wind Release: Air Current Wild Dance to control air currents in a wide area allowing her to trap numerous opponents within a large area in a Genjutsu without ever coming close to them or alerting them of her presence. This way of using Genjutsu is easy to understand in concept. When using a Wind Release technique Akari adds yin chakra to the technique. When a Wind Release technique hits someone the yin chakra flows from the wind and into the target's cerebral nervous system thus trapping them in the chosen Genjutsu. *Sylphs are described as invisible beings of air, which is where the concept of the technique came from.
Genjutsu: Sylph.title: Genjutsu: Sylph

Genjutsu: Tenseigan.description: This is an advance genjutsu as employed by Tenseigan wielders. After establishing direct eye contact with the user's opponent/opponents, the user can cast a genjutsu strong enough to control all nine-tail beast along with their jinchūriki completely controlling them. The user can also create an illusion based on the the users worst fear. * Genjutsu: Rinnegan * Genjutsu: Sharingan * Tsukuyomi

infobox.users: Masayoshi/Abilities and Powers, Shirubā Hyuga, Kyo Hyūga

Genjutsu: Tenseigan.title: Genjutsu: Tenseigan

Genjutsu: The Sound of Drums.description: Genjutsu: The Sound of Drums is another of Kisui's Rinnegan techniques. By activating the genjutsu via eye contact, the victim's mind begins repeating a simple pattern. Four drum beats in a second by second loop, constantly repeating in their mind. The sound of it tears away at the victim's mind, leaving them mentally weak until their mental state deteriorates completely, leaving them completely insane. The way this works is it plays havoc on the brain's capabilities of identifying touch, smell, sounds, sights, etc. The brain detects this sound as an anomaly, so it shuts down the auditory senses, rendering them basically deaf. That doesn't work and the sound still plays, so it starts shutting down the senses, one at a time until there's nothing left to shut down. The sound's still playing though, so it does one last thing; One last ditch effort to try and remove the sound. The brain shut
Genjutsu: The Sound of Drums.title: Genjutsu: The Sound of Drums

Genjutsu: The labyrinth of mirrors.description: This is an illusion technique associated with the Kazahan Clan. Using this genjutsu, the user creates a mental trap within the victim’s mind in the form of a vast labyrinth of mirrors. The technique begins by creating a disturbing reflection that the victim briefly catches sight of. Once the victim acknowledges the reflection, the genjutsu takes hold, constructing an endless maze of mirrors within their mind. As the victim attempts to escape, every path leads to another corridor of reflections, causing them to wander aimlessly through the labyrinth. The illusion persists until the victim realizes they have been caught in the genjutsu and successfully disrupts their chakra flow or is freed by an outside source.
Genjutsu: The labyrinth of mirrors.title: Genjutsu: The labyrinth of mirrors

Genjutsu: Torture Chamber.description: This Genjutsu was developed by Zetsumei to damage his enemies brain. He uses it at most of his battles. When he battled Ryuujin Entenka, he used this Genjutsu but failed because it was backfired by Ryuujin's left eye.
Genjutsu: Torture Chamber.title: Genjutsu: Torture Chamber

Genjutsu: Trapping Camelia.description: Takara summons a large pink, translucent flower under the opponent that compresses them inside before exploding. This genjutsu seems to act fast as it is completed only after two seconds; one second for the compressing and another one second for the explosion.
Genjutsu: Trapping Camelia.title: Genjutsu: Trapping Camelia

Genjutsu: Tree Binding Wind Blade.description: A two-fold attack whereby Kurenai first ensnares the opponent in a genjutsu, binding them with trees and then Asuma, using his Chakra Blades finishes them with his Flying Swallow.

Genjutsu: Underworld.description: Genjutsu: Underworld is a powerful genjutsu performed with the Mangekyō Sharingan Dōjutsu and signature to Asana Uchiha. After making eye contact with a target, Asana traps them in an illusion of nightmarish underworld, and relaying destruction due to her unprecedented ability. Additionally, the targets are granted dark experiences and feel the effects of burning up in flames. Overpowering them and making them faint afterwards or intimidated and bringing them to their knees. Sharingan users are able to withstand unconsciousness. Asana noted that this genjutsu can break the spirits of others after experiencing this ability.
Genjutsu: Underworld.title: Genjutsu: Underworld

Gensōkaichō.description: Gensōkaichō (幻想諧調, Phantasmal Melody) is a Kenjutsu fighting style developed by Fūgetsu Soga after training with her Legend Grave ability. The Gensōkaichō was developed by Fūgetsu after she met the spirit of a swords women when training with the Legend Grave. Training with various swordsmen and samurai over the course of her journeys across the world, taking a total of two years to develop. The Gensōkaichō weaponizes much like one of her father's techniques by giving it form with Yin Release. When activated her body is coated in a black energy, and a three eyed spectral entity appears from her back. The entity fights alongside her and is capable of manifesting swords, often mimicking her movements. Though, it is able to act independently from her and follow up her strikes with its own; allowing her to strike multiple times with a single gesture. Fūgetsu is able to cause the entity to pha
Gensōkaichō.title: Gensōkaichō

Gentle Fist Art Descending Stab.description: Taking advantage of the opponent's movements and attempts to block against a physical attack, Seireitou utilizes the Byakugan to pinpoint the vulnerabilities in an opponent's seemingly invincible defense. Whether it is a moment of weakness in the flow of chakra, a natural vulnerability in their movements and energy flow, or even an opening forced upon them in the heat of combat, the Byakugan will find it without fail. And once it is found, Seireitou unleashes a four-fingered Nukite (貫手, "Crossbeam Hand") followed by three fingers, two fingers, and then a single finger; in that descending order. The four thrusts are performed at immense speeds and almost appear to be occurring within the same instant. The purpose of this combination is to first neutralizing the resistance of the opponent's defenses, slowly wearing their defenses down until the final single-fingered thrust manages to tear

Getsurin no Kekkai.description: is an advanced application of the Mangekyō Sharingan technique, Tsukuyomi, which was developed by Kazuhide. Incorporating the usage of the Yin-Yang Release this technique surpasses the effects of basic techniques, encapsulating both the victim and the practitioner in a . Within the confines of this barrier the perception of time becomes skewed and the boundary between reality and illusion blurs. Conceptually, the mechanics of this technique are relatively simple. While standard genjutsu allows the user to take control of the victim's senses through various mediums, this technique claims dominion over a select space. As such, this technique cannot directly inflict phantom sensations upon the victim, but the user is able to control many aspects within the aforementioned boundary. Furthermore, this technique cannot be broken in the same manner as a mere illusion, because the victim's senses
Getsurin no Kekkai.title: Getsurin no Kekkai

Ghost Palm.description: Ghost Palm is the taijutsu style developed by Kaname Soga. Like the Hyuga Clan's Gentle Fist style, Ghost Palm focuses on damaging an opponent's internal organs. When in use, the slightly visible chakra swarms around their hands in a seemingly untamed way, making it feel like ghosts are swirling around their hands, giving it its name. When the chakra makes contact with the opponent's part of the body, it can cause the internal organs to become heavily damaged. Muscles can contract unwillingly and unnaturally, nerves can have the feeling of being stretched out, and bones can be cracked and broken. When utilized properly, the user can destroy internal organs to the point that if inspected with the Byakugan, it would look like the affected areas were "put into a meat grinder". Ghost Palm can also be considered a defensive measure. When trapped in a Genjutsu such as Tsukuyomi, the user can s
Ghost Palm.title: Ghost Palm

Glimpse of Horror Technique.description: Glimpse of Horror Technique (一目の恐れの術, Hitome no Osore no Jutsu) is a very dangerous Genjutsu developed by Kyōsuke. The reason why it is ranked as an A level technique is that it enters the subconscious of the target by manipulating the chakra in their brain to find their biggest fear, by entering that specific part of the brain. After finding that fear, it is reincarnated into an illusion that plays in front of the target using Yin Release. If it was a moment that they had, for instance, the death of a loved one, then that moment is played again in front of them like i just happened. No one is fearless, they must have something that they are horrified from and this technique uncovers it. After seeing that moment, the target should be paralyzed from the site and mentally damaged, which can give the user a chance to attack.
Glimpse of Horror Technique.title: Glimpse of Horror Technique

God: Temple of Nirvana.description: With his mastery over the Temple of Nirvana Technique, Jukan Nara doubles the effects using his senjutsu. Because of this enhancement, the effects are instantaneous, trapping people in genjutsu before they even realize. Escaping this technique is nearly impossible as those under its effects fall asleep instantly. Although it is a powerful genjutsu, it does not take up much Sage Chakra. Even if Jukan dies, the technique won't cancel, similar to the Summoning: Impure World Reincarnation. Jukan taught this technique to Reiko Hōzuki when she mastered her senjutsu skills. Reiko's version is as potent as Jukan's except she can negate one drawback. She can be in her water state when using this. Since victims can't tell where the genjutsu came from, Reiko can avoid being targeted. One major drawback is that Jukan has to stand still to perform the technique. If the opponent is immune to genjutsu,
God: Temple of Nirvana.title: God: Temple of Nirvana

Great World Reincarnation.description: Great World Reincarnation (グレートワールドの生まれ変わり, Gurētowārudo no umarekawari) is a Genjutsu based on making hallucinations and reawakening things of the past with horrid images. The Genjutsu like most Doujutsu based Genjutsu is activated on eye contact with one with the Ketsuryugan upon this happening the now Victim will be sent to a pitch black void where for a while they will see nothing until then the Genjutsu main ability activates. After the Genjutsu looks through the past memories of the victim, The true Genjutsu activates the void will turn dark red after this they will begin to see Visions which all vary from each opponent. For example one may see a dead relative in a different way such as a skeleton with its head cut off, or worse as someone who has commited murder may see the hallucination of their own victims with several weapons in their body. This Genjutsu can even conjure up ent
Great World Reincarnation.title: Great World Reincarnation

Gushkin-banda: Avatamsaka.description: is the quintessence of or rather beyond, utilizing mind, body, soul and spirit in unison to create one of the most powerful genjutsu in existence. This would be considered by some, the first "genjutsu" as it was created three millennia ago in the legendary The Isle of the Blooming Flowers. The Avatamsaka technique is the only genjutsu that affects opponents on the physical level, mental level, spiritual level and the causal level. At its lowest level, the Avatamsaka is able to completely nullify one of the opponent’s five primary senses and will cause immobilization in various parts of the body and minor nerve damage. The damage at the lowest level abolishes of one of their senses however, it is only temporarily; no more than thirty minutes at a time. Gushkin-banda: Condemned Effigy Techniqu.description: This Fuinjutsu named the shows the powerful chakras and fearsome ablilities of The Sage of Enlightenment when attempting to meld his spirit with those of the lower levels of existence. This seal was developed after studying the soul transfer abilities of the Yamanaka clan and having members of the clan train him on the ways to perform this technique, and how the members of such a clan can take over the opponent's body through imposing their soul within a foreign body. Since Gaoh does not have this ability through kekkei genkai, he must write this seal through contact with the opponent's soul which can be done by using the Adramelech seal by touching the opponents body with the seal, and the seal tranceds the physical realm and attaches to the opponents soul. Gaoh does not need to shoot his souls out of his own body using similar signs to an Yamanaka. All of the techniques utilized by Gao
Gushkin-banda: Condemned Effigy Techniqu.title: Gushkin-banda: Condemned Effigy Technique

Gushkin-banda: Demogorge.description: The Path Gold Alignment techniques or rather Gushkin-banda techniques usage are a symbolical and energetic representation of the spiritual illumination and physical transformation of the human race to its perfected state. They are a vibrational melding of etheric wave and human realization, causing a physical, mental, spiritual and soul reaction. All of the techniques utilized by Gaoh are all connected with the usage of his existential abilities and thusly vibrate on a higher frequency of even those of the yin-yang nature types. The Path Gold Alignment techniques are said by the Heavenly Sovereign himself to be above that of even Space-Time Ninjutsu and are even capable of affecting multiple realities if enough chakra is used. With the essence of the imbedded within the Path Gold Alignment techniques, few find possible to surpass them in all their aspects. The most potent of the yin-yang

Gushkin-banda: Diffusion of The Eight Im.description: The might of the Heavenly Sovereign diffused into eight separate entities. is an extremely advanced spiritual technique created by Gaoh Minazuki. Gyakkai Kishō.description: stems from the — a facet of the elder sight known as Gōgan. Its working is a negotiation between sin and story: the ledger of a life is turned backward, line by line, until the ink runs clear — a sanctum where a lifetime can be endured inside a heartbeat. The user inhales deeply, then expertly harmonizes the target’s chakra with their own, weaving it through the intricate sutures of the Gōgan. This is no theft, but a delicate splice—two streams braided together until their identities blur. The sclera of the right eye deepens to obsidian, a candle encased in velvet night. This fleeting gift—the world’s sole mercy—serves as an omen. From the void, a projection emerges, bearing the guise of the user’s face but not their heart. The gas causes hallucinations to anyone who breathes it, which can cause them to see things that aren't really there. In order for the illusion to remain active, the caster must continually exclude the gas throughout the duration of the technique. In order for the technique to be canceled, one must struck that's casting it, but since the user remains hiden throughout the technique, this isn't an easy task. Additionally, keeping the illusion active is quite chakra-taxing, which can lead to the user canceling it to save chakra. While the illusion is active, the caster can not be through most traditional methods, with the exception of contact-type sensing techniques.
Hallucinating Gas Genjutsu.title: Hallucinating Gas Genjutsu

Hankan.description: is a powerful genjutsu created by Gekihen using the Byakugan. Fear is an emotion induced by a threat perceived by living entities, which causes a change in brain and organ function and ultimately a change in behavior, such as running away, hiding or freezing from traumatic events. Fear may occur in response to a specific stimulus happening in the present, or to a future situation, which is perceived as risk to health or life, status, power, security, or in the case of humans wealth or anything held valuable. The fear response arises from the perception of danger leading to confrontation with or escape from/avoiding the threat (also known as the fight-or-flight response), which in extreme cases of fear (horror and terror) can be a freeze response or paralysis. It exists within every single living being, and could range from varying criterias. In the case of shinobi, fear may be a deadly w

Heavenly Illusion: Heaven Viewing Techni.description: A single target, multiple senses jutsu that causes its target to see a pleasurable vision. Like Magen: Narakumi (Demonic Illusion: Hell Viewing), a circle of objects - typically items in quantity nearby such as sand or leaves depending on location - spins and envelops the target before falling away. After that, the world appears normal to the target until they see the vision. Much like its counterpart, this illusion is easy to spot due to the swirling obstruction that occurs as the illusion is anchored to the target. Also, the illusion is best employed if the target is researched enough beforehand that the pleasurable vision is something that they'd find pleasurable.

Heavenly Illusion: Kneel in Fear.description: When this technique is performed, the user emits an omnidirectional wave of chakra that can ensnare multiple target's minds under its illusory effect. Enemies caught in the effect will be engulfed in a powerful fear that takes a hold of their consciousness causing them to imagine multitudes of negative consequences for their actions. In addition to this, the targets will also have intense phantom pains in their legs that may cause them to fall to their knees, thus the name of the technique. Shirokaze Fuyutama has demonstrated the ability to modify this with the use of to remove the requirement of hand seals, but becomes limited to a single target that has made eye contact with him.
Heavenly Illusion: Kneel in Fear.title: Heavenly Illusion: Kneel in Fear

Heavenly Illusion: Painting a Lively Pic.description: This specific illusion is one that, surprisingly, has beneficial effects on the victim. Although this depends on the context used. By making contact with an individual, or simply having influence over their chakra network through a prompt, the user may remove the sensation of pain from the victim of a wound of some sort. This can be used to assist in medical procedures, or more deviously, be used as a means to disallow any reaction to a strike that has occurred. This in turn, can cause individuals to not react to wounds, and therefore, die of symptoms such as blood loss, and the like. However, if one sees the wound, then the technique immediately dissolves, as the visual sensation of seeing the wound would cause the body to produce "pain" to alert the victim.
Heavenly Illusion: Painting a Lively Pic.title: Heavenly Illusion: Painting a Lively Picture of Fantasy

Heavenly Illusion: Perception Overload.description: This technique is reportedly Shirokaze Fuyutama's most powerful and original genjutsu is his arsenal. Using what he had learned from years of training with his he developed a technique designed to debilitate even the most cunning of shinobi. This technique allows the user to alter the target's ability to sense external stimuli in a quite unique way. Under normal circumstances a person is unable to detect stimuli until it has reached an intensity referred to as the absolute threshold. In this way a person is able to block out unnecessary stimuli that would otherwise be distracting and preventative to accomplishing a focused goal. As such the body constantly sends a multitude of sensory signals that aren't registered by the brain. This technique effectively removes the mind's ability to block out these sensations. As such a target under its effect has all of their senses magnified to the p

While this is a positive Genjutsu in some cases, it can also be used as a means to torture those individuals who, in actuality, are extremely fatigued. Because they have a boost in morale, they will continually tire themselves until they are unconsciously moving, despite their body clearly being incapable of doing so.

He has been known to be able to even convince people that he is their "brother" to aid infiltration. During battles, it can convince an opponent that something present on the battlefield isn't, and vice versa. On a weak-willed Chunin or Genin given to rage or sadism, the "eyes" can exert a form of mental control through the Genjutsu.

Additionally, the target loses their motor skills with continued exposure to the ringing. This technique was normally used by Kin Tsuchi after she distracted the enemy with Shadow Senbon.

Illusion of Blades Meeting.description: Illusion of Blades Meeting is a Genjutsu employed by Shusen Nara. By using the sound of blades clashing, or sparking together, Shusen is able to use Sound as a trigger to trap his target in a perceived clash of blades with whatever bladed weapon they would naturally draw. By repeating the sound of clashing blades, Shusen can loop this jutsu even as the target takes damage, by overlapping the disruption of their chakra with another wave of sound that restructures and realigns them with the Genjutsu. This can be used with a typical sword, or a more atypical weapon, like the Antler Blades.
Illusion of Blades Meeting.title: Illusion of Blades Meeting

Illusionary Bells: Cicada Swarm.description: The user runs chakra into one of their bells, causing it to emit an eerie sound like that of a chirping cicada. Anyone other than the user who hears it will have hallucinations that cicadas are swarming. If the illusion is not broken after a minute or two, the cicadas will engulf the hearers. The body will believe the victim to be suffocating, and so will pass out.

Illusionary Cloud Armor.description: A technique which Sujin based on the principles of A's Lightning Release Armor. However, it eventually resulted in something totally unlike the latter. By wrapping his body in a layer of Chakra, Sujin can use his talent for genjutsu to let the chakra act as a medium for it, putting an illusion on anyone who looks at him. Where the victim looks at Sujin doesn't matter, as they begin to succumb to the effects immediately. When the technique is active, the victim will experience trouble focusing their sight on the user, as their vision appears blurred and unstable. The user may seem to have disappeared, or been at several places at once. They find it troublesome to control their own body, the ground and the sky appearing constantly shifting and moving. Executing jutsu becomes harder and harder as time progresses, and eventually, the opponent may become victim to hallucinations and pain, see
Illusionary Cloud Armor.title: Illusionary Cloud Armor

Illusionary Mist.description: The Three-Tails releases a mist created by its chakra to put intruders under an illusion. The illusion torments the target with events from their past. The illusion will vanish if the victim can break the illusion, either by themselves or with the assistance of another.

Infinite Demise Technique.description: Infinite Demise Technique (無限薨去の術, Mugen Kōkyo no Jutsu) is a Genjutsu that uses the concept of Killing Intent and applies it in the form of illusionary torture. The better the user is with Killing intent, the stronger he can push this technique. After weaving the required hand seals, the target goes through hell as he is shown many ways of death. In the illusion, the target dies several deaths, these deaths are intensified and are counting on the user's killing intent as the killing intent is transcribed in the form of illusions. This technique can only be stopped by the target himself with an ordinary Genjutsu break. However, the challenge is to maintain their composure as they live through many deaths as they do not only see how they die, the illusion is accompanied by strong pain sensation. Each illusion starts a few seconds before their death so that they live the moment and feel th

Infinite Demise Technique.title: Infinite Demise Technique

Infinite Fear.description: This is a technique that can only be used by a person of the Kyōgan, The user makes direct eye contact with the target. After this the targets, fear is drawn out of their mind and used against them. Fears can also fight along with the user.

Infinite Ring Genjutsu.description: This extremely powerful illusion, a creation of Hyouya's Kuzu-no-Ha spirit, causes the target to experience freefalling through a curving, colorless cavern, with extremely sharp spikes jutting out from the walls, which the user will try to avoid, by narrower and narrower margins. This technique cannot be broken by conventional means, and usually requires some unusual aid to be broken. While this technique is active, the user is bound to the spot, and will perceive any damage inflicted from the spikes as real. Long enough exposure to this technique will send the target into a coma.
Infinite Ring Genjutsu.title: Infinite Ring Genjutsu

Infinite Spiraling Illusion Technique.description: Infinite Spiraling Illusion Technique is one of the signature techniques of Mugan Uchiha of the Masked Shadows. This genjutsu uses the Sharingan to project it, so it requires no Hand Seals, only an eye contact. Infinite Spiraling Illusion Technique is highly dangerous because it can severely damage the target's mind, possibly leading to permanent mental damage. The downside of this jutsu is it's high chakra cost, making it hard to Mugan to use it in quick succession.
Infinite Spiraling Illusion Technique.title: Infinite Spiraling Illusion Technique

Infinite Tsukuyomi.description: {{JutsuInfobox |tabber=Yes |image1=Infinite Tsukuyomi.png |caption1=A light shines out to the world… |image2=Infinite Tsukuyomi effect.png |caption2=…which entraps the inhabitants in a genjutsu. |named=Yes |kanji=無限月読 |romaji=Mugen Tsukuyomi |literal english=Infinite Moon Reader |other jutsu=Yes |related jutsu=God: Nativity of a World of Trees |jutsu classification=, Genjutsu, Dōjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary |jutsu range=Short, Mid, Long |users= |hand signs=Ram |debut manga= |debut anime= |novel debut= |movie debut= |game debut= |jutsu media=Anime, Manga, Novel, Game, Movie }} The Infinite Tsukuyomi is an extremely powerful genjutsu that traps the entire world in an illusion, enslaving the human and animal populations in a dream so that their chakra may be drawn upon by the God Tree. To cast a genjutsu of this scale, the user's Rinne Sharingan must be reflected off o
Infinite Tsukuyomi.title: Infinite Tsukuyomi

Inner Sakura (RW109).description: broadly refers to a range of techniques performed by Sakura Haruno with her inner self. Inner Sakura is a manifestation of Sakura Haruno's inner emotions, representing Sakura’s actual opinion on things when she outwardly displays something completely different. Inner Sakura has the habit of saying, The phrase has no literal meaning but is usually translated as “Hell yeah!”, “Hell no!”, or “Damn it!”, depending on the situation. The English anime translates it as a forceful “Cha!” Inner Sakura is unique as it is in a way a second will within Sakura’s mind. During the Chūnin Exams, Inner Sakura was strong enough to repel Ino from Sakura’s body when she used the Mind Body Switch Technique on her. In most appearances, Inner Sakura is used as a taijutsu where Sakura’s inner feelings burst out and she unleashes all her strength on the target with one or more punches; however, Inner Sakura may
Inner Sakura (RW109).title: Inner Sakura (RW109)

Instantaneous Mental Bliz Technique.description: By a single glance at the target, the user instantly enters its subconscious, manifesting an ephemeral image of his own body in his mind, the target is paralyzed until the user can exit. The user my either aquire some of the target's memory, learning information and techniques, or simply destroy the victims mind by simply clapping hands. This creates a small black orb that explodes momentarily, leaving the victim permanently incapacitated, and at the user's mercy when the user enters a targets subconscious, the user's body is also immobile, making him vulnerable to attacks by an ally of the target.
Instantaneous Mental Bliz Technique.title: Instantaneous Mental Bliz Technique

Interrogation Genjutsu.description: {{JutsuInfobox |unnamed=Yes |image=Kakkō's Interrogation Genjutsu.png |jutsu classification=Genjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary |jutsu range=Short |users= |debut manga= |debut anime= |novel debut=Naruto: A Shinobi Story |jutsu media=Anime, Manga, Novel }} This is a genjutsu used to break the will of the user's captured target, to make them give up as much information as possible; however, if the target has strong will, the technique will be useless.
Interrogation Genjutsu.title: Interrogation Genjutsu

Invocation of Shadow Hex.description: This technique, which was historically associated with the the art of mysticism, utilizes precise chakra control in order to manipulate an opponent's actions through commands that are relayed via genjutsu. Mystics would commonly use this technique in order to temporarily restrain powerful Yūgure before following up with a potentially lethal technique. After focusing their chakra, which is occasionally aided by the ram hand seal, the user grasps the target's mind and establishes a psychic link. After this is done they are able to send false physical commands into the aforementioned mind. This allows the user to manipulate the user's movement to a degree. This skill is noticeably easier to utilize on those without a strong will, as shown when utilized on Yūgure in the shape of an animal. While this technique cannot take control of a conscious human target completely, it can manipulate thei
Invocation of Shadow Hex.title: Invocation of Shadow Hex

Invocation of the Wavering Shadow.description: This technique allows the user to construct a mental block in order to protect their mind from invasion, which was originally used by ancient mystics to protect themselves from being controlled by Yūgure. This is accomplished by sectioning off a portion of the user's consciousness at the moment they are inflicted with the invasive technique. Therefore, the user of this technique is able to protect the whole of their mind against invasion and instead lead the would-be invader into a mental plane designed to delay the enemy. In this plane both the enemy and the mental projection of this technique's user will meet in what appears to be a shadowy environment, where the invader will be expected to overpower the mental projection to complete their technique. In this case overpowering boils down to defeating the mental projection in combat. Since the invader's technique isn't activated until th
Invocation of the Wavering Shadow.title: Invocation of the Wavering Shadow

Irozu Secret Genjutsu: Paradigm of Corru.description: This technique is a powerful and secret genjutsu created by the Irozu clan, guardians of the daimyo of the Land of Fire. Otoshi Nagare, who is a descendant of the Irozu clan, is capable of using this powerful technique to cripple his foes. After forming the needed hand signals, the user either touches the target, makes eye contact with them, or makes the target hear their voice. Once that is done, the user casts a powerful mental field around them. Within the field, the user is subjected to blindness, being deaf, mute, unable to taste or even feel. Lost in a dark world without their senses, the user is heavily crippled and unable to make any bearings. The genjutsu can debilitate them even better by making them lose their sense of balance, causing the user to become virtually helpless. The user can attack over and over again without a single counterattack being launched. If the user wants
Irozu Secret Genjutsu: Paradigm of Corru.title: Irozu Secret Genjutsu: Paradigm of Corruption

Irozu Secret Genjutsu: World of Shards.description: This is a powerful and secret genjutsu known by the members of the Irozu clan, guardians of the daimyo of the Land of Fire. Otoshi Nagare, a descendant of the Irozu clan, can use this technique to cripple his foes. Aichi Goron learned it by reflecting it back at Otoshi during their battle. After weaving the needed hand signals, the user captures the opponent in a mental field with a touch, eye contact, or making the target hear their voice. Once the target enters the genjutsu, they are thrown into a landscape of trees, grass, and rocks made of pure glass. The target hits the ground and is unable to move. After a few moments, the landscape, including the glass sky, is broken into an innumerable mass of shards that cascade upon the target like an avalanche. Upon the glass crashing upon them, the shards become a raging ocean, tearing and cutting into the opponent relentlessly. For minutes,

Izanagi.description: {{JutsuInfobox |ref= |tabber=Yes |image1=Izanagi 1.png |caption1=When Danzō is hit by Sasuke's Susanoo arrow… |image2=Izanagi 2.png |caption2=…he casts Izanagi to nullify the damage and continue as if nothing happened. |named=Yes |kanji=イザナギ |romaji=Izanagi |other jutsu=Yes |parent jutsu=Creation of All Things |related jutsu=Izanami |jutsu classification=, Genjutsu, Kinjutsu, Dōjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Defensive, Supplementary |jutsu range=Short |users= |hand signs= |debut manga= |debut anime= |game debut= |jutsu media=Anime, Manga, Game }} Izanagi is a unique and powerful genjutsu performed through the Sharingan. , in an effort to make practical use of the technique, had ten Sharingan embedded into his right arm. To use Izanagi to its full potential, users must also have the genetic traits of the Senju, who are also descended from the Sage. Partially for this reason Danzō ha
Izanagi.title: Izanagi

Izanagi (RW109).description: is a dōjutsu of Shisui Uchiha’s Mangekyō Sharingan. With a normal genjutsu, a user will apply an illusion to a target’s senses, causing the target to experience things that are not real. With Izanagi, the user applies an illusion to reality itself, giving the user control over what is and is not real for as long as Izanagi is active. Users typically do this to protect themselves, negating any injuries they receive or even their deaths. When this happens, their injured self fades away as an illusion and their noninjured self immediately materialises in the previous self’s place.Izanagi works similarly to the Creation of All Things Technique, used by the Sage of the Six Paths to turn imagination into reality, using an identical process. The user uses spiritual energy―the basis for Yin Release―to create shape from nothingness followed by applying physical energy―the basis for Yang Release―s
Izanagi (RW109).title: Izanagi (RW109)

Izanagi (Yakujō's Genjutsu).description: Grasping the handle of Tanpopo, Yakujō will use the Wind Release: Deep Breath and blow through the metal tip of Tanpopo. The wind element will release through the hollow staff and release into the the end. The spores will release out of the end. As the spores float through the air, Yakujō will manipulate her chakra through them. When a target looks upon the spores, they will be trapped within the genjutsu. The genjutsu itself, causes the targeted to see the endless spores floating down from the sky. It is almost serene for those who see it and will cause them to drift away. As the technique works, their mind is reacting as slow as the spores fall. In reality, Yakujō will initiate a sharp and focused wind release technique that will finish off the opponent. * The techniques name, Izanagi comes from the Japanese God who gave way to the Gods Amaterasu, Susanno and Tsukiyomi after trying to
Izanagi (Yakujō's Genjutsu).title: Izanagi (Yakujō's Genjutsu)

Izanami (RW109).description: is a dōjutsu of Shisui Uchiha’s Mangekyō Sharingan. Like the various techniques used with the Sharingan and its Mangekyō counterpart, this technique is named after a . In this case, it is , who, together with his sister and wife , created the islands and other deities of .One of the most famous stories about Izanagi tells the tale of how he goes into , the Japanese underworld, to retrieve Izanami after she died giving birth to the Shintō fire god, . In Yomi, he manages to get Izanami and they both try to leave; however, Izanagi was not supposed to look at her before they escape. Right before they reach the exit, Izanagi looks back and sees her in a decayed form. Frightened, Izanagi flees from Yomi and blocks the cave. Izanami curses Izanagi saying that she will kill 1,000 people per day. In response, Izanagi says that 1,500 people will be born each day. In another variation of the story,
