Izanami: Striking Sparrows.description: After performing the hand seal, the user will use Izanami to create various sparrows. Once created the user can manipulate these sparrows to attack the opponent or circle around the user for defensive style similar to the Hyuga's rotation technique. The bird can also be absorbed to replenish small amounts of chakra. The chakra sparrows also have a mind of their own.
Izanami: Striking Sparrows.title: Izanami: Striking Sparrows

Jibakugan.description: This genjutsu brings out the victim's subconscious negative or hateful emotions. The caster can take advantage of these feelings and control the victim's actions. This technique can be cancelled by smelling the , using the Sharingan, or killing the caster. Those who are being controlled by the Jibakugan gains several strange markings under their eyes and on their foreheads. For this technique to be effective, direct eye contact is needed, unless the user's power is sufficient enough to use it without the need of direct eye contact.
Jibakugan.title: Jibakugan

Jump-Style Air Shadow.description: The user jumps forth towards her opponent with a sword strike, leaving a trace of afterimage, which when seen by the target locks them in a genjutsu which causes them to hallucinate multiple swords. With the enemy off guard, the user is free to cut them down.
Jump-Style Air Shadow.title: Jump-Style Air Shadow

Kalki.description: Sacrificial Aspect - Sense of Touch This ability is contained within the right hand of Sakra Devanam Indra. In which it spawns the apocryphal "Kalki" a large sword capable of annihilating anything and everything, physical, spiritual, conceptual. The targets are completely wiped out on every level, to the point that they never even existed, and are totally impossible to recreate by any means. This technique manifests as a single swing of the Kalki, which destroys all matter physical and spiritual this also includes chakra based constructs in a 100km radius, it contains enough power to eradicate the . It works by obliterating the conceptual, spiritual and mental bonds of objects causing them to collapse. This ability even works against Yin–Yang Release techniques, as the sword is not made of chakra but various forms of energy from each existential plane combined into one unique form and th
Kalki.title: Kalki

Kamimusuhi.description: is a unique ability awakened by Kurami Uchiha obtaining the Mangekyō Sharingan after some time, when she had been granted this gift is unknown. Unlike Tsukuyomi’s time control and torturing manners, Kamimusuhi goes a step further than this, and yet Kurami resent Kamimusuhi’s existence. Nightmares are constructed when Kurami activates Kamimusuhi, while only needing to drift those bloody eyes once at the victim, and have locked it for at the very least four seconds. Within a fragment of a millisecond Kamimusuhi throws the victims into a world of darkness, crawling into their mind with those dark, cruel nightmares to unlock those deepest and darkest memories, and use these to birth them into a new illusionary world. Whereas time and torture is the key of Tsukuyomi, Kamimusuhi builds an entire world to break the mind of the trapped apart, to recall their own memories in a realistic way. Feed
Kamimusuhi.title: Kamimusuhi

Kamiyonanayo.description: Kamiyonanyo ((神世七代, Seven Generations of the Age of Gods) is a genjutsu of exceptional caliber, formed through the utilization of the . It was a technique developed by Shinpachi Nomura in order to effectively combat the native to the . In order to even begin the genjutsu, a great deal of comprehension and experience using the Yin Release are requirements; as well as countless hours of meditation. To begin, Kamiyonanyo is not a technique that is consciously activated by the user; it is a reflex of sorts which has been programmed into the mind itself. Through the repetitious introduction of Yin-themed chakra to the brain, the body gains the ability to recognize the internal presence of this nature transformation in an instant. This means that, upon being ensnared by an enemy's , the body's extensive "training" in the recognition of Yin-based chakra, which is the foundation of all illusions
Kamiyonanayo.title: Kamiyonanayo

Kiryū Gensō.description: Kiryū Gensō (気流幻想, Literally: Illusory Air Current) is the trademark technique style of Megami Otsuihō which utilizes infrasonic pulses of sound, generated via the , in order to facilitate illusions. As utilizing sound do not require direct contact between the user and their victims, techniques derived from Kiryū Gensō allow the user to remain hidden while implementing their illusions. Furthermore, Megami has demonstrated that illusions stemming from this technique can ensnare multiple enemies simultaneously, and that she can set up persistent illusions that effect areas rather than individuals. It is through this technique that Megami has received the majority of her recognition over the years. On a side note, Megami has demonstrated the ability to detect, and counteract, sound based illusions with greater ease due to her use of this technique. While not a direct product of this techniq
Kiryū Gensō.title: Kiryū Gensō

Kitsune Kenbu: Shinikajuen.description: Kitsune Kenbu: Shinikajuen - Fox Sword Dance: Orchard of Death *Rank: A *Range: -- *Element: -- *Users: Kouseitan'i Clan The user begins this genjutsu by focusing a large amount of chakra into their eyes. They then look the opponent in the eyes and implant the chakra there. The user then chooses when to activate the genjutsu trapping them in an fake world, which normally looks like a flowering orchad though settings may vary with user. The user then attacks the opponent in the genjutsu, but the attacks dont appear physically as most attacks to the body would. Instead they target the bodies circulatory, nerve, and chakra systems. If the damage is enough the user wont be allowed to move let alone heal and if the damage is too severe it may even result in death.
Kitsune Kenbu: Shinikajuen.title: Kitsune Kenbu: Shinikajuen

Kitsune's Song.description: Ayumi in her half transformed state, sings a beautiful yet enchanting song that is used to lure her opponent's to her or control her opponent's mind. Ayumi usually uses this technique while hunting, however she won't hesitate to use it during battle. Opponent's with a strong will are resistant to this technique
Kitsune's Song.title: Kitsune's Song

Kotoamatsukami.description: {{JutsuInfobox |ref= |image=Kotoamatsukami.png |named=Yes |kanji=別天神 |romaji=Kotoamatsukami |literal english=Distinguished Heavenly Gods |jutsu classification=, Genjutsu, Dōjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary |users= |debut manga= |debut anime= |game debut= |jutsu media=Anime, Manga, Game }} Kotoamatsukami is a Mangekyō Sharingan dōjutsu that casts a powerful yet subtle mind-controlling genjutsu on the target. The technique allows the user to enter the mind of any individual within their field of view, and manipulate them by giving them false experiences, making it seem as if they were doing things of their own free will. It is regarded as a genjutsu of the highest calibre, due to the victim being entirely unaware that they are being manipulated. As a testament to its power it was strong enough to even negate Kabuto Yakushi's control over a reincarnated Itachi Uchiha, desp
Kotoamatsukami.title: Kotoamatsukami

Kotoamatsukami (RW109).description: is the signature dōjutsu of Shisui Uchiha’s two Mangekyō Sharingan, casting a powerful yet subtle mind-controlling genjutsu on a target without their knowledge. The technique allows the user to enter the mind of any individual within their field of view, and manipulate them by giving them phantom experiences, making it seem as if they were doing things of their own free will. Even if one is informed they are under Kotomatsukami, like Asashi for example, the target(s) will remain under Kotoamatsukami until death due to being the most imperceptible genjutsu in the world. Noted as Shisui Uchiha’s ultimate technique, it was highly coveted by Danzō, who later stole Shisui’s right eye and had it implanted into his own right eye-socket to gain access to this dōjutsu. Shortly thereafter, Shisui entrusted his remaining eye to Itachi Uchiha, who implanted it into the eye-socket of one of his crows

Kotoamatsukami: Beam of Light.description: {{JutsuInfobox |named=Yes |image=Kotoamatsukami Kobo.png |kanji=別天神・光芒 |romaji=Kotoamatsukami: Kōbō |literal english=Distinguished Heavenly Gods: Beam of Light |game names=Kotoamatsukami: Kobo |parent jutsu=Kotoamatsukami |jutsu classification=, Dōjutsu, Genjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Offensive |users= |game debut= |jutsu media=Game }} The user places the opponent under a genjutsu using Kotoamatsukami, which shows a large Mangekyō Sharingan that shines down rays of light to blast the opponent.

Kouseitani Clan Naibun Genjutsu: Shougai.description: Kouseitan'i Clan Naibun Genjutsu: Shougai no Butai - Kouseitan'i Clan Secret Genjutsu: Assault of the Elements *Rank: SS *Users: Kouseitan'i Clan The user focuses a small amount of chakra into their eyes and looks at the opponent. If the opponent is looking in their eyes at the same time the seeds for the genjutsu is automatically planted. The user can then choose when to activate the jutsu by forming the last handseal. This genjutsu will then activate and warp the opponents view of reality until they are standing on what looks like a blank slate. Then without warning flames, torrents of water, lightning bolts, horrendous gusts of winds, and earthquakes will begin to rock them until they collapse from mental strain.
Kouseitani Clan Naibun Genjutsu: Shougai.title: Kouseitani Clan Naibun Genjutsu: Shougai no Butai

Kuchisake-onna.description: Kuchisake-onna (口裂け女, Slit-Mouthed Woman) is a powerful illusion incorporating the use of Kirigakure's signature mist as well as the Magen: Kyōka Suigetsu. It is recognised by Heiwa as his most horrific and twisted illusion due to the traumatic side-effects victims whom it was face. By forming a thick mist full with the user's chakra, said user can then apply the Yin Release to the technique, casting an illusion which the mist dissipates but the user's presence is also erased. A slit-mouthed ghostly woman also appears from behind the victim, whom soon becomes paralyzed. The user is then mutilated slowly. Whilst feeling the entire pain of having their limbs removed from them, the victims are incapable of falling asleep nor are they capable of death. Their very own flesh is then eaten before their very own eyes, before the woman begins to bulge out the tongue of the target, and then the ey

Kuchisake-onna.title: Kuchisake-onna

Kuebiko (Ender).description: Kuebiko is a Genjutsu Mangekyō Sharingan technique created and used by Seikan Uchiha. Though not a separate technique bound to one eye, it uses the Mangekyō Sharingan. To use it, a wielder of a Mangekyō Sharingan focuses their eyes to have the pinwheel pattern spin in a hypnotic manner. If the target looks into the eyes while Kuebiko is being used, they are put into a trance-like state where the user of Kuebiko can control their movements. Doing this takes a lot of mental concentration and so the user cannot move while using it.
Kuebiko (Ender).title: Kuebiko (Ender)

Kuiaratame.description: Kuiaratame (悔い改め} Kuiaratame is a very powerful form of illusion that rivals kotoamatsukami and infinite tsukuyomi in terms of strength is as powerful as kotoamatsukami except that Yasuhiro with his right eye can not only lock the victim into undetectable genjutsu but also chew his will or ideology against the victim. as Yasuhiro presented when he used the body of Kenta Setsuki as he wanted, with the left eye the user can chew an illusion and create beasts with yin energy these creatures correspond to the nightmares of defeated opponents and they cannot be changed, moreover, when Yasuhiro focuses strongly, he can even confuse to such an extent that he could casually end a war with a simple glance.
Kuiaratame.title: Kuiaratame

Kōga-ryū.description: Kōga-ryū is a multipurpose fighting style that the Koga Guild teach their shinobi. Unlike normally fighting style it isn't restricted to a single method of fighting, but instead is about giving its users a way to be prepared for anything. Kōga-ryū is fundamentally different from all other fighting styles. This is because unlike other fighting styles it doesn't have an organized method of fighting with certain rules. It is a fighting style that is a lot more flexible to the point that learning other fighting style is part of its training. This led opponents to describing Kōga-ryū as "unorthodox", "dishonorable", or "unfair" because of how limitless Kōga-ryū's potential is and just how far shinobi of the fighting style are willing to go to achieve their goals. The reason for this comes from how Kōga-ryū isn't a fighting style to teach Koga shinobi how to fight. It is a fighting to teach Ko

Lament of Sanzu River.description: is a powerful that seemingly stems from Koyomi’s Kindō Byakugan which traps the target into a seemingly endless illusion that forces them to live out the entirety of their life on a mental plane and eventually finds themselves upon the shores of the Sanzu river upon death in said illusion. As what can be assumed from the unique application of the technique, it takes more than a cunning intellect to understand the predicament. By using a seemingly flawless method of chakra control, Koyomi can initiate the technique unsuspectingly. She calls it the River of Lost Dreams and Hopes. To initiate the technique, Koyomi gathers a massive amount of yin chakra along with subtle amounts of natural yang energy into the core of her body. From this point, Koyomi is capable of releasing the stored chakra through her own Water Release techniques most notably, the Gōuyōka. When this massive amount of chak
Lament of Sanzu River.title: Lament of Sanzu River

Leaf Whistle Genjustu.description: A sound genjutsu made by whistling through a leaf infused with chakra. Due to the fact that this is a sound-based genjutsu, it doesn't require the enemy to look at the user for the genjutsu and it can be used from a distance which is a great advantage against other genjutsu which require eye-contact. The effects of the genjutsu depend on the notes the user is playing through the leaf either putting them to sleep, paralyzing them etc. Kuhaku Mugen had such a mastery over this technique which earned him the moniker "Whistler of the Leaves". This technique can effect multiple targets.
Leaf Whistle Genjustu.title: Leaf Whistle Genjustu

Leaf-Style Phantom Blade.description: Leaf-Style Phantom Blade (木ノ葉流迷夢剣, Konoha-Ryū Meimuken) is a technique developed in Konohagakure. Famous amongst the Kinsei clan, used by many swordsmen in Konoha. It's based on an ancient Konoha Kenjutsu technique called Leaf-Style Willow, which was used in the past as a way to deceive the opponent. Years later, this technique was designed simply to make the Leaf-Style Willow a fighting style. For proficient users of this technique, it can be used with each blade strike as it takes little chakra and is based upon a simple method. It's mostly used to deceive the opponent or to confused them seconds before the strike. This technique simply creates multiple illusions of the user's arm and blade while striking in order to confuse the opponent of where the strike is coming from. As only one of these arms are real. The user can create ten or eleven illusion arms that start from his shoulders
Leaf-Style Phantom Blade.title: Leaf-Style Phantom Blade

Leaf-Style Willow.description: The user waves their sword back and forth, which when seen by the target locks them in a genjutsu which causes them to hallucinate multiple waving arms. The movement resembles that of a blowing in the wind. With the enemy off guard, the user is free to cut them down. Kama Uchiha noted this technique to bear a resemblance to his Nise Tengoku, though on a smaller scale than the latter. Kumogumo can use this technique with a kunai.

infobox.users: Kojima Uchiha, Haiiro Kurama, Hizashi Yamanaka, Chiyo Nara, Danzō (Clone), Inabi Uchiha (Sparks), Kumogumo, Kaimiko Uchiha, Mitarashi Uchiha, Souma Nara, Omoi Uchiha, Hibiki Kiyoshi, Kato Kenshin, Rin Towa, Dan Shimura, Kareha Kurosaki, Itachi Amahara, Temari Uchiha, Saizen Kinsei,Kosuke Maruboshi, Akichua Kobayashi, Ryusuke Sanada, Meiro Uzumaki, Kashikoi Sukiru, In'ei, Shisō, Rue, Yozoraōka, Haigara Sarutobi, Maneshitsugumi, Yagura (1kidney), Temujin, Kama Uchiha, Heiwa Uchiha, Gekihen, Temujin (KushimaruFuma), Kōga Nara, Asaka Uchiha (DP), Raikou Waka, Ryo Sakai

Leaf-Style Willow.title: Leaf-Style Willow

Light and Dark Exorcism Arts of Togakush.description: This is a Hiden, or secret technique, that is also sometimes referred to as spiritual puppetry. Much like the true puppetry technique, it involves the manipulation of an inanimate physical body, such as that of a puppet. For that matter the limitations of this technique follow along with the average limitations of a puppeteer, in regards to the number of bodies that can be manipulated at once and the ranks of the puppets involved. For this technique, Gaoh must concentrate a ghostly soul into one of his hands and combine it with the Sage of Enlightenment chakra. After that point, he will have to make contact with the desired object, which will then become infused with the deceased soul used in this technique. The soul will spread into the new body, and the puppet well then be able to be controlled by Gaoh much of the same way that a puppet is manipulated by a puppeteer. While no strings e
Light and Dark Exorcism Arts of Togakush.title: Light and Dark Exorcism Arts of Togakushi

Lightning Illusion Static Genesis.description: By converting one's chakra into countless microscopic electrical sparks through which the user will coordinate complex signaling to the target's nerves, thereby creating illusory objects or areas. Due to the method of performance, this technique requires incredibly masterful chakra control, which may at times make it difficult to perform other techniques while maintaining Lightning Illusion Static Genesis. To coincide with the inherent difficulty of this technique, its effects are incredibly potent. Since this technique activates the target's nervous system directly, it can cause illusory effects that target all of the opponent's senses at once, including chakra sensory if the user desires. Due to this fact victims of this technique commonly fail to realize that they are under the effects of a genjutsu. This particular static based illusion is utilized to create either illusory objects,
Lightning Illusion Static Genesis.title: Lightning Illusion Static Genesis

Lightning Illusion Static Lock.description: By converting one's chakra into tiny electrical sparks, the user will signal the targets nervous system in complex patterns. This signaling is intended to create an illusion scenario where the target is immobilized, often with their arms bound. Due to the state that this technique leaves an opponent in, they cannot generally break the illusion through the normal genjutsu release. Furthermore, due to the method of activation this technique may not be recognized as an illusion by the victim, which leaves them in a dangerous situation indeed. The main purpose of this technique is to immobilize a target, even if it is for a moment, so that the user can buy time for either themselves or allies. A variation of this technique causes the target to be dealt a great amount of illusory pain upon the victim, which may cause them to pass out immediately. It should be noted that the practitioner of th
Lightning Illusion Static Lock.title: Lightning Illusion Static Lock

Lightning Illusion Static Repulse.description: This two part technique allows a user to disrupt their own chakra flow, usually to break a genjutsu, and immediately follow up with illusory assault of their own. The first part of this technique is accomplished by falsely triggering one's own nerves with complex electrical signals via the Lightning Release. While this method will usually dispel nearly all normal genjutsu, it is much less effective against top tier illusions. Such illusions will require the user to increase the strength of electrical charges used to free themselves. While this sounds simple enough, increasing the strength of these artificial signals will result in adverse effects upon the user. Such effects include a backlash of phantom fatigue and pain, but may be less dangerous than remaining under the effects of a powerful genjutsu. The second part of this technique consists of counterattack targeting the opponent's n
Lightning Illusion Static Repulse.title: Lightning Illusion Static Repulse

Lightning Release: Lightning Illusion Fl.description: {{JutsuInfobox |ref= |image1=Raigen Raikōchū Manga.png |caption1=The technique depicted in the manga. |image2=Lightning Flash Pillar.PNG |caption2=The technique depicted in the anime. |tabber=Yes |named=Yes |kanji=雷遁 • 雷幻雷光柱 |romaji=Raiton: Raigen Raikōchū |english tv=Lightning Illusion: Flash Pillar |other names=Lightning Style: Flash Pillar |jutsu classification=Genjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary |jutsu range=Short, Mid, Long |users= |hand signs= |other jutsu=Yes |derived jutsu=● Allied Shinobi Forces Technique |debut manga= |debut anime= |game debut= |jutsu media=Anime, Manga, Game }} The Lightning Release: Lightning Illusion Flash of Lightning Pillar is a genjutsu that utilizes Lightning Release. The user discharges electricity through their entire body in the form of an extremely bright light to disorientate their target's vision. Once this is done, the user can i
Lightning Release: Lightning Illusion Fl.title: Lightning Release: Lightning Illusion Flash of Lightning Pillar

Lightning Release: Storm Paradise.description: After doing the required seals, the user will take the victim to an illusionary cloud puff. Then, the clouds begin to turn black and lightning strikes the victim severely. In reality, the victim becomes paralyzed due to them believing they have been struck.
Lightning Release: Storm Paradise.title: Lightning Release: Storm Paradise

Living Nightmare Technique.description: The Living Nightmare Technique is a special technique created by Ezemaru Kimza a few years before the events of Kimza Chronicles. It soon becomes his signature technique and is considered one of the most powerful genjutsu in existence as well as an incredible feat for a Kimza, who has little talent in genjutsu. Daigaru Meitochi learned it in The Last Sealer after gaining power of the Guardian Beast Chakra Form. After gathering and molding enough chakra, the user rendes the target to sleep by either eye contact, a touch to the forehead, or an illusion genjutsu. It can also be used when the target is already asleep. After the target has fallen asleep, the user sends a mental form of themselves into the target's minds. Then, they activate the imagery part of the brain. From there, the user can manipulate the target's REM patterns, creating dreams for them. In the dreams, the user has access

infobox.users: Akari Murakami, Ezemaru Kimza, Bukarok, Daigaru Meitochi

Living Nightmare Technique.title: Living Nightmare Technique

Lovely Ladies of the Leaf.description: Lovely Ladies of the Leaf or Harem of the Eyes is a Genjutsu technique created by Happosai Hanju. This technique was created to distract interlopers who get in the way of Happosai's peaking, stealing, and any other action he uses when he is just being a big pervert. It is also done as his mental trophy to show all the women he has peeked. The Genjutsu seals the target in a mental world where all the beautiful women of The Hidden Leaf Village are gathered inside of a bathhouse. Each women has there form displayed in the way Happosai remembers them and his accuracy in shape comes from his superb peaking skills and transformation skills. Super effective against perverts and a berserk button of any women who sees themselves in it with great detail.
Lovely Ladies of the Leaf.title: Lovely Ladies of the Leaf

Magen: Denkōsekka.description: Magen: Denkōsekka (魔幻:電光石火, Evil Illusion: That Which Matches the Speed of Lightning), is known as a high-speed movement based technique, that has allowed Yamanaka Akihiko to remain one of the fastest shinobi in all of the Hidden Leaf. That however is a deception, in reality, Akihiko employs a very subtle but powerful genjutsu that makes it appear as though he simply disappears and reappears before his adversary when reality he is manipulating their perception of time. Due to the speed in which this technique is employed, occurring at window of barely a fraction of a second, its true effect remains a mystery to the world at large.
Magen: Denkōsekka.title: Magen: Denkōsekka

Magen: Heki Chisoki.description: Magen: Heki Chisoki - Demonic Illusion: False Speed Technique *Rank: SS *Range: Mid (0~15m) *Users: Emanyeru Kouseitan'i *Clan: Kouseitan'i Clan The user begins this jutsu by infusing their eyes with chakra while concentrating on the genjutsu at hand. After doing so they only need to establish eye contact for a brief period of ten seconds before being fully implanted into the opponents system. The user can then choose the time that the genjutsu will take effect and strike. Please not that this jutsu does not allow you to control time. It only allows you to affect the way the opponent perceives time around them. For the genjutsu to really be taken into effect, it is best to have the user in a completely calm and relaxed state that does not show motion. That will allow it to be much harder for the opponent to recognize a genjutsu simply because the user has not moved enough to tell any dif
Magen: Heki Chisoki.title: Magen: Heki Chisoki

Magen: Kyōka Suigetsu.description: Magen: Kyōka Suigetsu (鏡花水月, lit. Evil Illusion: Flowers Reflected on a Mirror and the Moon Reflected on the Water's Surface) is a powerful genjutsu dojutsu that ensnares the mind of its victims, making them completely oblivious to the presence of the caster; they are unable to see him, smell him, hear him or sense him in any capacity.
Magen: Kyōka Suigetsu.title: Magen: Kyōka Suigetsu

Magen: Saimin no Jutsu.description: Magen: Saimin no Jutsu (魔幻:催眠術) is a low-level but extremely versatile genjutsu dojutsu used by Yamanaka Akihiko. Using the eyes as a medium, Akihiko is able to instantly trap his victims in an illusion of his choosing. While temporarily the illusion is cast quickly and multiple illusions can be layered in seconds, making this an invaluable tool for any shinobi.
Magen: Saimin no Jutsu.title: Magen: Saimin no Jutsu

Magnet Release: Demonic Illusion.description: After gathering magnet chakra in their hand, the user snaps their finger towards an opponent. This causes an invisible E.M.P to surge toward the opponent. Upon contact with the intended object the user can employ different effects.
Magnet Release: Demonic Illusion.title: Magnet Release: Demonic Illusion

Mangekyō Sharingan: Advanced Reverse Dim.description: This is a more advanced form of Sharingan: Reverse Dimension. Now, in the victim's mind, all sense of direction is altered. The left is up. Up is right. Right is down. Down is left. The back is the front and the front is the back. Northwest is Southeast. Southeast is Southwest. Southwest is Northeast. And Northeast is Northwest. This is very difficult for the victim to master because not only are the rules applied when they move, but it is also applied where they see their opponent go and attack. Thinking about all these things is a very challenging task. However, the user is not affected. Inspired by a Bleach Technique used in the Aizen Saga.
Mangekyō Sharingan: Advanced Reverse Dim.title: Mangekyō Sharingan: Advanced Reverse Dimension

Mangekyō Sharingan: Blind Eye.description: A very powerful Genjutsu. By using the Mangekyō Sharingan, the user can put the victim in a state where all senses, but the sense of touch/feeling, are disabled for five minutes. The victim can't see, hear, smell, or taste for a whole five minutes. Since this is a Mangekyō technique, this does put strain on the body.
Mangekyō Sharingan: Blind Eye.title: Mangekyō Sharingan: Blind Eye

Medical Illusion: Desiccation Nightmare.description: The is a powerful that was created by an unknown member of the who was once a member of the . This powerful technique was created by a member of the who'd been apprenticed to during the . Created with the intent of assisting medics who wound up in a dangerous situation for one reason or another, it combines the Kurama Clan's signature genjutsu affinity and the extreme precision of to create a truly devastating illusion. After first making contact with their target in some fashion, the user injects a great volume of chakra within the target's body that affects them on the cellular level. This in turn gives the caster complete dominance of said cells, which are then given a dark and devastating command—cease and desist. Completely shutting down, these dead cells are then ruptured; inducing sudden and extreme that destroys the victim's body from the inside out. This cell degradation is swif
Medical Illusion: Desiccation Nightmare.title: Medical Illusion: Desiccation Nightmare Technique

Melody of Deception.description: Melody of Deception (旋律の虚偽, Senritsu no Kyogi) is a technique created and utilized by Yūgetsu. He uses his flute in order to perform the technique. This jutsu is the base of all his melody related Genjutsu. This technique can be used as generic Genjutsu and the sounds it makes can be used as a substitution hand seal to perform specific Genjutsu. Each specific Genjutsu has a specific melody that needs to be played in order to initiate the Genjutsu effectively. The function of the technique is very simple. Yūgetsu plays the flute as a distraction to the opponent's ears, which acts as a trigger to the Genjutsu. Waves of chakra are fired with each melody. They disturb the chakra of the opponent slightly, giving Yūgetsu the chance to trap them under his Genjutsu, which shouldn't be difficult considering the trigger that was initiated with the sound of the flute. The opponent is immediately tr
Melody of Deception.title: Melody of Deception

Meshita.description: {| align=center style="background:transparent;" | valign=center | This article, , is property of Jumpy Naruto. |} Meshita ((名) 若者, literally meaning young) is a genjutsu that forces the opponent to believe that he/she is a child.It is known to be quite effective as,as long as the genjutsu is in effect,the opponent can be killed very easily.The Meshita unlike most genjutsu does not last for long and has a limited time that it can remain in effect,usually ten minutes.This jutsu requires a lot of chakra as the area of the brain the user manipulates is quite complex and so a large amount of chakra is needed to pull of the jutsu effectively.It is very comedic to see your opponent lying on the ground crying their eyes out and screaming for milk.This jutsu is known to be used very frequently by Ninja Jesters.
Meshita.title: Meshita

Midnight Mare.description: The Midnight Mare is a powerful lingering genjutsu that revolves around manipulating dream when the target fall asleep. The technique allows the user to manipulate and control the dream of the target when they fall asleep. It is a rather special genjutsu because of its activation criteria and the effect could linger for days before dissipating away. Upon activation, the user will have total control of the flow and construct of the dream until the target is aware that it was just a dream. During the timespan, the user could take the opportunity to extract important information from them and even instil fear in their subconscious, weakening them in the subsequent war or fight. Those with weak mentality may not be able to break through the genjutsu by themselves and will usually starve to death if the caster do not cancel it manually. __NOEDITSECTION__
Midnight Mare.title: Midnight Mare

Mikaboshi.description: is a known technique that stems from the Inreki Clan, which has been passed onto to the evident members that inherited the strong spiritual chakra of their ancestor. It allows the user to manipulate the elements through that is affecting the senses in the brain of the , essentially affecting the of the targeted individuals. Initially the user amplifies the existing genjutsu to subsequently transfer some of the chakra to the hypothalamus that affects the thermoception, thus the sense of feeling and touch. This essentially allows Mikaboshi to be used as a layered genjutsu, significantly enhancing the potency of standard illusions that mimic elemental natures. *Amatsu-Mikaboshi (天津甕星, "August Star of Heaven"), also called Ame-no-Kageseo (天香香背男, "Brilliant Male"), is a god of evil and of the stars, specifically the pole star
Mikaboshi.title: Mikaboshi

Mind's Eye.description: This genjutsu focuses on the opponent's nerves and mind, and targets them by using the collected information to project the opponent's worst fears and nightmares. It is said that this technique is powerful enough to cause the nerves of the opponent to become temporarily paralyzed.
Mind's Eye.title: Mind's Eye

Mirror Release: Serial Confusion.description: The ability of this powerful Genjutsu is to control the five senses to the point that it can make the target misinterpret another person's form, shape, mass, feel and smell to be that of the enemy. It also requires the victim to make eye contact with Riyan's left Mangekyo in order for that person to be trapped. The one downfall to this technique is that the illusions shatter upon deactivating the Mangekyo. For this reason, Riyan is forced to keep his Mangekyo activated for long periods of times if he wishes illusions to persist. There is some compensation for this weakness, though it isn't massive; after a foe has seen the left Mangekyo, they are doomed to be trapped in it again and again every time the technique is activated. However, even this has a drawback, which is, in fact, also a drawback to the technique's overall illusionary capabilities. If a foe can figure out how the illusion
Mirror Release: Serial Confusion.title: Mirror Release: Serial Confusion

Mist Servant Technique.description: {{JutsuInfobox |ref= |image=Mist Servant Technique.png |named=Yes |kanji=霞従者の術 |romaji=Kasumi Jūsha no Jutsu |english tv=Misty Follower Jutsu |jutsu rank=D |jutsu classification=Genjutsu, Clone Techniques |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary |users= |debut manga= |debut anime= |novel debut= |game debut= |jutsu media=Anime, Manga, Novel, Game }} This technique creates several ghost-like figures clad in black that emerge from the surrounding environment. When uses this technique, the figures are somewhat similar in appearance to him, but are not his exact lookalikes in the same that other clone techniques resemble their users. The black figures move slowly towards their target, provoking the target into attacking. Each time the figures are struck, the attacks pass through them, only briefly disfiguring their form. With each attack they receive, the figures multiply. Because this is
Mist Servant Technique.title: Mist Servant Technique

Mountains and Forests Sutra.description: is a technique crafted by Hijiko Kakurerakudo that is based among his fundamemtal reasonings of duality. The personality of the nonself brought forth distinguished attributes from multiple nature transformations which resulted in such a stoic jutsu. The nativity of the world's forest. Hijiko states that this technique is product of his first titillating encounter with natural energy and thus, it maybe classified as senjutsu. It is also known as one of the . This technique can only be performed by merging one's on life force with the surrounding natural energy via the Kaihōgyō Shingon Kakushin and merging Earth Release, Water Release and Yang Release in equal ratios. Upon creating the Mirrored Snake hand seal, massive grove of titanic trees immediately rise in the air from virtually any contactable surface aside from the ebb and flow of water and lava. Within an instant, massive trees wit
Mountains and Forests Sutra.title: Mountains and Forests Sutra

Movement Masking.description: Movement Masking is a technique where the user educes a genjutsu around their vicinity and mask their movements. For example, when throwing a left hook, people can tell a person is about to throw one because of the movement of their arm. Another movement would be a liner dash, the opponent would be able to tell a straight movement. Its the same thing with just about most movements, but with this technique, the user can mask those movements making it impossible to predict what they are about to do. It almost makes the user invisible unless they don't move which in a fighting situation is almost never. To make the technique even more difficult to deal with, it isn't just one genjutsu, it a continuous genjutsu the user does using Yin Release. So if broken, a few seconds later the genjutsu will just be educed again as long as they keep funneling Yin Release chakra into the genjutsu.
Movement Masking.title: Movement Masking

Mugenjō.description: is a an addition-line ability: one of the aspects of illusion mastery. Seemingly simple, it is used to refer to the act of "layering" genjutsu: interweaving a genjutsu for back-to-back casting, or hiding a "timed" genjutsu within another one. However, it should be noted that Mugenjō is not a separate technique and is in fact more a skill: developed for the purpose of enhancing one's illusionary prowess. In its mechanics, Mugenjō is very simple. When a genjutsu is cast, those who are affected will attempt to break free: be it through a genjutsu dissipation, outside help, or even sheer willpower. While succession varies (factoring the power of the illusion, the casters genjutsu prowess, chakra cost, overall determination, etc), an attempt of some kind will be made regardless. This illusionary ability is meant to make the succession rates of said attempts as low as possible. After placing s
Mugenjō.title: Mugenjō

Mushroom Spore Technique.description: The Takehoushi no Jutsu (Kanji: 茸胞子の術; English: Mushroom Spore Technique) is a Ninjutsu/Genjutsu utilized by the mushrooms. It allows them to expend chakra as a means of producing spores that are disproportionately high in spiritual energy. The spores' excess of spiritual energy allows them to be utilized both as a means of ensnaring one's target(s) within an illusion as a result of the target(s) inhaling the spores and as explosive fuel for the Immortal Fires of Samādhi.
Mushroom Spore Technique.title: Mushroom Spore Technique

Mutability of All Senses Technique.description: Mutability of All Senses Technique (万感無常の術,Bankan mujō no jutsu) is foul technique originating from a dark beast. This technique is a corruption of the imagination governing and form creation of via the infusion of . * Due to originating from the Namashiki those that possess its chakra are able to use this technique. Along with this individuals that obtain the Heretical Yin Seal can use it. Since the transmigration of Valden, this technique has become an ability that a Hametsugan user can awaken.
Mutability of All Senses Technique.title: Mutability of All Senses Technique

Negative Emotions Suppression Seal.description: {{JutsuInfobox |named=Yes |kanji=阿閦如来 |romaji=Akshobhya |jutsu classification=Hiden, Genjutsu, Fūinjutsu |nature type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary |users= |jutsu media=Anime, Manga }} The Negative Emotions Suppression Seal is a hiden technique that combines fūinjutsu and genjutsu to manipulates the user's mind to suppress intense emotions. This technique, similar to Izanagi, is self-induced and only works on the user. This technique is sealed into the brain by simply placing a palm on their or another person's head. When the person with the technique sealed is overwhelmed by sudden emotions, this technique is triggered, inducing an illusion whereby the user is reminded of the good and just they have done whilst simultaneously adding more positive emotions or Yang, forcibly, into their brains. This allows them to overcome any darkness cast upon them as the technique balances any amoun
Negative Emotions Suppression Seal.title: Negative Emotions Suppression Seal

Nensha.description: Nensha (念写,Thoughtography) is a technique awakened by Valden after consuming the 「 」and is useable with his Hametsugan.
Nensha.title: Nensha

Nightmare Crow Calls.description: This is a genjutsu, which is cast by a crow, In this genjutsu a crow caws a few times which drops the opponent under the user's genjutsu. The user is free to manipulate the technique and make any illusion they wish their opponent to see. This genjutsu gives the user the ability to manipulate all five senses of the opponent. Ichirou Mamuro's mastery allows him to affect any sense of the opponent including Chakra Sensing Technique and any other sense the opponent might have for example: Heat sensing technique.
Nightmare Crow Calls.title: Nightmare Crow Calls

Nightmare Illusion: Underworld Servant.description: The user's blood is smeared on the face of a victim and the scent of the blood unleashes a terrifying Genjutsu, which transforms the user into a terrifying and gory looking demon in the eyes of the victim. The sheer terror it unleashes on a victim is huge, bringing forth the biggest fears and syncing them with the vision of a horrible demon.
Nightmare Illusion: Underworld Servant.title: Nightmare Illusion: Underworld Servant

Ninja Art: Eternal Penance.description: Ninpou: Fukyuu Kugyou - Ninja Art: Eternal Penance *Rank: S *Range: - *Users:Emanyeru Kouseitan'i The Eternal Penance is a technique that uses the old saying 'The eyes are the windows to the soul' and takes it to a whole new level. It destroys the mind by taking all of the pain that the person you use it on has caused others in his/her life, multiplies it by the number of eyes made for the Genjutsu, and turns it back on the person. You control the amount of time that all of this takes, so you can make them feel the pain in a sudden rush and totally obliterate their mind, or torture them over the course of years. Kind of like the Tsukuyomi's seventy-two hour thing.
Ninja Art: Eternal Penance.title: Ninja Art: Eternal Penance

Ninja Art: Infinite Nightmare.description: Ninpou: Mugendai Akumu - Ninja Art: Infinite Nightmare *Rank: S *Range: - *Users:Emanyeru Kouseitan'i This genjutsu focuses on confusing the opponents optical and hearing nerve centers to create a sense of confusion while in a state of terror. The user begins this genjutsu by focusing a set amount of chakra into their eyes. The more chakra the user focuses the stronger it will be. They will then look the opponent in the eyes planting the genjutsu. The user can then activate this genjutsu later on with a simple horse handseal causing the state of reality that the opponent is experiencing to warp and distort effectively hiding the user while making the opponent believe that the object of the most horrifying nightmares has come to life.
Ninja Art: Infinite Nightmare.title: Ninja Art: Infinite Nightmare

Nise Tengoku.description: is a Dōjutsu and Genjutsu accessed through both eyes of Kama Uchiha's Mangekyō Sharingan. It is a genjutsu of the highest calibre and it incorporates and synchronizes both Genjutsu used through Kama's eyes; Amenonaemasu and Amenowakahiko. Using both eyes of his dōjutsu, Kama projects an illusion which is distinctively the same as reality itself. The target then experiences flashbacks about things that did not even happen. Kama manipulates the emotions of the user to be filled with penitence and stress, causing great depression until they die. Every single sense, including the ability to sense chakra, is hindered and, as a result, even those possessing dōjutsu will be manipulated to see and know what Kama desires. This illusion is cast by the target looking at anywhere the user has looked at, making evading next to impossible. Only those possessing the Rinnegan are capable of detecting th
Nise Tengoku.title: Nise Tengoku

Nise no sekai: Gensō.description: Nise no sekai: Gensō is a powerful Genjutsu that only Raio's Rinne Sharingan has been shown able to perform. To use this technique the user must already have their Rinne Sharingan activated. After that they concentrate their chakra and focus on a location, if done properly the user will create an illusionary copy of him/herself that will fool even the best of sensors into believing that it has the same smell, and chakra signature as the user. They will do whaterver the user wants them too. After this Jutsu is mastered the user can create numerous copies of him/herself, making this technique very useful when tricking your opponent or trapping them. Raio has stated that unlike ordinary Genjutsu that directly target the mind of the opponent, this one targets the world itself which include the opponent's senses, creating the illusion of what the user wants others to see, that being said it i
Nise no sekai: Gensō.title: Nise no sekai: Gensō

Nyorai.description: is one of the most powerful Genjutsu of the Uchiha Clan. This technique is similar to Izanami, but instead of deciding destiny, it forces the target to acknowledge it along with past mistakes and forgive themselves, thus gaining enlightenment. The user simply glances at the user's facial expression, replicating it to get a glimpse of their thoughts and feelings. With this, the use can then project images around the target within the target's subconsciousness. These images will keep reappearing until the target realizes their faults and accepts them or the user intervenes by entering the subconscious to tell them to accept their fate in order to speed up the process. However, if the target fails or does not want to accept, a mirror will appear, showing their inner, dark, horrific manifestation of their true self, which will consume them. This will cause insanity. Though, even if the targe
Nyorai.title: Nyorai

Olfactory Genjutsu.description: Scent based illusion techniques remain among the rarest forms of Yin Release used to initiate genjutsu attacks on opponents. Though unusual they are highly effective methods of delivery often used as supplemental tactics in Kyrgyzishi Clan attack patterns. The versatility of this style of attack lends itself well to many different combat strategies. As the Uchiha were the primary impetus for the creation of this style of genjutsu, it remains particularly effective against members of this clan, as well as many other types of dōjutsu users. The Kyrgyzishi developed this style of genjutsu after their initial defeat at the Uchiha's hands during the Ten Fingers of Blood Stained Hands massacre and their subsequent dealings with Hidden Mist. These techniques were developed to mimic both the Hiding in Mist Technique and Clam based genjutsu that worked so well against the Kaguya Clan as a counter
Olfactory Genjutsu.title: Olfactory Genjutsu

Onogoroshima.description: Onogoroshima (淤能碁呂島おのごろじま, Spontaneously Congealed Island) is a powerful of the Goshintai. It allows the user to superimpose imagination over reality. *Onogoroshima was created when Izanagi and Izanami churned the sea with the Amenonuhoko. When they raised the spear from the ocean, drops fell from the spear, forming the island.
Onogoroshima.title: Onogoroshima

Opalescence.description: This is a secret genjutsu that was once handed down from head of the Hyūga to the next. Eventually, almost anyone with a Byakugan eye could learn this technique, though the head of the Hyūga clan has access to the most powerful version. This is known as the Byakugan version of Tsukuyomi, though the former pales in comparison to the latter. After activating the Byakugan, the user makes eye contact with their target or touches them. Soon after, the target is thrown into a world where there is only white. Stuck in this formless, monochromatic world, most targets begin to panic. Soon after, the world begins to become colorful, with moving, wavy bands of one color after another, shining slightly. The number of colors depend on how skilled the user is with the genjutsu. Soon after, the target suffers slight blindness, head pain, and something similar to a seizure. The target tries to close the
Opalescence.title: Opalescence

Order of Glamour.description: {{JutsuInfobox |named=Yes |image=Order of Glamour.png |kanji=蠱惑の号令 |romaji=Kowaku no Gōrei |other jutsu=Yes |parent jutsu= |jutsu classification=Genjutsu, Taijutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Offensive, Supplementary |jutsu range=Short |users= |game debut= |jutsu media=Game }} Using Demonic Illusion: Cajolery of Glamour, the user can suppress the will of his or her followers and force them to attack the user's opponent with taijutsu.
Order of Glamour.title: Order of Glamour

Otojutsu: Thousand Cherry Blossoms Night.description: Otojutsu: Thousand Cherry Blossoms Nightmare is an Otojutsu technique created by Samiya Kanari. By singing a specific melody, so long as her opponent hears it they become trapped in a nightmare. The world around them becomes a large cherry blossom forest. The enemy is swarmed and drowned in the thousands of pink cherry blossoms, simulating the crushing effect of drowning in water all while the person stands paralyzed and unknowing to the true scenario around them. *Thousand Cherry Blossoms Nightmare gets it's name from a popular rock song in Japan known as Senbonzakura, which also means "Thousand Cherry Blossoms".
Otojutsu: Thousand Cherry Blossoms Night.title: Otojutsu: Thousand Cherry Blossoms Nightmare

Otojutsu: Wild Anthem.description: Otojutsu: Wild Anthem is an Otojutsu technique created by Samiya Kanari. It is employed by simply screaming aloud, amplifying her voice to levels that send sound waves all around her. The purpose of the technique is to incapacitate and blowback her enemies, using the sheer volume of her scream *Wild Anthem much like every other Otojutsu technique, shares a name with a popular Japanese song. Specifically the song by the band .
Otojutsu: Wild Anthem.title: Otojutsu: Wild Anthem

Pale Rose Art: Rose Moon Dancing Blade.description: ---- Using this genjutsu, Ayaka creates the illusion of a pink full-moon in an evening sky. Then, she body flickers up into the air, so that the moon outlines her dark silhouette. She cuts on her descent downwards, attacking her target, who has difficulty seeing her blade in the dark, with the bright light of the moon blinding them and casting Ayaka herself, in shadow. Alternatively, she can simply reflect the moonlight off her blade to blind her opponent, taking advantage of the opportunity to strike; her opponent cannot do the same thing. This technique constantly drains chakra while it is being used.
Pale Rose Art: Rose Moon Dancing Blade.title: Pale Rose Art: Rose Moon Dancing Blade

Paradise Path.description: The Paradise Path is Doujinn's unique ability using his Rinnegan. It utilizes a range of special genjutsu, and can seal victims inside of them. Doujinn uses his unique Paradise Genjutsu through this path when he wants.
Paradise Path.title: Paradise Path

Perfect Hypnosis: Fake Object.description: Perfect Hypnosis: Fake Object is a supplementary genjutsu used by the genjutsu master of the Masked Shadows, Kitsunekamen. This genjutsu fools the senses of vision and feeling and makes the target think there is an object that doesn't really exist. For example, it's possible to make the target think he or she is trapped behind a wall while he or she really isn't. If the target realizes he or she is in genjutsu, it's possible to escape this genjutsu.
Perfect Hypnosis: Fake Object.title: Perfect Hypnosis: Fake Object

Phagaro Rooho.description: Enter the enigmatic event . This technique is characterized by an illuminating black and white energy sphere, which forms in the vicinity of Gaoh's core, with anomalous markings surrounding it. This small sphere is released with a massive gravitational pull, dragging everything to it within a massive radius while increasing in size, density and overall mass. This ability used by Gaoh is known for being one of the most damaging techniques in the shinobi world next to his Kalki used by his Sakra Devanam Indra technique. This is one of the few techniques to exist in more than one plane of existence, specifically the astral plane. This form requires the manipulation of three forms of energy which includes; chakra, natural energy, and the energy from the entirety of the messianic plane, in which Gaoh is the Sage of in order to initiate the technique. The Path Gold Alignment techniques or rath
Phagaro Rooho.title: Phagaro Rooho

Phantom Veil Technique.description: The is an ancient technique that was once characteristic of the Noble , having originated from their teachings. It is a plain and basic illusionary technique used to set the foundations for their hiden . Simple in execution, the user simply draws out their chakra as an intangible cloak that is then given minor properties. From there, the caster drapes the cloak over their selected target. While their victims are under the veil, the user is able to selectively weaken and dull a single sense; blurring their eyes, muffling their hearing, numbing their skin, clogging their nostrils, etc. The technique's effects are not strong and are noticeably quite weak, and the veil can easily be lifted simply by releasing a pulse of chakra to tear it to shreds. As a result, it was historically taught to and only utilized by younger members of the Kurama Clan. However, although the Phantom Veil is a start
Phantom Veil Technique.title: Phantom Veil Technique

Plant Release: Mass Chaos.description: By using Plant Release: Mass Chaos, The user sprouts plants from the ground that releases spores and pheromones rapidly into the air. By altering the chemical makeup in the brain, once inhaled or taken into the body through the skin, will induce unprecedented and random acts of berserkness and rage within those affected. This generally wears off in 30-40 minutes.
Plant Release: Mass Chaos.title: Plant Release: Mass Chaos

However, instead of targeting the mind with his chakra, Asu instead implants a seal that effects the spiritual consciousness of the target, and how that consciousness effects the perception of the target. Once activated, which must be done at a close range, the target will see nothing but black, being unable to see passed the infinite darkness. However, that changes once the target reopens their eyes to see the world around them. Their sense of sight, smell, orientation, taste, hearing, sense chakra, molding it and the ability to sense emotions will come to a complete halt. This allows Asu to attack, even at close range, without being seen, heard, or leaving a chakra making him completely imperceptible as if he does not exist as the target's eyes will have

By using his Gensanryoukyou, Patorikku secures enough chakra to catch several enemies in an illusion were the victims are left to think that the sky has shattered into millions of pieces of glass which are raining down upon them. The jutsu is an excellent diversion to use in the need of an escape possibility while surrounded by a small army of hostile shinobis. Radioactive Poisoning Technique.description: Radioactive Poisoning Technique (放射性毒殺の術, Houshasei Dokusatsu no Jutsu) is a Tailed Beast Skill of the Storm Dragon. In a similar vein to Lightning Release: Lightning Illusion Flash of Lightning Pillar, the beast can emit a bright flash from their body, blinding any one who sees for some time. This is compared to the power of Hiden: Hiding in Scale Powder Technique, though the duration depends on how specialized the user is and how much chakra is put into the technique. At times as well, whoever sees the light is ensnared into a generic genjutsu that can be manipulated. With the experience of the tailed beast, it can do its best to simulate a genjutsu that tricks the brain into thinking its real, thus causing the brain to damage the victims' own body. Remote Chakra Manifestation Technique.description: The was once used by the Minazuki clan ages ago. The clan was only one branch of the Revered Paths of the Consecrated Blood Grail whose names were filled with grace and dignity. Each clan of this council demonstrated a fine tune manipulation of chakra whether it was through inherited skill or through intensive training regiments. In any case, the technique produced a profound change across the clans and even in the performance arts. In an unbelievable feat, members of the Revered Paths of the Consecrated Blood Grail would spar amongst other nations without so much as utilizing a finger. The ability itself was once considered to be the zenith of chakra manipulation and was originally a mystery that was everlastingly impenetrable. A user initiates this technique by spinning their chakra in a helical motion while gradually increasing its celerity until the user reaches the maximum level of

Restricted Tsukuyomi.description: The Restricted Tsukuyomi is a powerful genjutsu which is cast from the third eye of a Rinnegan user. The user casts the genjutsu with their third eye, causing this eye to emit a powerful light. Anyone who sees this light is then trapped within the realm of the genjutsu. Using the principles of the Izanagi, the world inside the genjutsu is just as real as the material world, meaning any injuries suffered while under the genjutsu also transfer to the victim's material body. Additionally, the user completely commands the genjutsu world they've created, essentially allowing them to rewrite "reality" and change the settings to make the illusion more in their own favor. Those caught within the Restricted Tsukuyomi cannot move their physical bodies—which remain stationary in the material world—unless the genjutsu is somehow broken. Though one of the most powerful genjutsu, the are methods of co

Reverse Realm Technique.description: Reverse Realm Technique (倒像国土の術, Tōzōkokudo no Jutsu) is a high tier Genjutsu. It's considered one of the masterpieces in illusionary arts. It's a technique that works on the perception of the target, altering it in order to puzzle their minds and create multiple openings for attacks. After weaving the Tiger hand seal, the opponent is put under a potent Genjutsu. The target views everything to be inverted, as if he's walking on the sky. If the user attacks the target from the right, the target would view the attack as if it's coming from the left. If the user attacks the target from behind, the target would see it as if the user is attacking them directly upfront. That is also applied to projectiles. Multiple variations of this technique has been made. The user has the choice to neglect the upside down effect and simply focus on the inverted attacks. Yūzuki was able to create a variation
Reverse Realm Technique.title: Reverse Realm Technique

Rising Dragon Claw.description: is one of Yaburu most favored attacks derived from his own combat form known as the, "Revolting Fist". To begin, he channels his internal energy (Chakra) throughout his body, he intensifies his chakra to such degree that it becomes visible and imbues his chakra with yin-nature after which he throws an elegant pose with his claw above his head and performs a slide kick towards his opponent. If it lands, he follows up with another strong kick that sends his opponent(S) flying. Just as they are about to land, he fiercely strikes them in the back with his claw in a horizontal arc motion. However, since, the attack involves the usage of yin the effects of this attacks are not just limited to physical injury but also can cause the victim to hallucinate and sometimes these hallucinations can be so intense that the victim enter a catatonic state.

Riyan's Unnamed Genjutsu.description: By channeling his chakra into his opponent, Riyan is able to distort the target's perception, effectively making a person's five senses unable to properly register what is happening. This power can be negated by one using their chakra to close off their emotions before the hypnosis takes place. He can also use this Genjutsu whenever someone looks directly into his normal Sharingan eyes. In Sharingan form, it takes a similar appearance to Itachi's genjutsu, as it generates crows, followed by two blazing Sharingan eyes to appear behind the opponent with a black backdrop behind them. * This Genjutsu is based on the illusions used by Koga Kuchiki in the Bleach filler arcs.
Riyan's Unnamed Genjutsu.title: Riyan's Unnamed Genjutsu

Sage Art: Illusion.description: The user releases a part of his natural energy into the surrounding area and it forms an invisible mist. If the opponent is in this mist they start too hallucinate things. This illusions are not high level genjutsu they are equal to a C-ranked genjutsu so they can easily be released, but as long as the opponent stay's in the mist he/she falls into a new genjutsu within moments.
Sage Art: Illusion.title: Sage Art: Illusion

Sage Art: Silver Tongue.description: Sage Art: Silver Tongue (仙法・銀舌, Senpō: Ginshita) is a -enhanced and technique created by Yua Shimura based off her studies of the . It serves as a Fighting Style. Yua, through her Summon wrapped around her neck, is able to continuously gather and store it within a Fūinjutsu seal located on her tongue. After infusing that seal with her chakra, she is able to infuse her very words with Yin Senjutsu. Through this, she is able to manipulate inorganic material around her as if they were organic beings under her verbal genjutsu. This provides Yua with a devastating level of control over the very battlefield that shinobi fight atop, able to manipulate even the projectiles thrown at her, as well as the air itself. Complicated commands are impossible to perform, limiting Yua to making short commands as she uses this technique.
Sage Art: Silver Tongue.title: Sage Art: Silver Tongue

Sage Art: Triple Element: Rhapsody of En.description: Sage Art: Triple Element: Rhapsody of Endless Dreams () is a collaboration technique preformed by Zenkichi Senju, Yoshikage Kurokami, and Kaname Soga. In order to use this technique, Zenkichi and Yoshikage will enter Sage Mode, while Kaname enter his Nature God Mode. They will connect their energy together, causing a green aura to appear around them and each sharing the same eye color. The three will slam their hands on the ground, summoning a massive forest of white around them. The three will then clap their hands together, which causes the tree to produce flowers, which in turn produce pollen which seeps into air.

Sainokawara.description: Sainokawara is an extremely powerful Genjutsu that is used with the Mangekyou Sharingan. Like the Susanoo, Sainokawara isn't exclusive to an unique Mangekyou Sharingan. However, the conditions to use this ability are difficult. For one, the ability requires eye contact that has to be maintained for half a minute without any interruptions such as blinking. The user of the technique must have very large chakra reserves, or any Tailed Beast chakra (however small it may be) stored within them. After starting eye contact with the victim, a black and red beam of negative chakra starts to develop between the eyes of the user and the eyes of the victim. This chakra beam becomes very visible and noticeable to anyone after around 15 seconds, and both the victim and the user will start to feel nausea. Techniques that stem from the Buddhaic or the Messianic Planes are grades beyond techniques or being that have their origins in the physical, astral, mental, causal or various other planes of existence. This technique does not require traditional hand-signs, but at any rate requires immense concentration similar to the an Uchiha's Susanoo technique. The true body of Sakra Devanam Indra is so massive that just the single clap of its massive hands, is able to crush a country sized Chibaku Tensei by using the Five Finger Mountain Technique. Scattered Clouds Vanishing Mist.description: is a contact-type that uses the -natured chakra, such as that from the Hiding in Mist Technique, as a medium. With this technique the user can selectively ensnare individuals withing the range of their mist in a variety of illusory effects according to their will. Additionally, the practitioner can choose to effect anyone within the range of their mist, with the exception of exempted targets. The effects of this technique can range from simple effects, such as auditory and visual hallucinations, to complex illusory applications, like temporarily manipulating weak willed individuals or forcing a target to reveal information. In addition to the ability to effect several targets without direct contact this techniques mode of application offers many distinct benefits. Scattering Thousand Dreams Technique.description: is an unique initiation maneuver that serves as a follow up maneuver to crow-based . While this technique was developed as a direct from the it can also be used in concert with the and Hiding with Crows Technique. Therefore, it offers multiple methods of activation, which in turn allow it to be utilized in a wide variety of scenarios. The technique takes effect when the crows generated by one of the aforementioned techniques are dispersed either by the efforts of an enemy, or through the command of the practitioner. In either case each crow is replaced by a few black feathers, which slowly fall towards the ground. Enemies who happen to see, hear, or make contact with even a single one of these feathers will be ensnared in an illusion determined by the user's will. Similar to Dance of the Powdered Snow, this technique can be used to trap an opponent in a genjutsu composed of countless wea

Scorch Release: Inflaming Desires.description: The is a technique that compels Hōsōshi's imagination to execute his murderous intentions with the Scorch Release. The extremity of this technique is fully dependent on Hōsōshi's mood and killing intentions. By expressing his Killing Intent to his opponents, Hōsōshi visualizes to have [a heart] — the opponent's heart — between his hands, engulfed in his evaporating flames. While the technique is potentially a "fear factor" expressing his Killing Intent to inflame them with the Scorch Release, it's possible to turn it into reality. In fact, Hōsōshi uses his imagination to harmlessly inflame the “heart” of the victim. Consequently, the flames will slowly evaporate the victim from the inside out.
Scorch Release: Inflaming Desires.title: Scorch Release: Inflaming Desires

The Seal of the Living Law of Light, encourages activation of one's focus and desire to meet the "Living Law" expression in his / her being in a more expedient and complete manner. Thus, this seal is in essence a manifestation template, in that it helps an individual to see clearly and act upon that insight in a very real and manifesting way. Yet it cannot bring of any kind that is not in alignment with the destiny field of the individual; ie. the field containing the codes for the greater spiritual good of that person's incarnational pathing.
