Secret Jutsu: Hallucinogenic Static.description: The user sends a pulse of sparks through the ground and the nearby enemies who are touched by it are put in a state of dysphoria and feel as if they are living in a sort of hell. This jutsu can also be used airborne, but is not typically used in such ways. The effects of this jutsu can vary. Typically, the jutsu lasts for about an hour but the person may feel as if they have been gone for multiple weeks. Similar to the effects of Itachi Uchiha's Tsukuyomi.
Secret Jutsu: Hallucinogenic Static.title: Secret Jutsu: Hallucinogenic Static

Secret Medical Skill: Surgical White Ele.description: The Secret Medical Skill: Surgical White Elephant Phantom (秘伝医療 技能: 手術 有難迷惑 幻像, Hideniryō Ginō: Shujutsu Arigatameiwaku Genzō) is a powerful illusion technique incorporated by medical ninjutsu. It was created by Chūkode Caught deep without an illusion, the opponent is unable to unravel themselves! As hard as they might try they are stuck, held at the user's whim. Genjutsu has a blurred line with Medical Ninjutsu on the other side; it works by controlling the flow of chakra in a target's cerebral nervous system which includes the brain and spinal cord. Chūkode created a jutsu where a medic could create an illusion to sedate a patient who was reacting wildly to poison or a mental illness. It allows users to heal patients effectively without harming them. After the needed signs are formed, the user initiates the technique through sight and or sound. The chakra they use to do this is so fine
Secret Medical Skill: Surgical White Ele.title: Secret Medical Skill: Surgical White Elephant Phantom

Secret Technique: Firefly Illusion Order.description: This technique requires the dojutsu Anshigan, and its ability to emit light. In this method the wielder can send signals understood by fireflies and have them execute commands. With their own chakra the user can then adjust the intensity, duration, and range of the cold light emitted by these fireflies. Those who catch sight of the glow fall under the influence of a subtle genjutsu. While in effect, the specific intervals at which the fireflies glow produce a stimuli that interfere with the brain's ability to consolidate short-term memories into stronger long-term memories. The genjutsu can be further altered by the user to affect multiple people differently or extended using a sensing barrier. Due to its complexity, the intricacies of this technique are known in detail only by its creator, Headmistress Suiren, making her the sole user. Lightning Release: Lightning Illusion Flash of Ligh
Secret Technique: Firefly Illusion Order.title: Secret Technique: Firefly Illusion Order

Secret Technique: Ravenous Swarm.description: The user taps the forehead of their target before performing the rat hand seal. The target will feel their vision go blank for a moment before finding themselves in an empty void surrounded by millions upon millions of insects. The insects swarm the target and begin devouring their flesh creating dozens of sensations across their body in order to make them think they are truly being eaten alive. Shinan will appear shortly after, the insects skittering away from him as if afraid. He will then extend his hand to his target offering them freedom. If they accept, they lose consciousness and Shinan is free to root around in their mind for information, if they refuse then the genjutsu continues until the target submits, Shinan breaks the technique, or the target figures out that the techniques in itself is only an illusion.
Secret Technique: Ravenous Swarm.title: Secret Technique: Ravenous Swarm

Senshiryoku.description: {{Infobox/Jutsu/RW109 | title= | image= | caption=Taiyō using Senshiryoku. | kanji=千視力 | unnamed justu=No | romaji=Senshiryoku | literal english=Thousand Eyesight | novel debut=The Six Paths Chronicles | media=Novel | nature type= Yin Release | jutsu classification=, Genjutsu, Dōjutsu | jutsu rank=S-rank | jutsu class type=Offensive, Supplementary | jutsu range=Short- to Mid-range (0-10m) | hand seals=Technique specified hand seal | related jutsu=Tsukuyomi, Izanami | users=Taiyō Hashimoto--> }}--> is a powerful S-rank genjutsu from Taiyō Hashimoto’s Shinbigan which enables him to entrap a target inside their own hell until the user decides to lift it or dies, or if the target is dead. Senshiryoku can be cast from either eye but must have direct eye contact with the intended target within close range. It can only affect one person at a time and is useless against two or more individuals s
Senshiryoku.title: Senshiryoku

Sephirothic Tree of Life.description: The (עץ חיים) or is a term from the 's system of , named , to describe a diagram composed of 10 Numbers and 22 Letters. The ten Numbers are the ten sayings of God in the first chapter of (בראשית) in which He wrought the universe, with the 22 letters of the Hebrew alefbet interpolated between these powerful Numbers. The Hebrew word for Numbers is Sephiroth (plural, used to refer to the entirety of the Numbers) while the Hebrew word for Number is Sephirah (singular, used to refer to a specific Number). This technique outlines the integration of Spirit into Matter through the process of Divine Man becoming Hue-Man, and Hue-Man becoming Man. The Path Gold Alignment techniques or rather Gushkin-banda techniques usage are a symbolical and energetic representation of the spiritual illumination and physical transformation of the human race to its perfected state. They are a vibrational melding o
Sephirothic Tree of Life.title: Sephirothic Tree of Life

Shadow Paralysis Genjutsu.description: A rather simple application of Kotoshiro's manifestation of the Sharingan's Genjutsu capabilities put to action. Upon eye contact being established, the victim is immediately placed under the illusion that their shadow stops moving, eventually leading to the prevention of their locomotion as the Genjutsu appears more real by the passing second. This is an effective stall technique for as long as eye contact remains established. Upon breaking eye contact, the Genjutsu is dispelled. It should be noted, though, because of the instant transition between the Genjutsu's activation and closure, the opponents are often confused as to the current state of their mind, sometimes allowing for extreme confusion among enemy ranks.
Shadow Paralysis Genjutsu.title: Shadow Paralysis Genjutsu

Shadow Strike of the Sages.description: * Name: Shadow Strike of the Sages * Type: Unknown rank, Offensive * Users: Kakashi Namikaze (Ultimate Ninja 3 only) In Ultimate Ninja 3, Kakashi Namikaze calls forth shadows of himself to strike the enemy. Due to the word "Sages" in it, it is assumed that Gokage Sennin are able to use it in actual Naruto.
Shadow Strike of the Sages.title: Shadow Strike of the Sages

Sharingan Autogenjutsu.description: Sharingan Autogenjutsu is a new approach of genjutsu developed by Maikeru Alexe. This technique opens a virtually unlimited options of controlling one's own psychology in any way imaginable, by directly manipulating the user's brain to create a wanted effect. In the early stages of Maikeru Alexe's developing Sharingan, this type of genjutsu has a limited range of influence, being able only to control and enhance a few consciouss functions, like emotions, focus, cognitive processes, visualization etc. This restrained version of the genjutsu is shown to even be capable of increasing the efficacy of chakra usage, allowing the user to enter a so called "Chakra Mode" in which the energy "flows" in almost perfect equilibrium.
Sharingan Autogenjutsu.title: Sharingan Autogenjutsu

Sharingan Wights.description: Shisui can create creatures who follow any of his commands, generally involving espionage or the stalking of others. Each of these creatures bear his within their eyes, allowing him to see what they see and even cast additional illusions through their vision. Because the creatures are illusions as opposed to real animals, they do not make any sound and are able to pass through any ordinary physical obstacle. Additionally, it is impossible to get a clear image of the creatures when you look at them directly, reducing them to something that is always seen from the corner of the eye, something one can easily convince oneself of that only exists in their imagination. Aligning with Shisui's character, these creatures are generally cats but he can also create air- or sea-born wights such as crows or salamanders should the situation call for it. Although their main purpose lies within reconnais
Sharingan Wights.title: Sharingan Wights

Sharingan: Blind Reality.description: Sharingan: Blind Reality (写輪眼・盲実, Sharingan: Mōjitsu) is a technique developed by Hidari with Kazuhide's assistance. Due to the tremendous level of spiritual energy that exists within the Sharingan's activation as a result of the unique chakra that the Uchiha Clan have, various effects can be induced against the opponent via eye contact; a primary one being . However, Kotoshiro has found a more direct variation of this. By fueling his spiritual energy with chakra through the Sharingan after establishing direct eye contact, Kotoshiro can channel this to another person's eye, which temporarily clouds their vision as a result of the large influx of spiritually infused chakra, otherwise known as .
Sharingan: Blind Reality.title: Sharingan: Blind Reality

Sharingan: Chakra Illusion.description: The , is a created by Ayame Uchiha, through the extensive use of her Sharingan. After activating the Sharingan, the user applies its base technique when exerting their chakra, capturing the foe in a genjutsu. Anyone who watches the exertion of the user's chakra will be caught within the genjutsu, making it extremely hard to tell if one is indeed using a genjutsu. Once caught, the user is stuck in a world where they are drowned by chakra. With deeper practice, Ayame has found, that she is capable of making the opponent think they have more chakra than what they really do.

infobox.users: Fukitsu Uchiha, Ayame Uchiha,Sigma Uchiha,Tsuna Uchiha/Rebirth,

Sharingan: Chakra Illusion.title: Sharingan: Chakra Illusion

Sharingan: Hallucination.description: A more advance form to the Sharingan's basic hypnosis ability. The user uses hypnosis to cause the enemy to hallucinate for a predetermined amount of time. The possibilities for this jutsu are near infinite as the user can cause the enemy to hallucinate about anything. The hallucination could be based on a certain fear or they can cause them to think that their allies are really their enemies. The victim of this jutsu cannot break it easily because, unlike average , the victim actually believes the things they are hallucinating about are real and, more often than not, will either try to flee or attack the hallucination, not dispel it.

infobox.users: Itami Uchiha, Kakashi Hatake, Rath Uchiha, Tensai Uchiha

Sharingan: Hallucination.title: Sharingan: Hallucination

Sharingan: Illusion Punch.description: Sharingan: Illusion Punch is a Genjutsu created by Oshino Uchiha, It's incredibly similar to Tsukuyomi as it also plays inside the Opponents head, the opponent perceives themselves being hit with punches over and over again at the full strength, it usually plays in their head for about 1,30/2 minutes and Is only visible in the real world as .5 seconds.
Sharingan: Illusion Punch.title: Sharingan: Illusion Punch

Sharingan: Reverse Dimension.description: This is rather a simple Genjutsu, all it does is that it makes it seem everything is upside down. Nothing more, nothing less.
Sharingan: Reverse Dimension.title: Sharingan: Reverse Dimension

Sharingan: Static Reality.description: The Sharingan: Static Reality (写輪眼・静真, Sharingan: Seijin; English TV: "Copy Wheel Eye: Sage") is a technique which is derived from the principles of the Izanami in combination with the ability for the Sharingan to cast Genjutsu of varying degrees. The technique utilizes the Sharingan of the user to visualize the environment for a moment, and subsequently take a "snapshot" of it, keeping it within the user's memory. At this point in time, the user can either do two things: transfer this image of chakra onto a holographic projection for closer observation, utilize it in a Genjutsu maneuver or store it within their mind as a long-term memory. This Genjutsu is a simple replication of this physical sensation in a visual form. This, in turn, makes it impossible for the other senses to be affected during this illusion. However, it can provide a potent distraction in preparation for another tech
Sharingan: Static Reality.title: Sharingan: Static Reality

Sharingan: Truth Inversion.description: The Sharingan: Truth Inversion (写輪眼・真経津, Sharingan: Mafutsu) is a unique technique that utilizes the hypnotic (催眠, Saimin) and insightful (洞察, Dōsatsu) properties of the Sharingan to create a highly unique and debilitating illusion that can cause repeated damage towards an enemy if the victim are left unaware. It was created by Naori Uchiha, who made it to utilize her abilities with the standard Sharingan to a highly practical effect. Firstly, Naori utilizes her Sharingan as a means to begin copying the use of the technique that her opponent will use against her. From herein, Naori creates the illusion that the copied technique is activated slower than the actual speed of it, therefore also causing the opponent to believe that Naori has been injured from the aforementioned technique. However, in reality, the victim's technique has been performed slower than Naori's own use of it. Therefo
Sharingan: Truth Inversion.title: Sharingan: Truth Inversion

Shinatsuhiko(Ender).description: Shinatsuhiko is the left eye Mangekyō Sharingan ability of Kūiki Uchiha and is an extremely powerful Genjutsu. Sasuke Uchiha has been quoted as saying Shinatsuhiko could be just as powerful as Itachi Uchiha's Tsukuyomi, if not more powerful. Shinatsuhiko is activated by Kūiki, with his Mangekyō Sharingan active, staring into someone's eyes. After this is done, the person is unable to move and, while still seeing everything else normally, sees a duplicate Kūiki in front of them that speaks to them by Kūiki controlling the duplicate. While Shinatsuhiko is active, the target is unable to move or speak, but will continue to perform all normal bodily functions. If someone has Shinatsuhiko put on them, any Genjutsu they were using will cease.
Shinatsuhiko(Ender).title: Shinatsuhiko(Ender)

Shinjiro.description: Named after the Death-Gods of the afterworld, the Shinigami, Shinziro is one of the most powerful genjutsu in existence. The Shinjiro's name literally means the 'Shinigami Stare of Shattered Souls'. It is also unique to the Shinigami's eyes flashing when the jutsu is initiated. It is unique to the Uchiha Clan, and only those with the Mangekyo Sharingan can perform it. It is the counterpart to the ninjutsu Inryōkukami. Shinjiro requires eye contact when performed. When executed, the jutsu traps the target in a white vortex-like void with gray clouds circulating the vortex. The user then uses a genjutsu to constrain the target limbs. This is said to keep the target from using the release seal to counteract the jutsu. Then, the user focuses an immense amount of chakra in the main optic nerve behind the eye. The users, pinwheel-like tomoe then spin rapidly until the user's eye looks like a b
Shinjiro.title: Shinjiro

Shinkantoku.description: Shinkantoku (, lit. Mind Control) was the first Mangekyō Sharingan technique awakened in Kane Soga's eyes. It is powerful genjutsu capable of manipulating a person's mind and memory. By peering at an foe, Kane is able to enter the opponent's mind and is easily able to alter, erase, or sugarcoat the memories of an opponent. The easiest usage of the ability is to erase an opponent's memories as this is most apparent to them. As they lose a piece of memory suddenly, they may possibly become aware that someone could have possibly whipped their mind and counter Kane. The next, more difficult usage is to sugarcoat memories Kane mixes in false memories with the target's true memories. If achieved properly, the opponent will become confused and disoriented or, should Kane not want this side effect, he can make it so that the memories blend together better. The last and most difficult application

infobox.jutsu classification: Kekkei Genkai~ Mangekyō Sharingan, Genjutsu, Dōjutsu

Shinkantoku.title: Shinkantoku

Shinkiro no Jutsu.description: Name:Shinkiro no Jutsu (Mirage Technique) Type: Genjutsu, A- Rank,Offensive,Defensive Users: Shinkiro,Yuri Kazahana This jutsu is more of a skill than a jutsu. The user can cast mirages on the opponent,making the opponent feel like the mirage is real or they are under Genjutsu.
Shinkiro no Jutsu.title: Shinkiro no Jutsu

Shivering Whirlpool Technique.description: This genjutsu locks the target's vision span; in other words, their line of sight will not move even if the body is turned, and the target can only see what they were seeing when the genjutsu was first used until the genjutsu is dispelled.
Shivering Whirlpool Technique.title: Shivering Whirlpool Technique

Shroud of the Garden's Bed.description: Expelling forth the spores, similar to the Izanagi technique with the use of the Wind Release: Deep Breath Yakujō will trap her target within a powerful genjutsu. The target will believe they are laying in a bed of calm grass and being hit by a vivid wind. The genjutsu will last until the entrapped target realizes the genjutsu is fake or is hurt. It is simply a distraction that will cause the target to forget about what they were previously doing. This allows Yakujō to escape from a battle she cannot win.
Shroud of the Garden's Bed.title: Shroud of the Garden's Bed

Silent Nocturne.description: Silent Nocturne (粛粛夜曲, Shukushuku Yakyoku)
Silent Nocturne.title: Silent Nocturne

Sky Style: Dance of the Crescent Moon.description: The Sky Style: Dance of the Crescent Moon is a variant of the Leaf Style: Dance of the Crescent Moon involving the usage of illusionary copies to psychologically overwhelm the opponent. This is done with combining the copies with blinding speed. It is considered more of a genjutsu than ninjutsu, since believing that the copies are real would merely multiply the damage when the user's blade(s) connect with the victim.
Sky Style: Dance of the Crescent Moon.title: Sky Style: Dance of the Crescent Moon

Sly Mind Affect Technique.description: {{JutsuInfobox |ref= |image1=Sly Mind Affect Technique part 1.png |caption1=The target is fooled into thinking they are making progress… |image2=Sly Mind Affect Technique part 2.png |caption2=…even though the distance remains the same all the time. |tabber=Yes |named=Yes |kanji=狐狸心中の術 |romaji=Kori Shinchū no Jutsu |jutsu rank=C |jutsu classification=Genjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary |jutsu range=Mid, Long |users= |debut manga= |debut anime= |jutsu media=Anime, Manga }} This technique causes one or more targets to, while walking in what they believe to be a straight direction, instead walk in circles. As is typical for genjutsu, the targets are unlikely to notice that they're doing this, causing them to waste time and energy as they wander about. only realize that they've fallen prey to this technique when they notice the body of a centipede that killed hours earlier.
Sly Mind Affect Technique.title: Sly Mind Affect Technique

Smoke Genjutsu.description: Kemuri blows a stream of smoke from her mouth, the trick is to make the target close there eyes. After they open there eyes they see terrible images of there friends and family turn into skulls.
Smoke Genjutsu.title: Smoke Genjutsu

Smoke Illusion Technique.description: The user casts an illusion using smoke as a medium. The user creates shadowy replicas of themselves that vanish and appear throughout the smoke. The user can have these figures also "attack" the opponent. This technique can be further aided by using smoke clones that can actually harm the opponent.
Smoke Illusion Technique.title: Smoke Illusion Technique

Smoke Release: Genjutsu.description: The Smoke Release: Genjutsu is a Genjutsu that allows the user to create illusions by using the smoke created by the Smoke Release, a smoke based Kekkei Tōta. This technique is different from other Genjutsus in the fact that it does not affect the target's nervous system but instead creates psychical illusions made of smoke, this means that the Genjutsu is more believable and more effective than other Genjutsus.
Smoke Release: Genjutsu.title: Smoke Release: Genjutsu

Snake Slither Genjutsu.description: Using his , Ken appear to turn himself into a giant that binds the target leaving them at his mercy.
Snake Slither Genjutsu.title: Snake Slither Genjutsu

Soul Judgment.description: Soul Judgment is a Genjutsu created and used by Akame no Nishiki. With the application of chakra, Nishiki's red eyes can be made to glow ethereally. An opponent looking at Nishiki will be drawn to look at the eyes, when a Genjutsu will activate. To an opponent, it will seem as if Nishiki, in his stare, is expressing disdain and is pointing out all the flaws in the opponent's character. The memories of all the things the opponent is ashamed of doing will rise to the forefront, further enhancing the effects. Though this technique does not have much combat potential, as it merely establishes the superiority of Nishiki morally in the opponent's mind, it is a useful tool during negotiations and while trying to convince someone to listen to you.
Soul Judgment.title: Soul Judgment

Soulbane.description: Soulbane is a powerful genjutsu known to be forbidden among the Konohagakure ninja. It targets the mind and causes the target to believe that anyone is a foe. While under the effects of the genjutsu, anyone affected will attack those who they believe to be enemies, even their closest friends. They will act completely coherent, however, almost as if it is of their own volition, but they will not listen to reason. Once defeated, they return to normal with no memory of the events. A more powerful version was cast on Konoha ninja through the use of barriers set up and maintained at four points, two of which were protected by ninja who were under the effects of the genjutsu themselves. This more potent version could not be dispelled by normal means; only by killing the original caster could it be stopped. * Oddly enough, when the genjutsu was used on Hinata and Shino, Kiba and Akamaru, Neji a

infobox.users: Kazuya Herikaru, Kagura, Shisui Uchiha (DP), Kanamaru Masatake, Kimi Sarutobi

Soulbane.title: Soulbane

Soulless Sandstorm.description: This is a technique created by Shigai Daija That allows him to mess with and even kill opponents. It begins with him kicking up a massive amount of sediment from the ground that creates a sea of sand. He then creates a large gust of wind that turns the sea into a raging sandstorm. The sand of the storm is filled with his chakra which allows him to bend in with it. However enemies will easily be found as the sand will highlight them for him. Using this as a cover he can attack an opponent normally with justus or use a special genjutsu he created for this. This gents involves throwing his voice at various angles all around opponent. Combined with the howling wind and his mastery of voice usage he cannot be located by his voice. Hearing his voice while within this storm will trap the opponent in a genjutsu. This certain genjutsu makes them trapped in a sandstorm that stretches thousands of

infobox.jutsu type: Wind Release, Earth Release, Yin Release

Soulless Sandstorm.title: Soulless Sandstorm

Sound Release Illusion: Needle Melody.description: This technique paralyzes the enemy. It starts if the enemy hears the little sound of the hand signs being performed. The enemy starts feeling dizy and is seen in a dark place. Then, he hears steps and fast moves. He then feels an extremely acute pain and when he looks to his body he sees one thousand senbons spiked on it. When the Genjutsu is over the enemy falls to the ground with no senbons.
Sound Release Illusion: Needle Melody.title: Sound Release Illusion: Needle Melody

Speak of the Devil Technique.description: This particular Genjutsu is, unlike others, activated through verbal expression. In this regard, the Genjutsu utilizes the words spoken by the user, and subsequently employs them as a means to direct the chakra network's flow within the brain. In turn, the brain creates illusory, holographic images which play upon a "big screen." This said illusion becomes more potent depending on the victim's connection to the said words, and how they interpret them. Therefore, the technique is rather subjective in its effect, and is entirely dependent on the personal relevance that the victim has to the words spoken.

infobox.users: Akari Murakami, Hideyoshi Nara,Madara Uchiha (Cherry), Satoru Kensei

Speak of the Devil Technique.title: Speak of the Devil Technique

Spirit Amplification Technique.description: This technique, as its name suggests, allows the user to magnify and project composed primarily of spiritual energy into the surrounding area. By doing so one is able to induce effects upon targeted individuals within his immediate vicinity. This technique is unique among most genjutsu, requiring only precise chakra control to initiate. Thus, it allows opponents to be ensnared through proximity alone. As a relatively simple genjutsu the Spirit Amplification Technique can entrap a target in an illusion of variable design, such as conjuring illusory doppelgangers or triggering an involuntary loss of consciousness, granting a great deal of flexibility in performance. The potency of this technique seems to be directly tied to the development of the user's skill with genjutsu, increasing in potential intensity as one's skill in the illusory arts progresses. Particularly, some individuals have
Spirit Amplification Technique.title: Spirit Amplification Technique

Spirit Illusion: False Flame Technique.description: Spirit Illusion: False Flame Technique (精幻・偽炎の術, Seigen: Kaen no Jutsu) is the first of Koyone Takamori original illusions, developed just prior to her entry into the . Initiated by holding an explosive tag with the , Koyone casts an illusion of igniting the paper tag with her chakra, whose flames can be directed toward her target in a variety of shapes and sizes. Targets who believe themselves to be struck by this illusory fire will incur an intense burning sensation, delivering a notable level psychological stress. Additionally, Koyone can make it seem as if the aforementioned flames sprout forth from any explosive tags she's thrown, sometimes in concert with their natural destructive effect. Koyone often, and quite purposely, announces this technique as , perpetrating the ruse that she's utilizing a technique.
Spirit Illusion: False Flame Technique.title: Spirit Illusion: False Flame Technique

Spirit Illusion: Focus Disortion.description: A refined and specific application of the Spirit Amplification Technique this slowly robs the victim of their ability to visually focus on the surrounding environment, effectively disrupting their ability to properly react to their opponents. This technique initially manifests itself as a slight blurriness around moving objects, that eventually escalates to the inability to focus on any visual target whatsoever. As the effect is not instantaneous, are more likely to believe the effects of the illusion as reality. Due to the perceived visual blur, victims of this technique often demonstrate decreased accuracy and reaction time, which can put an individual at a significant disadvantage.
Spirit Illusion: Focus Disortion.title: Spirit Illusion: Focus Disortion

Spirit Illusion: Peerless Transcendence.description: Spirit Illusion: Peerless Transcendence (精幻・無双超絶, Seigen: Musō Chōzetsu) is a developed by Kyōshi Takamori and later passed on to this sister, Koyone. Rare amongst illusory techniques this skill provides a supportive function, as opposed to the vast majority of genjutsu that distort or falsify an opponent's senses. More specifically, this technique allows an individual to concentrate and refine the mind's interpretation of sensory input. This is turn allows the user to amplify the reaction time of both themselves and their allies, as well as improve the efficacy of certain . While this technique is incredibly beneficial, it carries the risk of mental exhaustion if it is overused. This can be partially overcome in by experienced users like Kyōshi, who can maintain this technique for extended periods of time without much noticeable cost, but this requires years of strenuous training.
Spirit Illusion: Peerless Transcendence.title: Spirit Illusion: Peerless Transcendence

Spirit Illusion: Reverse Dream Technique.description: Spirit Illusion: Reverse Dream Technique (精幻・逆夢の術, Seigen: Sakayume no Jutsu) is a developed by Kyōshi Takamori and later passed on to this sister, Koyone. This technique allows the user to relay a target's sensory information to themselves. This effectively allows one to view or listen from a target's perspective, usually without disrupting the target in question. While this technique can potentially relay information from multiple senses simultaneously, and even replay sensory information from a target's memory, novice practitioners can only observe a single sense from real time. This is due to the great deal of concentration necessary to perform this technique, which also makes it near impossible to employ in combat.
Spirit Illusion: Reverse Dream Technique.title: Spirit Illusion: Reverse Dream Technique

Spirit of Reckoning Technique.description: The Spirit of Reckoning Technique is a reasonably high level Genjutsu which is mainly used for interrogation purposes. The user exerts his chakra from his body in the direction of the opponent and forcibly puts them in a violent illusion to be 'judged' by a tall, thin, Grim Reaper like figure. Chains penetrate the victim's body in the illusion and bind them, with the illusion actually stimulating parts of the brain which are associated with pain. This creates an actual feeling of intense pain as the interrogation commences, with the Reaper performing brutal acts of 'torture', such as disemboweling a victim, removing limbs or organs, mutilation and intense acts of cruelty like castration. For this reason alone, attempting to dispel the Genjutsu by means of inflicting pain on oneself would be thoroughly useless.The pain alone ensures that the enemy is more and more incapable of breaking th
Spirit of Reckoning Technique.title: Spirit of Reckoning Technique

Strallilium of Divine Genesis.description: The Strallilium are the radials of etheric chakra which are designed to penetrate the subsuvial membrane of an ensouled being and infuse the corporeal body of that soul's matter expression with the codes of divine kinship (and thus service) beyond the tapestry of karmic revolutions. The subsuvial membrane is a contact substance of interface between the etheric and the corpuscles of the blood. They were first discovered by the Sage of Enlightenment, Gaoh Minazuki during his tenure at the Academy of On which was in turn taught by the Chengdu Clan. The Path Gold Alignment techniques or rather Gushkin-banda techniques usage are a symbolical and energetic representation of the spiritual illumination and physical transformation of the human race to its perfected state. They are a vibrational melding of etheric wave and human realization, causing a physical, mental, spiritual and soul reaction.

infobox.users: Gaoh Minazuki, Asu Rashoujin, Namino Majikina, Sun Wukong (SahaTo), Ukyo Hara, Garyo Kanakura, Eligos, Geryon, Orias

Strallilium of Divine Genesis.title: Strallilium of Divine Genesis

String Bean Binding Illusion.description: {{JutsuInfobox |image1=String Bean Illusion 1.png |caption1=The target gets restrainted by bean strings... |image2=String Bean Illusion 2.png |caption2=...giving the user the opportunity to strike. |tabber=Yes |unnamed=Yes |other jutsu=Yes |parent jutsu=Demonic Illusion: Tree Binding Death |jutsu classification=Genjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary |jutsu range=Short |users= |hand signs= |debut anime= |jutsu media=Anime, Manga, Game, Movie }} This user casts an illusion that makes themselves disappear while the target sees several bean vines growing from the ground. These vines bind the victim's body, lifting them into the air before a bean pod raises and opens to reveal the user, ready to strike. However, a skilled genjutsu user can revert the effects to the user.
String Bean Binding Illusion.title: String Bean Binding Illusion

Kei is not necessarily different, but his own style of fighting encompasses all ranges and adapts specifically to the opponent he faces. Due to Kei's love of combination: of techniques, etc, Kei has amassed all his fighting styles into one kind of fighting. Using different skills, Kei can aim to eliminate or distract the opponent, keeping them on their toes throughout before changing it up and finishing the job. The genjutsu affects anyone residing in this area and forces them to act towards a goal of the user's choice. Similar to of Shisui's dōjutsu, any victims of the technique are entirely unaware that they're being manipulated. From the target's initial point of view, its as if they've been set-ablaze without being burnt, which serves as a distraction to allow the technique to take effect. Once the technique takes full effect the target experiences excruciatingly painful sensations as if their being burnt alive.

Ten Thousand Moments of Dread.description: This genjutsu is the personal creation of Genjiro Hirosame, the leader of the Death Guard. While concentrating chakra, Genjiro can make anyone relieve the pain of people they've wronged in the past. The victim is trapped inside the wronged person's body and is able to feel anything it happened to them, with every sensation greatly amplified. Because of the sensory overload, this genjutsu can render someone mad or possibly kill them. This technique gained Genjiro the nickname "The Storm Demon". This technique is almost impossible to counter but if someone can ignore the augmented feelings, can break this technique like any genjutsu. However, using this method requires great will. Also, the technique ends if Genjiro stop focusing chakra.

Tennotama.description: Tennotama (玉の天, Tennotama) is the unique ability of Saraya Hatake's Mangekyō Sharingan. Tennotama, simply put, allows Saraya to create "pockets" of Genjutsu in multiple areas of her choosing. These pockets can not be spotted without a Sharingan or other doujutsu. Each pocket differs depending on Saraya's wishes. With her right eye, she can cast a short range Tennotama. With her left eye, she can cast a long range Tennotama. What makes this technique highly versatile is the fact that Saraya does not need to make eye contact for the genjutsu to take effect. It also does not require Saraya to focus on an area to maintain the pocket. However, they do disperse with time.

It is said to represent the "Spiritual World and Darkness" (精神界と闇, Seishinkai to Yami) and is the antipode to Amaterasu. Tsukuyomi requires eye contact to be performed. When executed, the technique traps the target in an illusion that is completely controlled by the user. Itachi's prowess with the technique has allowed him to alter the perception of time with ease within the genjutsu to make it seem to last for days when in fact it only lasts a few seconds. This allows
Tsukuyomi.title: Tsukuyomi

Tsukuyomi (NejiHyuga2).description: This is the page for the technique as it appears in the Diaries of the Hidden Waterfall series. For the canon rendition, refer to . For the fanon rendition, refer to Tsukuyomi. Tsukuyomi is a Mangekyō Sharingan dōjutsu and one of the most powerful genjutsu in existence. Said to represent the , Tsukuyomi is but one vertex of the "holy trinity" formed by itself and two other techniques, Amaterasu and Kuraokami. Tsukuyomi is a Mangekyō Sharingan dōjutsu awakened in the left eyes of both Itachi Uchiha and Seika Uchiha. Both Uchiha are able to trap a target within their genjutsu with a single glance and both Uchiha are highly capable of manipulating the target's perception of time. *Amatsumeisōte * *Kotoamatsukami *'
Tsukuyomi (NejiHyuga2).title: Tsukuyomi (NejiHyuga2)

Tsukuyomi Mode.description: This technique is a variation of Tsukuyomi, a high level Genjutsu. The user transforms the Tsukuyomi into a barrier that slows the opponent down. This does not happen physically but rather mentally. It makes the opponent think they are being held back by a barrier. While using this technique, Itachi's health and chakra slowly go down. If Itachi uses this technique when his health bar is low, he could finish himself off.

infobox.jutsu classification: Kekkei Genkai~Mangekyō Sharingan, Dōjutsu, Genjutsu, Barrier Ninjutsu,

Tsukuyomi Mode.title: Tsukuyomi Mode

Tsukuyomi: Amazakaru.description: Tsukuyomi: Amazakaru is a Mangekyō Sharingan dōjutsu utilized by Seika Uchiha, serving as the antipode to Sasuke Uchiha's and Emiri Uchiha's Blaze Release: Kagutsuchi. Manifesting in her left Mangekyō Sharingan, Tsukuyomi: Amazakaru is a technique that according to Itachi Uchiha is the ability to apply 'hyperrealistic fluidity' to the illusions of Tsukuyomi to the point that Itachi—who is capable of using Tsukuyomi himself—couldn't discern the line between illusion and reality when he was influenced by this technique as an experiment. Even Shisui Uchiha who possesses the Kotoamatsukami—widely considered to be the most powerful genjutsu—was only able to differentiate the boundary after subjected to several hours of the technique's influence which Shisui further comments was more than enough time for Seika to kill him if she was so inclined to do so. "Amazakaru" is but a single part of the
Tsukuyomi: Amazakaru.title: Tsukuyomi: Amazakaru

Twinkling Maiden's Heart.description: Sakura smiles at her opponent before glaring and summoning her giant inner self. Inner Sakura yells, "I'm speaking from the heart!" as she punches her opponent. The screen shatters, revealing it all to have been a genjutsu and Sakura herself punched her opponent. The foe flies off into the distance. Sakura smiles and says, "You should be nice to girls."
Twinkling Maiden's Heart.title: Twinkling Maiden's Heart

Unending Fear Technique.description: {| align=center style="background:transparent;" | valign=center | This article, , is property of Jumpy Naruto. |} The Unending Fear Technique (永遠の恐れテクニック) is part of a long line of comical jutsu along with the Unending Laughter,Tears and Speech Techniques.The Unending Fear is a Genjutsu.It makes the opponent believe that he/she is under assault by their worst fears imaginable.This jutsu is the a non-lethal jutsu as well as being the most mentally scarring jutsu.It should be noted that it is extremely comical to see your enemy crouching,running,hiding and screaming at enemies that do not exist.Though these cases are rare,there are few people who die from shock at the sight of the Genjutsu.After the sequence of hand seals is completed the opponent will already be under the Genjutsu.This style of jutsu is regularly employed by the Ninja Jesters of the Land of Deception.
Unending Fear Technique.title: Unending Fear Technique

Unending Tears Technique.description: {| align=center style="background:transparent;" | valign=center | This article, , is property of Jumpy Naruto. |} The Unending Tears Technique (永遠の悲しみテクニック) is another of the comical Unending line of Ninjutsu along with the Unending Laughter, Speech and Fear Techniques. This jutsu forces the opponent to re-live their saddest moments in their minds over and over again. Using their chakra, the user then manipulates the target's emotions and multiplies the sadness by ten. This forces the opponent into an unending period of tears that lasts as long as the user wishes. This jutsu is fatal, in the fact that, due to unending tears forced by the jutsu, the opponent becomes massively de-hydrated to the point that they may die because of it. So, in a way, the opponent actually cries him/herself to death. Due to the manipulation of the target's mind, this jutsu is considered as genjutsu and ninjuts
Unending Tears Technique.title: Unending Tears Technique

Unrivaled Torture.description: * Name: Unrivaled Torture ** Other names: none * Element: none * Rank: A * Range: Short * Type: Offensive, Kagirinaigan ability * Classification: Genjutsu * Hand Seals: Tiger * Users: Ryun Uchiha The jutsu consisted of Ryun gesturing with his hand and mentally reaching into the victim's mind, forcing them to relive all the worst memories of their life, both painful ones and ones that were merely embarrassing, over and over and over again to the point where it almost seemed to cause physical pain. Interestingly, Ryun found that after a brief session of torture, the subjects demonstrated a slight increase in intelligence and efficiency after they recovered. At extreme intensities this genjutsu could kill the victim.
Unrivaled Torture.title: Unrivaled Torture

Upheaval Incision: Illusionary Heaven.description: This technique is a combination of Ninjutsu, Bukijutsu and Genjutsu. It incorporates the use of Kama Uchiha's Mangekyō Sharingan. The user imbues the Tempest Shuriken with lightning-natured chakra, hurling it towards the opponent. By looking at the Tempest Shuriken, the target is cast in a powerful Genjutsu which is made to seem like reality. When the opponent 'dodges' the incoming shuriken, it will be merely an illusion, whereas they will be slashed by the shuriken in the real world. The trick is in the genjutsu, and it affects the five senses along with the 'sixth' sense for some gifted shinobi. These senses; Sight, Texture, Smell, Taste and Hearing, are all manipulated and allow the illusion to be distinctively similar to reality in every aspect, allowing them to not be able to realize the Illusion, even with Dōjutsu such as the Rinnegan as their sight is also hindered, which will mak

Vertigo Genjutsu.description: The user casts a genjutsu that causes the target to perceive everything around them in slow motion causing them to feel dizziness and confusion. In addition, the environment and people within the illusion become distorted in a wavy-like manner. This can ultimately cause the victim to faint or at the very least give them a headache. While a basic genjutsu, this can work well on targets with less experience dealing with genjutsu.
Vertigo Genjutsu.title: Vertigo Genjutsu

Very Hiden-Wood Release: Song of Nature.description: {|width="50%" align="center" !width="25%" style="border:5px outset black; border-radius:2ex; background: radial-gradient(#e5a0e1, #ce90ca, #b780b4, #a0709d, #896087, #725070, #5b405a); "|Goddess of the Double Blossomed Cherry Tree |} is an extremely powerful ethereal sound based technique crafted by the that has the ability to ensnare all who hears the song of nature to lose their connection to worldly things and to become the herald to the pure world of nature. This technique is used in conjunction with the in order to produce an unavoidable technique that forces the opponent lose their control of their inner chakra and the manipulation of natural energy. It is a truly enchanting and mesmerizing song for those whom are unfortunate enough to have her voice bless their ears. is a fundamental source of energy that flows throughout the world and is often noted as the predecessor to chakra.

Virtual.description: *Name: Virtual. *Element: Genjutsu. *Type: Supplementary. *Description: This technique is simple but quite ingenious. It is as simple as making the tharget perciev that they hear voices emanating from inanimate objects. Marek uses this to give the appearance that his puppet Blackout is in fact an actual person. It distorts the targets senses just enough so that they think they hear the puppet speaking and see the proper effects when they hit a body or slice flesh etc.
Virtual.title: Virtual

Voices of Spirits from the Past and Futu.description: is an infinitely subtle technique invented by for the sake of bending the minds of creation. It is considered a truly dangerous .

Wakaremichi.description: After casting the Forest of Shadows, In'ei takes her opponent(s) to the center of a road under the treetops. She than presents different offshoots from the center, showing different "possibilities" that could befall the opponent, before forcing them to choose one. The jutsu itself is meant to overload the brain with possibilities while placing them between a rock and a hard place.
Wakaremichi.title: Wakaremichi

Water Release Genjutsu: Demonic Phantom.description: After the user performs the necessary hand seals, the Conch King opens its shell and releases a mist that puts the opponent under a genjutsu. In the genjutsu, the Conch King licks the opponent until they're frozen which results in the opponent being overcome with fear and in a matter of time and goes into a mental breakdown. The power of the genjutsu was greatly increased by the trees' magnetic forces surrounding the swamp they were in.

Water Release: Drowning Paradise.description: After the hand seals are formed, the user creates an illusionary beach like paradise. Then, the sand begins to turn into a pitch black ocean and the victim believes they are drowning. In reality, they cause pain to themselves due to them gasping for air in the illusion.
Water Release: Drowning Paradise.title: Water Release: Drowning Paradise

Water-Reflecting Moonlight.description: is a powerful genjutsu employed by Heiwa through his water-based techniques. By applying his Yin Release in tandem with his Water Release techniques, anyone who comes into contact with said water is trapped in a powerful illusion whereby a reflection of them comes to life, rising to fight them. Being a natural pacifist as well as possessing a profound talent in the use of water-based techniques, Heiwa had an idea of a genjutsu to be used as a means to quickly end his battles by subduing his targets without the use of his eyes. During his usual self-training in the ponds of Kiri, Heiwa was looking on the water whilst warming up. He saw the moon reflected on the water, the same as the one on the horizon, and thus the idea of the genjutsu was sparked. His application involved subtlety and stealth, in which he would make it seem like ninjutsu, and thus not raise suspicion during his applicat
Water-Reflecting Moonlight.title: Water-Reflecting Moonlight

White Lotus.description: Gekihen rapidly expels large quantities of scale powder imbued with large amounts of chakra, which have a luminous color that blinds targets and places them in genjutsu once seen. The chakra within them creates loud vibrations, which add another layer of the genjutsu once heard. A strong odor is also created by the chakra in the powder, which, once smelled, will add another layer of the genjutsu. Upon making contact with the target, the chakra casts another layer through touch. Once the target is trapped within even a single layer of the genjutsu, Gekihen can control their body, which he then manipulates to taste the powder, casting the strongest layer of the genjutsu. Due to the external factors to initiate, reversing the genjutsu is impossible, however, releasing it is possible, but Gekihen can simply cast it again, as long ast the powder remains. The complexity of the illusion is imme
White Lotus.title: White Lotus

White Marsh Technique.description: The White Marsh Technique (白沢の術, Hakutaku no Jutsu) is a highly advanced Genjutsu technique exclusive to those who have made themselves highly proficient in the ninja skill. While this technique is widespread, only a few users possess the knowledge and proficiency within the art in order to utilize it correctly. There are a few steps that are required to master this specific technique, which only dedicated Genjutsu practitioners may attempt to master. Therefore, those of the Uchiha Clan, who possess an illusion of similar potency, opt not to learn this technique on most occasions. To utilize this technique, one must understand the nature of Genjutsu combat. Two users engaging in a battle of Genjutsu are engaging in a battle of wills, intellect, and most of all, deception. Therefore, the use of illusions to fight against illusions is something most users tend not to utilize unless absolut
White Marsh Technique.title: White Marsh Technique

White Squall.description: White Squall(白疾風, Shiro Shippū) is a wind based illusion used by Ryūken Senju. Since, Ryuken can control air pressure, manipulate wind, use wind chakra and finally to some extent can use air space he would emit a special wind from his body which would be relatively thicker than normal air, then this air would spread throughout a huge range (nearly 500 meter). When inhaled by someone, they would become immobile. Soon, the whole world would appear in an inverted manner and everything would turn black and white then the user makes his enemies see their worst nightmare this causes them to suffer through extreme mental trauma, and causes them to became mentally unstable. This also to somewhat weakens their will power to do anything. Hence, this technique not only incapacitates the enemy but also makes him mentally unfit to continue fighting and is said to be amazingly effective when it comes
White Squall.title: White Squall

Wicked Tongue Curse.description: Wicked Tongue Curse is a technique created by Koji Yamanaka and is his most powerful technique. He describes this technique as the culmination of all his shinobi skills into one technique. Upon making the snake hand seal a tattoo appears on his tongue and extends to his cheeks. The seal is made up of Yin Release and Lightning Release chakra, and allows the user to induce spoken commands on anyone who hears the user's voice. This is done by the seal emanating it's own electromagnetic field that not only subjects the target to entrancing electrical soundwaves, but also influences the bio-electric field of all living beings causing them to be caught in a powerful, unbreakable, and unblockable genjutsu that makes targets obey every command of the user through the hijacking and manipulation of their neural impulses and synapses. Through this technique the target is subjected to every command
Wicked Tongue Curse.title: Wicked Tongue Curse

Will Bending.description: Will Bending is a Genjutsu created and used by Akame no Nishiki. Nishiki waves his hand almost casually, and to any person looking at it a Genjutsu activates. A subtle illusion, it plants in their mind the suggestion that all of Nishiki's ideas or plans are much better and more attractive than any that the person themselves may have come up with or heard from any other person. Though Nishiki cannot force anyone to do something as drastic as, say, killing themselves, he can still convince them to take his side in a negotiation or conflict.
Will Bending.title: Will Bending

Wind Illusion Breeze of Wind Pillar.description: This genjutsu pushes the enemy with an extremely strong gust of wind that appears to emanate from the user's body. A secondary genjutsu can then be used within this genjutsu.
Wind Illusion Breeze of Wind Pillar.title: Wind Illusion Breeze of Wind Pillar

Wind Release: Sand Cloud Whirlwind.description: The user creates a dome-shaped sandstorm which surrounds the opponent and hinders it from escaping. During the technique's execution, the used sand particles collide against each other, thus creating electro-magnetic waves which place the trapped person under never-ending genjutsu in the form of characterless beings attacking with kunai. While the target is busy fending these illusions off, it is vulnerable for attacks from the outside. When sand isn't readily available Akari will use Earth Release alongside the technique to create sand or other earthen debris. * Chakra Ghost Technique

Wind Release: Tornado Paradise.description: The user does the hand seals and creates an illusionary city. Then, the sky turns dark and a fearsome tornado starts destroying things and sucking them in. The victim is either sucked in or struck by a flying object. In reality, they feel the pain of wherever they were strucked or sliced.
Wind Release: Tornado Paradise.title: Wind Release: Tornado Paradise

Wood Release Secret Technique: Pitcher P.description: This technique uses wood nature chakra to physically and mentally paralyze targets, rendering them unable to move or think properly while killing them. It attacks targets simultaneously on two fronts, physically with ninjutsu and mentally with genjutsu. The effect of this technique can be targeted at or neglected from specific chakra signatures, making it ideal for use in group fighting over a large area.

Wood Release: Aokigahara.description: This technique was created by Sensha as a trump card of sorts. It is his most powerful wood release technique and possibly his most powerful technique he has. Sensha begins by slamming his hand into the ground to create an entire forest around him that spans an astounding range in every direction. The created wood is petrified making it impossible to burn and extremely hard to break. The leaves become like razors that cut up anything that touches them. Due to the canopy far above them, the whole forest is basked in complete darkness. Sensha then activates the second part of the technique. Using his Yin chakra he distributes into the forest he creates small plants that can produce and repeat sound. He then speaks three words, "End it all". The plants pick this up and begin repeating it over and over in a maddening chorus while every word that comes out of their mouth can throw Sensha's op
Wood Release: Aokigahara.title: Wood Release: Aokigahara

Wood Release: Forest of False Prophets.description: This is often said to be the most feared of all of someone's jutsu, and for good reason. Much like a traditional Wood style jutsu, the user is capable of creating an entire forest in the blink of an eye. But that is where all similarities end. Every tree in this forest is alive. Each tree possesses a single Sharingan eye, watching the unfortunate victim with cruel intent. This living forest is surrounded in a massive genjutsu, in which the single act of looking at any of the eyes will result in paralysis. Enemies who are trapped in the forest will also find the task of using jutsu difficult, as the forest draws in chakra from the air around it in order to grow. This often results in victims being drained of their chakra, and then killed as the massive forest grows around them.

Wood Release: Illusion Arm.description: Wood Release: Illusion Arm is a technique that allows multiple use of the two forbidden genjutsu techniques, Izanagi and Izanami. After performing the needed hand seals, the user creates an arm of Wood Release, which covers the original arm like an armor. The arm is revealed to have Sharingan embedded in it, allowing the user to control it. After the eyes are activated, the user can then use Izanagi and Izanami at will.

Wood Release: Star Hailing from Heaven.description: ---- Wood Release: Star Hailing from Heaven is a powerful cooperation ninjutsu made up of the kekkei genkais Wood Release and Scorch Release. It also uses the Mangekyō Sharingan and it's parent. It uses Yang Release for various purposes as well. First, it is recommended that the Uchiha goes first while attacking. First the Uchiha should attack the opponent with some sort of weapon, then use the Genjutsu: Sharingan technique to place them under a genjutsu. After that, the Senju uses Wood Release Secret Technique: Nativity of a World of Trees to make a tree that catches the opponent and takes them upward. Then the Uchiha should start the Scorch Release: Incinerating Flare Technique and then use Kamui to make it disappear for a while as the Senju adds Yang Release chakra to the branches to make them spread apart. Once they spread apart and show the target, the Kamui goes above the opponent'

World Reversing Technique.description: By casting a hallucinating effect on the targets eyes, the user casts a genjutsu that causes anyone who is affected to see everything backwards (e.g. Day is night, World is upside down, Allies looking like foes). No matter how skilled an opponent is with breaking genjutsu, the only way the foe can break it is that they have to land a clean hit on the one that cast it.
World Reversing Technique.title: World Reversing Technique

World Serpent Treasured Dharma Eye.description: is an extremely dangerous genjutsu that combines both contact-type and visual-type along with components of senjutsu into one technique. It is a genjutsu of unparalleled mystique and peril, a technique that weaves together the ethereal threads of senjutsu and genjutsu into a tapestry of both beauty and dread. This results in it being a mystical and perhaps one of the most dangerous snake-related techniques in his arsenal. As its namesake or maybe through legend alone, this technique allows Karamitsuku to trap all individuals within a certain range of him under a mysterious genjutsu while simultaneously inflicting to all objects that the Treasured Dharma Eye sees. Those who gaze upon it will never forget the eye's irresistible and overwhelming presence. By holding the jin seal and manipulating the mythical energies of his chakra, Karamitsuku is able to summon the eye of a divine world ser
World Serpent Treasured Dharma Eye.title: World Serpent Treasured Dharma Eye

Yamako.description: also referred to as the Out of Sight, Out of Mind Technique is a powerful genjutsu developed by Asuna Kurama.
Yamako.title: Yamako

Yang Release: White Paradise.description: Doujinn teleports his victim to a black space and traps his victim. The area suddenly becomes white, and the victim's body begins to deteriorate into ash.
Yang Release: White Paradise.title: Yang Release: White Paradise

Yin Release: Black Dream.description: This technique can only work when under any type of genjutsu that puts them under sleeping stasis like the Temple of Nirvana Technique, once the opponent is asleep the user weaves the necessary hand seals and cast this technique into the opponents mind where it'll manifest manifest shadow creatures each effecting certain aspects of the human body. Each of these shadowy nightmares attack differently that harms the opponent under the genjutsu, the first creature that attacks steals the and replenish the caster, the second beast attacks effect the mind eating away at the psyche of the target, the third and last creature feeds off the opponents soul and Life Force which will then replenish and strengthen the caster till the target is either incapacitated or dead.

Yin Release: Black Paradise.description: Doujinn teleports his victim to a white space and traps them. The space suddenly turns black, and all the chakra is absorbed from the victim, causing the body functions and mind to stop working.
Yin Release: Black Paradise.title: Yin Release: Black Paradise

Yin Release: Insanity Scythe Technique.description: by conjuring a form of pure Yin Release and forming it into the shape of a scythe the user is able to cast a unique illusion on anyone cut. The scythe itself is very fragile and does not physically harm anything, when shattered, it expels a burst of yin chakra which causes an additional hallucinatory genjutsu, of the user's choosing. Skilled users are able to imbue existing weapons with this technique allowing them to cast illusions on anyone touched by the object in question.
Yin Release: Insanity Scythe Technique.title: Yin Release: Insanity Scythe Technique

Yin Release: Mental Fracture.description: After weaving the needed hand seals, the user places their index and middle finger on the target's head and releases Yin Release chakra into it. Shortly afterwards the target vision turns into a haze of grey and black signalling the target is under allowing the caster to send a wave of Yin Release into the brain, this would trigger the target to become a blind with rage and bloodlust, attacking anyone or anything around the target like a wild animal but can still utilize it's chakra but unable to use techniques except it's strength making themselves a mindless killing machine. The technique usually wears off in five minutes, after which the target has slight disorientation.
Yin Release: Mental Fracture.title: Yin Release: Mental Fracture

Yin Release: Mirage Armour.description: Activating the Mirage Genjutsu, Maomi will cast it on herself, making the victim unable to land any techniques on her. This jutsu is similar to Izanagi and Kamui since it gives the user intangibility and casts a genjutsu on themselves.
Yin Release: Mirage Armour.title: Yin Release: Mirage Armour

Yin Release: Raining Blades.description: This is a genjutsu that was created by Kashikoi during her training in genjutsu. How it works is that by using the Sukiru Secret Technique: Kaibyaku, she is able to open up her imagination to a point were blades start hitting the opponent. While these blades don't necessarily do any physical damage, they attack the brain and nervous system, making the opponent feel like there is actually damage being done.

infobox.users: Haru Hyūga,Takashi Kazami, Kashikoi Sukiru, In'ei

Yin Release: Raining Blades.title: Yin Release: Raining Blades

Yin Release: Thousand Droplets.description: Yin Release: Thousand Droplets (陰遁千点滴, Inton Sententeki) is a technique devised by Yuto Chinoike. By swinging his in a certain pattern, Yuto draws the opponent into a trance-like state. Once the target is within this trance, Yuto imbues Yin Release Chakra to run through his blade and he swings, aiming to slash into their skin. Once blood is drawn, the Yin Release Chakra is able to enter the body of the target and take effect. Due to the chakra being in the individuals bloodstream, the effects are much more potent. Once in this Genjutsu, the target is shown a seen where the people they care for most are impaled by a thousand blades dropping from the sky and piercing their bodies. Due to the target still being in a trance-esque state, it is even more difficult to differentiate this illusion from reality. The most dangerous part of this technique stems from the trance-like state. Not only c
Yin Release: Thousand Droplets.title: Yin Release: Thousand Droplets

Yin Release: Voice of the Forest Techniq.description: The is one of the of the Noble . This technique is one that was originally developed during . Simple in execution, the caster first coats their vocal cords with chakra, allowing them to use their own voice as a medium for genjutsu. Due to the fact that the technique utilizes sound-waves, it is far harder to resist than the average illusion. By speaking, the caster generates a sound-wave that directly influences the central nervous system of those who hear them. Washing over the eardrums, the spiritualized sound-wave flows through the organs of the inner ear to bring their target under thrall, entrancing them to do what the caster wishes. Created by the Kurama Clan, the technique was created with the intent to be used reconnaissance or interrogation. While the genjutsu is active, the user is able to compel their target through a form of mental hypnotism: commands being etched directly int
Yin Release: Voice of the Forest Techniq.title: Yin Release: Voice of the Forest Technique

Yin-Yang Release: Eternal Paradise.description: After performing the needed hand seals, the user will touch the desired victim and take them to their own wonderland. After some words are spoken, the user will then use Killing Intent to destroy the victim's wonderland and it will then turn into a black and white space. While in space, the black and white swirls start spinning around the victim and their body becomes black and white. The user again puts their hand on the victim and suddenly the whole space begins to compress them. In reality, the user sealed the victim in the genjutsu, unable to be released. *Note* this jutsu can only be broken by the Izanagi Blade. This jutsu is labeled kinjutsu due to how much chakra it takes to seal the victim.

Zaiaku.description: Zaiaku is a powerful Genjutsu created by Kawarama Uchiha. Like most genjutsu, Zaiaku requires eye contact to be performed, trapping the target within an illusion completely under the user's control. The genjutsu places the target in an empty dark place, with the standing in front of them. The Shinigami will then show the target all the sins and wrong doings they have committed. After that the Shinigami will then state that the target is guilty, with this being said the ground will then split open making the target fall into hell. Despite being a genjutsu, the target will feel burned and can also suffer psychological damage. This genjutsu was so powerful it was able to take Kurasa out, however this was only for an hour.
